jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.description:
**Job ID** 20247 **Location** Los Angeles, California, United States **Job Category** Compliance / Quality **Date posted** 09/22/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------


When the work you do every single day has a crucial impact on the lives of others, every effort, every detail, and every second matters. This shared culture of passion and dedication pulses through Cedars\-Sinai, and it’s just one of the many reasons it was recognized by **U.S. News \& World Report’s ‘Best Hospitals’ Honor Roll for the eleventh consecutive year and tied \#1 in California \& Los Angeles**. Cedars\-Sinai continues to be acknowledged as a world leader in patient care, education, and research.


Our 915\-bed nonprofit, acute, tertiary, teaching Level I trauma center hospital is in the heart of Los Angeles. The Pharmacy Department has over 500 team members who are dedicated on providing both inpatient and outpatient pharmacy services, ensuring that patients receive high\-quality care tailored to their needs.


Join Cedars\-Sinai Medical Center at the forefront of one of the most transformative areas of medicine. The Cellular and Gene Therapy (CGT) Pharmacist Coordinator will serve as a clinical, operational, and strategic pharmacy leader in building and advancing a comprehensive CGT program across the health system. In this highly collaborative role, you will help design the infrastructure, governance, workflows, and partnerships needed to safely and effectively evaluate, procure, coordinate, administer, and monitor commercially approved, investigational, and emerging CGT products. Working closely with physicians, pharmacists, laboratory and research teams, finance leaders, and other key stakeholders, you will help translate innovative therapies into accessible, efficient, and patient\-centered care. As the CGT field continues to evolve, you will identify emerging opportunities, support strategic planning, and help shape the future of therapy delivery at Cedars\-Sinai. Your leadership will contribute to the safe, equitable, and financially responsible growth of CGT services while advancing the organization’s clinical, academic, and research missions.


This position has a flexible hybrid opportunity (up to 50% remote) and inpatient staffing (1 weekend per month) requirement.


\#LI\-RD1


**Qualifications**
------------------


**Educational Requirements:**
=============================


* Pharm.D. degree from an accredited School of Pharmacy
* Completion of a PGY1 residency or equivalent practice experience

**License/Certification/Registration Requirements:**
====================================================


* Current pharmacist licensure in the State of California.
* BLS certification upon hire

**What else are we looking for?**
=================================


* Passionate about advancing innovative therapies for patients with rare and difficult to treat conditions and helping patients navigate the complexities of the healthcare system
* Demonstrates strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex clinical, operational, financial, and scientific information clearly to diverse audiences
* Maintains a strategic, forward\-looking perspective on the cellular and gene therapy pipeline and identifies opportunities to prepare the organization for new therapies, technologies, indications, and treatment models
* Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where evidence, processes, and best practices continue to develop
* Maintains an excellent clinical database and critical thinking skills, including the ability to provide recommendations on the management of complex patients, utilizing organizational policies and evidence\-based medicine
* Is patient\-centered and committed to promoting equitable access to complex, high\-cost therapies while understanding the clinical, financial, and psychosocial challenges faced by patients and families
* Possesses experience in drug information services and formulary development
* Exhibits excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Demonstrates ability to prioritize projects to meet goals

jobs.description:
Under the supervision of the Campus Operations Manager, the Campus Operations and Events Coordinator will perform a variety of reception, organizational, programming, and student social support tasks addressing the needs of the school's basic facilities, operations and student's needs. The incumbent will serve as the first point of contact for visitors and callers and in many instances may provide supervision of students and will direct students and parents/guardians to the appropriate department/program.Is critical and essential that the incumbent have a basic understanding of risk management strategies and mitigation procedures in regard to health, safety and facilities and work continuously to broaden their knowledge, skills and abilities as there will be day to day occurrences where good judgement and mitigation measures will have to be executed and reported accordingly.The incumbent will also assist with a broad range of administrative customer service and clerical functions in support of the Geffen Academy at UCLA. As a result, superb customer service skills will be essential. Duties include assisting with daily basic maintenance requests and submitting tickets, following up and closing such activities with main campus' Facilities department. They will also maintain the organization of storage and public spaces as directed. Duties will also include answering phones, emailing, typing, photocopying, conference room reservation, setting up rooms, processing mail and distributing materials, stocking and tracking kitchen, copy and office supplies, supporting event planning and other administrative support duties as needed. It is essential that the incumbent be a self\-starter, proactive, flexible, communicate effectively and can coordinate and execute tasks with expediency, reliability and good judgement. jobs.title: Brand & Creative Coordinator, Social Media Content | Part Time
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

A premier Beverly Hills medical aesthetics and skincare practice is seeking a part\-time **Brand \& Creative Coordinator** to support our creative marketing, social media, digital presence and patient experience.

This is a hands\-on position for someone who is creative, visually minded and naturally understands today's digital and social media platforms. The role will help develop content for both the practice and the professional presence of a recognized aesthetic medical provider.

You'll spend part of your time creating and capturing content, developing creative ideas and supporting marketing initiatives, while also assisting with day\-to\-day practice operations when needed.

We're not necessarily looking for someone with years of agency or corporate marketing experience. We're looking for someone with **good creative instincts, a strong visual eye, reliability and the ability to turn ideas into polished content.**

**Responsibilities**

* Conceptualize, film and edit short\-form digital content
* Create content for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Stories and other digital channels
* Help develop the practice brand and the professional presence of an aesthetic medical provider
* Turn treatments, provider expertise and patient questions into engaging educational and lifestyle content
* Identify relevant beauty, aesthetics and digital trends and translate them into on\-brand creative concepts
* Capture treatment footage, before\-and\-after content, behind\-the\-scenes moments and lifestyle content

jobs.description:
Description:  



**Position Summary**


We are seeking an organized, detail\-oriented Inside Sales / Project Coordinator to support our sales team and coordinate projects from initial inquiry through quoting, submittals, approvals, and production release. This role partners closely with Engineering, Production, Purchasing, and Shipping, as well as external sales reps, dealers, customers, and contractors to ensure projects are quoted accurately, documented correctly, and executed on schedule.


The ideal candidate has experience reading blueprints or construction drawings, preparing quotes and proposals, coordinating multiple projects, and providing excellent customer service. Experience in restaurant equipment, commercial kitchens, manufacturing, construction, millwork, stainless\-steel fabrication, or a related industry is preferred.


Requirements:  



**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Prepare quotes and proposals in AutoQuotes; support special\-order pricing and product substitutions as needed. Ensure quotes and submittal packages are delivered accurately and on time.
* Review architectural/equipment plans, specifications, and shop drawings to identify requirements, constraints, and scope gaps.
* Coordinate submittal and drawing packages with internal teams and external parties; manage drawing revisions and approval cycles.
* Confirm product dimensions, finishes, quantities, and specifications prior to production release.
* Maintain accurate project files, correspondence, and status updates in company systems.
* Coordinate projects from the sales and estimating stages through production, delivery, and installation coordination.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for sales representatives, dealers, and consultants regarding project status and documentation.
* Communicate schedule risks, missing information, and conflicts early to keep projects on track.

* Identify potential project conflicts, missing information, or scheduling concerns and communicate them promptly.
* Provide customers and outside sales representatives with timely project updates.
* Help resolve issues such as order discrepancies, manufacturing errors, and other customer concerns in partnership with internal teams.
* Participate in sales meetings and provide updates on active projects.
* Develop strong working relationships with customers and support repeat business opportunities.
* Perform additional sales\-support and project\-coordination duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business, construction management, engineering, design, or a related field is preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in inside sales, project coordination, estimating, manufacturing, construction, restaurant equipment, or a related industry preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret blueprints, equipment plans, architectural plans, specifications, equipment schedules, and/or shop drawings.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Customer\-service\-focused approach with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating with outside sales and internal departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Experience using CRM, ERP, quoting, order\-entry, or project\-management software is preferred.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, measurements, dimensions, materials, and lead times is preferred.
* Experience with commercial restaurant equipment, stainless\-steel fabrication, millwork, cabinetry, refrigeration, or food\-service construction is a plus.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Equipment plan, drawing, specification reading
* Experience with AutoQuotes is a plus
* Quoting and estimating support
* Project coordination
* Estimating and quoting
* Order and change\-order management
* Cross\-functional communication (Sales/Engineering/Production)
* Scheduling and deadline management
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution
* Documentation and recordkeeping
* Cross\-functional teamwork
* Accuracy and attention to detail

**Physical and Work Requirements**

* Ability to work primarily in an office and manufacturing environment.
* Ability to sit, stand, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to walk through production areas and active project sites when necessary. and follow all safety policies when in production areas (PPE as required).
* Occasional lifting of samples, documents, or materials weighing up to 25 pounds.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Urology
jobs.description:
**Description**  

Under the direct supervision of the Clinical Trials Administrator, the Clinical Research Coordinator contributes to the overall operational management of clinical research/trial/study activities from design, setup, conduct, through closeout. The ideal candidate is an experienced professional who has direct responsibility for the implementation of research activities for one or more studies which may include multicenter clinical trials (both NIH and industry\-sponsored), local investigator\-initiated clinical trials, and/or programmatic clinical research activities. The Clinical Research Coordinator recognizes and performs necessary tasks to manage projects and prioritizes work to meet necessary deadlines. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and organizing necessary tasks to ensure adherence to the study protocol and applicable regulations, such as institutional policy and procedures, FDA Code of Federal Regulations (CFR), and ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP). You will also collaborate with the Principal Investigator (PI), ancillary departments, central research infrastructure teams, sponsors, institutions, and other entities as needed to support the administration of all aspects of studies, including, but not limited to, compliant conduct, financial management, and adequate personnel support. Salary offers are determined based on various factors, including but not limited to qualifications, experience, and equity.

  

Hourly Salary Range: $38\.19 \- $61\.45

  

Pay range: $38\.19 \- $61\.45 an hour  

  

**Qualifications** **Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimally 2\+ years of previous study coordination or clinical research coordination experience
* Interpersonal skills to effectively communicate information in a timely, professional manner and establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships with students, staff, faculty, external collaborators and administration and to work as a member of a team.
* Ability to effectively communicate to and interact with patients in a compassionate and kind manner.
* Ability to set priorities and complete ongoing tasks with competing deadlines, with frequent interruptions, to meet the programmatic and department needs, while complying with applicable University policies and federal and state regulations.
* Analytical skills to assess clinical research protocols and regulatory requirements, define problems, formulate logical solutions, develop alternative solutions, make recommendations, and initiate corrective actions.
* Close attention to detail to ensure accuracy in a fast\-paced, fluctuating workload environment.
* Organization skills to create and maintain administrative and regulatory files effectively as well as independently balance the various tasks to ensure deadlines are met.
* Demonstrated proficiency with Adobe and Microsoft suite software, especially Excel, to perform daily tasks efficiently and accurately.
* A learning and professional growth mentality so that new software tools, systems, and processes can be adopted quickly and efficiently
* Working knowledge of clinical research concepts, policies and procedures, and human safety protection regulations and laws.
* Knowledge of and experience working with a variety of local and external IRBs, scientific review and other research committees, national cooperative group sponsors, industry sponsors, federal and foundation funding organizations, etc.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively establish rapport, building collaborative relationships, and communicate complex concepts and ideas in an easy\-to understand manner.
* Ability to adapt to changing job demands and priorities, remain flexible including working flexible hours to accommodate research deadlines.
* High degree of concentration and focus in a work environment that contains distracting stimuli, competing deadlines, and work delegated by more than one individual

Overview
Tecolote Research, Inc. is seeking a talented, self\-driven individual for a position as a SME Strategic Communications Analyst to support the SSC/S6 Director, Cyber \& Data team in Los Angeles, CA. In this role, your work will have a profound impact on the country's most critical mission—protecting our national security by securing and modernizing the Space Force's cyber and data systems.


Responsibilities

Supporting the SSC/S6 Director, Cyber \& Data and their Chief of Staff as a key member of the team, the candidate will be responsible for the development and implementation of communication strategies that adhere to DoD and U.S. Space Force policies and guidance. The team member will:
* SSC Cyber Expo Execution: Lead and support the end\-to\-end event planning, coordination, and production for the SSC Cyber Expo—Space Systems Command’s premier event uniting leaders and innovators across the DoW, industry, and academia for three days of cyber strategy, operations, technology, and mission\-focused collaboration to advance our space\-based assets.
* Tasker \& Content Management: Use the Task Management Tool (TMT) and SharePoint to initiate, track, collaborate on, and close out various directorate, SSC, and Space Force Command taskers and documents.
* Strategic Writing \& Messaging: Research, draft, and edit articles, speeches, testimony, program acquisition point papers, briefings, and responses to Congressional, HHQ, and media Requests for Information (RFIs) for the S6 Director and senior leadership.
* Product Development: Develop a range of modern communication products, brand strategies, and guidelines to defend, educate, and promote the organization's cyber and data mission.
* Multimedia \& Design: Provide full\-service multimedia capabilities demonstrating professional knowledge in photography, end\-to\-end video production, and innovative design leveraging the latest technologies.
* Staff Integration: Assemble and provide instruction on the completion of electronic Staff Summary Sheet (eSSS) packages.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work cross\-functionally with internal stakeholders to create communication plans that align with the organization’s overall strategic objectives for space cyber defense and data modernization programs.
* Executive Engagement Support: Support senior leader strategic engagements and preparation packages, and facilitate Director PMRs, All\-Calls, and other high\-level meetings or event productions.
* Leadership Advisory: Effectively communicate with offices at each leadership level (Directorate, Center, MAJCOM, SF, DoD) and advise leadership on the status of assigned deliverables.
* Other duties as assigned.

jobs.title: Purchasing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About us**


We are a team of airline catering enthusiasts who believe flying is the greatest privilege and opportunity in the world and, believe it should be a nice experience for everyone. Air Fayre is an award\-winning catering team that is in search of the best and the brightest to join our dynamic team of airline catering enthusiasts.

**Air Fayre offers benefits including!**

* An excellent compensation package that includes a quarterly performance bonus program.
* Medical, Dental, and Vision for employees \& dependents at 80% premium sponsorship.
* Free short\- and long\-term disability insurance and life insurance
* 2\-4 weeks of paid vacation
* 401K with a match

 **Mission of role**


We’re looking for a detail\-oriented Purchasing Coordinator to process replenishment orders for materials, supplies, and equipment under the direction of the Purchasing Manager. This role helps ensure accurate purchase orders, timely supplier confirmations and deliveries, and appropriate inventory levels across our 24/7 airline catering operation.


You’ll work closely with purchasing, operations, inventory teams, and suppliers to identify shortages, coordinate replenishment, and maintain reliable product availability.

**Functions and Responsibilities**

* Process replenishment orders for materials, supplies, equipment, and airline catering products.
* Compile item, supplier, and order quantity information provided by the Purchasing Manager.
* Create and submit purchase orders to airline\-contracted and local suppliers, including orders placed through vendor websites.
* Monitor supplier confirmations, shipments, and promised delivery dates.
* Follow up on open orders and communicate potential shortages or late deliveries to operations.
* Maintain accurate inventory and purchasing records in supplier and Air Fayre systems.
* Help establish target inventory, safety stock, and replenishment quantities based on current inventory and outstanding orders.
* Coordinate orders for airline\-contracted products, fresh food, beverages, special meals, disposables, rotables, equipment, and charter products.
* Review inventory trends and abnormal movements to help prevent shortages, surplus, waste, and shrinkage.
* Establish and maintain positive working relationships with suppliers and internal teams.
 **Qualifications \& Educational Requirements**

* Approximately 3 years of purchasing, procurement, inventory control, or supply chain experience; food service experience preferred.
* Basic knowledge of supply chain management in a logistics or assembly environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, especially Excel; Microsoft Dynamics experience preferred.
* Ability to perform basic mathematical computations, analyze inventory data, identify discrepancies, and draw valid conclusions.
* Highly organized, analytical, and detail\-oriented, with strong follow\-through and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Flexible regarding work schedule in a 24/7 operation; bilingual English and Spanish is a plus.
* APICS coursework in purchasing, inventory management, or material requirements planning is preferred.
  

Join us in our mission to uphold the highest standards of quality in our products while fostering a culture of continuous improvement. We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Social Media / Production Coordinator | Own Distribution and Keep Production Moving
jobs.description:
Advocate Media Company is the media and marketing engine behind its client, Sina Rez Law, a consumer protection law firm with a founder who is also a car guy and the on\-camera talent for everything we make.

We publish short\-form content daily across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and we're building an in\-house content team around it: a lead videographer, a creative director, and you.

This is a two\-sided role. Half of it is distribution: everything we produce gets posted, packaged, and worked across every platform, on schedule, every day. The other half is production: on shoot days, you're the videographer's right hand, and the set runs on your logistics.

Distribution: what you'll own

* Publishing: the daily posting calendar across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Captions, hashtags, cover frames, scheduling. You keep the calendar moving and make sure everything goes out clean, accurate, and on time.
* Community: comments and DMs, every day. You know which comments to answer, which to pin, which to flag as content ideas, and which need to be escalated.
* Repurposing logistics: one video becomes multiple assets across platforms. You run that pipeline between our videographer and editors.
* The numbers: a simple weekly performance report covering what worked, what didn't, and what the team should test next.

Production: what you'll own

* Shoot\-day logistics: scheduling, locations, props, releases, and prep, including loading the teleprompter before the talent walks in.
* Set support: setup and teardown alongside the videographer, gear organized and accounted for, and the day kept on schedule.
* Media management: footage is backed up, labeled consistently, organized, and handed off to editors the same day it's shot.
* Behind\-the\-scenes capture when the moment's worth it.

Who this is for

* You spend enough time online to understand why certain videos take off, what makes a hook work, and how content behaves differently across platforms.
* You understand what tends to work on each platform and pay attention when those patterns change.
* You're ruthlessly organized. Calendars, checklists, and pipelines are how you think, and you're equally happy on a set or behind a spreadsheet in the same day.
* You like fast\-moving environments where there's always something to publish, prep, organize, or improve.
* Early career is fine. Hunger and consistency beat years of experience for this seat.
* Cars are a plus, not a requirement.

Comp and growth

$55,000–$65,000 depending on experience.

This is a full\-time, in\-person role in Woodland Hills on a content team with a real budget behind it. A Creative Director is being recruited to help lead the team as it grows.

You'll be in the room while a brand's content operation gets built, not maintaining one that's already finished. From this seat, you can grow into producer, social lead, or post\-production paths depending on where you shine.

To apply

Send:

* Links to any accounts you've run. Personal accounts count.
* Three accounts you think handle distribution exceptionally well.
* One sentence on why each one works.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Please provide links to any social media accounts you have managed or contributed to. Personal accounts are acceptable.
* A short\-form video gets strong views but very few comments, shares, or saves. What would you look at first, and what would you test next?
* ou have six videos that need to be published across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube today, while also preparing for tomorrow’s shoot. How would you organize and prioritize the work?
* Name one brand or creator you think distributes short\-form content exceptionally well. What specifically do they do that you would want to apply here?

Ability to Commute:

* Woodland Hills, CA 91367 (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

**Regional Account Manager**

  

  

At Brink's, we don't just deliver secure logistics \- we deliver peace of mind. You will play a critical role in deepening the relationships that fuel our business. You'll work closely with a portfolio of valued clients, becoming a trusted advisor who understands their unique needs and helps them unlock the full potential of Brink's integrated cash management and security solutions.

**Qualifications for the role:**

**Inside Sales Support Specialist**


West Coast Based \| Reports to Head of Sales \| Regional Scope


Build. Lead. Transform.

Quickparts is hiring an **Inside Sales Support Speci****alist** to own the RFQ\-to\-order sales cycle for a portfolio of small\-to\-mid\-sized accounts and to support day\-to\-day activity on Key Accounts. Reporting to the Head of Sales, with daily direction and prioritization from the Regional Sales Director, you will drive pipeline velocity through disciplined follow\-up, convert quotes to orders, and grow wallet share within our existing customer base across CNC machining, injection molding, additive manufacturing, and sheet metal fabrication programs.

✔ Own the RFQ\-to\-order sales cycle for assigned accounts


✔ Drive quote\-to\-order conversion and re\-order growth


✔ Grow wallet share within the existing customer base


✔ Support Key Account initiatives and strategic planning


✔ Maintain disciplined CRM management and forecasting

* Partner with Program Management to deliver accurate, on\-time quotes for new and repeat business
* Monitor quote aging and lead times; flag stalled opportunities and drive actions to improve close rates
* Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting in the CRM


Customer Growth \& Relationship Management

* Proactively reach out on upcoming projects, forecasted demand, and re\-order opportunities

* Re\-engage dormant accounts to win back lapsed business


Strategic Account Support

* Partner with the Director of Sales on Key Account initiatives, account reviews, and growth planning
* Surface customer insights, market intelligence, and competitive activity to inform account strategy


CRM \& Process Discipline

* Keep customer interactions, quotes, and pipeline data current and accurate in the CRM (HubSpot)
* Use CRM data to prioritize opportunities and sharpen sales effectiveness
* Act as a proactive problem\-solver for customers and internal stakeholders — Program Management, Engineering, and Operations — resolving issues with urgency and clear communication

 **What We're Looking For**

* 3\+ years in Inside Sales, Account Management, or Business Development
* Proven track record managing a sales pipeline and driving quote\-to\-order conversion in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Strong customer relationship, communication, and organizational skills
* Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office
* Self\-motivated, highly organized, and results oriented


Preferred

* Experience in contract manufacturing — CNC machining, injection molding, additive manufacturing, sheet metal fabrication, or industrial services
* Familiarity with HubSpot, RFQ management, and processes in a manufacturing environment

 **Key Performance Indicators**

* Quote\-to\-Order Conversion Rate
* Pipeline Growth \& Progression
* Revenue Growth Within Assigned Accounts
* Wallet Share Expansion
* Customer Retention \& Reactivation
* Re\-Order Revenue Growth
* Quote Turnaround Time
* CRM Compliance \& Data Accuracy

 **Why You'll Love It Here**

* Direct collaboration with Sales leadership
* Real ownership — your work drives revenue growth
* High\-growth, dynamic organization
* Fast\-paced, high\-volume environment
* Strong culture of accountability and collaboration
* Flexible work environment
* Competitive compensation
* 401K Employer match
* Excellent health and wellness benefits
* Generous Paid Time Off \- Recharge with ample PTO, including vacation days, sick leave, and holidays

 **Celebrate Your Strengths!**

This brief assessment highlights your unique strengths and how they align with our role requirements—providing valuable insights to spark great conversations about your fit, growth, and development here at Quickparts. **Quickparts Assessment Link**

Quickparts is a global leader in on\-demand manufacturing with over 25 years of experience. We deliver advanced manufacturing solutions including metal \& plastic 3D printing, CNC machining, injection molding, and casting patterns.


With facilities across the US and Europe and more than 4,000 customers worldwide, we serve industries including aerospace, defense, automotive, medical, energy, and industrial equipment.

jobs.title: Sales Representative-Retail Accounts
jobs.description:
Peter Pan Novelty Company, Inc. (PPNC) is looking for a motivated, energetic, and sales\-driven **Retail Sales Specialist** to help grow our retail business.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building customer relationships, developing new business, identifying product opportunities, and working directly with retail buyers.

You will work with both existing and prospective retail customers across grocery, value, specialty, convenience, drug, and other retail channels. From identifying an opportunity and presenting products to securing purchase orders and supporting the account afterward, you will play an important role in growing PPNC's retail business.

What You'll Do

**Grow Retail Sales**

* Manage and develop assigned retail accounts.
* Build strong relationships with buyers, assistant buyers, planners, and other customer contacts.
* Identify opportunities for new products, seasonal programs, reorders, additional categories, and expanded distribution.
* Present available inventory, new products, and relevant programs to customers.
* Work toward measurable account growth and sales results.

**Develop New Business**

* Prospect and develop new retail customers.
* Research prospective retailers and identify appropriate buyer contacts.
* Conduct outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, trade shows, referrals, and other sales channels.
* Secure buyer meetings and present PPNC products and capabilities.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and sales opportunities.

**Present Products \& Ideas**

* Prepare for buyer meetings, line reviews, product presentations, and customer visits.
* Create and coordinate presentations, line sheets, pricing sheets, assortment proposals, and samples.
* Follow up consistently after presentations and sample deliveries.
* Help move opportunities from initial conversation through purchase order.

**Identify Product \& Retail Trends**

* Stay current on trends in toys, play balls, novelty, impulse, collectibles, sensory products, squish, and seasonal merchandise.
* Research retailers, competitors, social media, marketplaces, and consumer trends.
* Identify products, themes, colors, packaging concepts, price points, and assortment opportunities that may appeal to retail customers.
* Share market insights with the sales and design teams.

**Support Customer\-Specific Product Development**

* Work with PPNC's design and product teams to develop programs for individual retailers.
* Communicate buyer feedback and customer requirements to internal teams.
* Help guide product selection, target retail pricing, packaging, themes, colors, and assortments.
* Coordinate revisions and follow\-up based on customer feedback.

**Own the Customer Follow\-Through**

* Stay informed and involved after a purchase order is received.
* Review purchase orders for basic accuracy, including products, quantities, pricing, ship dates, cancel dates, and customer requirements.
* Track important customer deadlines and communicate internally with operations, logistics, production, design, and management.
* Identify potential issues early and help coordinate solutions before they impact the customer.
* Maintain accurate account, opportunity, and project information in Monday.com and other company systems.

What We're Looking For

* 1–3\+ years of experience in sales, business development, account support, retail, consumer products, toys, gifts, novelty, or a related field preferred.
* Retail buyer or consumer\-product experience is a plus.
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable prospecting and developing new business.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with pricing and customer requirements.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and similar business tools.
* Experience with Monday.com, CRM platforms, or project\-management systems is a plus.
* Interest in retail products, consumer trends, toys, and emerging product opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means growing assigned accounts, developing new retail customers, building strong buyer relationships, converting presentations into purchase orders, identifying new product opportunities, and consistently following through on customer commitments.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for opportunities—someone who actively looks for the next customer, product, program, reorder, or sales opportunity.

Compensation

**Starting Base Salary: $73,000–$83,000 per year**

Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, retail sales background, and demonstrated ability to develop and grow customer accounts.

**About PPNC**

PPNC is a consumer\-products company specializing in toys, play balls, squish products, novelty items, and other fun and trend\-driven merchandise sold through retail channels.

This is an opportunity to join a hands\-on team where sales works closely with product development, design, operations, logistics, and leadership to bring products from concept to retail shelves.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Regional Revenue Operations Manager** 

Long Beach, CA – Onsite

Sierra Pacific Engineering and Products (SPEP) designs, manufactures, and proudly distributes high quality, cost\-effective industrial hardware components B2B. As an ISO\-certified industrial hardware company, our vision is to bring growth and stability to our customers through sustainable methods of engineering, service, and value.

**Employee\-Powered, Employee\-Owned \-** Our employees make SPEP all that it is. This belief is reinforced with the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) providing employees with 100% ownership in the business and the opportunity to benefit from the company’s success.

**Position Summary**

The Regional Revenue Operations Manager is a full\-time position responsible for supporting the company’s effectiveness by developing, analyzing, and governing regional revenue strategies, pricing standards, account segmentation, and market approaches. This role partners with internal departments to shape policies, tools, and initiatives that drive sustainable revenue growth.

The role exercises independent judgment in evaluating customer requirements, structuring proposals/quotes, and aligning internal resources to manage and/or support business goals.

The Regional Revenue Operations Manager serves as a critical link between Outside Sales Representatives, Supply Chain, Finance, and Operations ensuring timely and accurate communication and project management.

**Responsibilities**

**Sales Strategy \& Governance**

* Develops and maintains regional sales strategies, account segmentation frameworks, and go\-to\-market models.
* Recommends and enforces pricing standards, discount thresholds, and deal\-review standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain, and Sales leadership.
* Evaluates sales enablement tools and recommends structural improvements.
* Evaluates and prioritizes inbound leads based on strategic criteria and business impact. Conducts discovery with prospects to assess fit and recommend solutions.
* Completes timely communication to ensure new lead engagement and dormant lead re\-engagement with the associated Outside Sales Representatives.

**Business Operations \& Analysis**

* Analyzes market trends, customer trends, and competitive positioning to inform decision\-making.
* Prepares reports, forecasts, and recommendations regarding sales performance and risk.
* Assesses the financial and operational impact of proposed initiatives.

**Policy, Process \& Enablement**

* Collaborates with the Outside Sales team to create and execute account strategies. Provides consultative input on technical solutions, market positioning, and customer engagement approaches to accelerate growth in key accounts.
* Analyzes customer data, market trends and competitor activity to provide insights for leadership.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Leads cross\-functional initiatives involving Sales, Finance, Engineering, and Supply Chain.
* Initiates independent recommendations on prioritization of markets, products, and customer segments in partnership with sales leadership.
* Escalates and resolves complex business issues with material, financial or operational impact.

* Serves as internal advisor providing cross\-functional recommendations for revenue initiatives.

**Quote Management**

* Governs quoting and pricing standards.

* Provides regular communication regarding status updates and action items.
* Initiates recommendations on new product opportunities, pricing strategies, or process improvements.

* BA or BS Degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related degree, and a minimum of 3 years of proven experience in sales operations, business analytics, pricing strategies, or commercial operations (B2B preferred). In lieu of a degree, 6 years of related experience is required.
* Proven ability to analyze customer needs, exercise discretion in recommending tailored solutions.
* Discretion and exceptional independent judgment evaluating financial and operational risk.
* Experience developing account strategies and managing initiatives focused on revenue growth.
* Strong business writing and verbal communication skills.
* Positive and enthusiastic attitude with an eagerness to learn and grow.

· Experience with CRM and ERP systems.

* Ability to handle repetitive hand/wrist motions such as typing, using a computer mouse, phone and writing utensils.

jobs.description:
Creating a world where pets live longer, healthier lives, from their very first meal.
 ### **Learn more about our brands.**

**We're Looking For A(n):** Executive Assistant


**Location:** Onsite (Burbank/North Hollywood, CA)


**What You'll Be Doing:** The Executive Assistant will serve as the executive's right hand, increasing their effective capacity by organizing time, attention, commitments, information, and the working environment around the highest\-value priorities. This role will provide traditional executive support across calendar management, scheduling, travel, meeting preparation, coordination, and follow\-through, while also taking broad ownership of the day\-to\-day operation of a new office and studio.  

  

This is a highly proactive, ownership\-oriented role responsible for creating structure where it does not yet exist, building repeatable processes, coordinating people and projects through changing information, and continuously reducing operational friction. The role will also leverage technology, AI, and automation to make work faster, more reliable, and less dependent on manual effort or individual memory.  

  

The scope of the role will evolve over time. The expectation is that the Executive Assistant will anticipate needs, exercise independent judgment, identify and resolve issues, and build systems that allow the executive and broader operation to function more effectively with less direct intervention.


* Manage the executive's calendar, priorities, scheduling, travel, and logistics.
* Prepare for meetings and ensure decisions, commitments, and open items are tracked through completion.
* Coordinate internal and external communications, meetings, people, and projects on behalf of the executive.
* Manage day\-to\-day office and studio operations, ensuring the environment is organized, functional, and ready to support ongoing business activities.
* Support the development and buildout of the new office and studio, including vendors, timelines, logistics, technology, physical\-space needs, and other operational requirements.
* Select, coordinate, and manage vendors and external partners as needed.
* Oversee office supplies, equipment, technology, and recurring operational needs.
* Coordinate guest, meeting, and other office/studio logistics.
* Build and maintain workflows, checklists, documentation, and operating processes where needed.
* Identify recurring operational friction and address the underlying process rather than repeatedly solving the same issue.
* Maintain systems for information, documents, contacts, decisions, and follow\-up.


Use AI, automation, and other technology to simplify repetitive, information\-heavy, or rules\-based work.  

* Ensure decisions are translated into action and that actions are completed.
* Identify what requires executive attention versus what can be handled independently, escalating appropriately when needed.
* Take on additional responsibilities as the needs of the executive, office, and studio evolve.


**Qualifications (Note: We strongly encourage you to apply even if you don't tick ALL of these boxes.):**


* Exceptional organization, attention to detail, and follow\-through.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
* Strong ownership mentality with a proactive, solutions\-oriented approach.
* Highly anticipatory; able to think downstream and identify needs, dependencies, risks, and follow\-up before they become urgent.
* Process\-oriented with a continuous\-improvement mindset; able to identify inefficient or overly manual processes and build better ways of working.
* Strong independent judgment and ability to determine when issues can be handled independently versus escalated.
* High processing speed and ability to synthesize fragmented information from multiple sources into clear priorities, decisions, and actions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and adapt quickly as needs and circumstances change.
* Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across people, teams, vendors, and external partners.
* Comfortable providing and receiving direct feedback, challenging priorities when appropriate, and surfacing contradictions or issues.
* Strong discretion and judgment when handling sensitive business and personal information.
* Service\-oriented, practical, and persistent, without being passive or overly dependent on direction.
* Comfortable experimenting with modern technology, AI tools, automation, and custom workflows to improve efficiency and reliability.
* Ambitious and curious, with an interest in learning how the broader business operates and taking on increasing responsibility over time.



Required Experience:2\+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant or a related role


**Golden Perks \& Benefits:**
* Comprehensive healthcare coverage – We cover **100% of premiums** for medical, dental, and vision plans for employee\-only plans.
* Annual bonus
* We match up to **3\.5% of your 401k contributions**, ensuring your retirement savings grow alongside your career.
* **6 paid sick and mental health days,** an Employee Assistance Program, free weekly yoga and meditation classes, and additional mental health benefits, because we take a holistic approach to your well\-being.

* **Professional development** **opportunities** with mentorship, continuous learning programs, and performance\-based pay increases, empowering you to progress and excel in your career.

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Outreach Coordinator (Part\-Time, 20 Hours/Week, Afternoons \& Evenings)** 

Partners4Wellness (P4W) seeks a compassionate and motivated **Outreach Coordinator** to facilitate life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth involved in the juvenile justice system. This entry\-level position is ideal for recent graduates who are passionate about supporting under\-served youth through mentorship, skill\-building, and community engagement.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

Life Skills and Resiliency Workshops

* Facilitate interactive, evidence\-based life\-skills and resiliency workshops for youth and transitional\-age youth (TAY) ages 16\-25 in Juvenile Hall, the Youth Guidance Center, the Youth Leadership Academy, and other youth\-serving organizations.
* Create a welcoming, respectful, strength\-based, and trauma\-informed group environment.
* Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to participants, helping them develop coping strategies, problem\-solving skills, and goal\-setting techniques.
* Build positive, professional relationships with participants while maintaining appropriate boundaries and modeling effective communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Connect youth to community resources and support services that promote successful reentry.

Curriculum Support

* Maintain and update curriculum materials, participant workbooks, and community resource guides to ensure relevance and alignment with youth needs and best practices.
* Support the enhancement and occasional development of new curriculum content, workshop activities, and resource materials based on program needs.
* Stay updated on trends in youth development, trauma\-informed care, and community resources.

Community Engagement and Collaboration

* Establish rapport and maintain positive relationships with Probation staff, site coordinators, and other programming partners.
* Represent P4W at community and stakeholder meetings to promote life\-skills education for justice\-involved youth.
* Present at conferences on promoting youth mental wellness and resilience.
* Represent P4W at community outreach and tabling events to increase awareness of programs and services.

Program Reporting \& Support

* Track attendance and participation for each session, ensuring timely and accurate data entry.
* Collect youth feedback and support basic program evaluation efforts.
* Share success stories, challenges, and program updates with the Program Manager.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in Criminal Justice, Social Work, Psychology, Sociology, Public Health, Education, or a related field required.

**Experience \& Skills**

* Prior experience working or volunteering with at\-risk youth preferred but not required.
* Strong public speaking and group facilitation skills.
* Experience with basic data collection, tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Canva.
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred.

**Additional Requirements** 

* Work schedule consists primarily of afternoon and evening hours based on program and site needs.
* Following hire, employees will be required to successfully complete a background investigation conducted by the Probation Department to obtain and maintain access to assigned program sites.
* Valid driver's license, reliable transportation, proof of automobile insurance, and documentation establishing identity and employment authorization are required.
* Regular travel to juvenile justice sites required; occasional travel to community locations, conferences, and outreach events as needed.
* Mileage reimbursement provided for approved work\-related travel.

**Compensation: $24\-$25 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.**

jobs.description:
Overview:

Founded in 1965, **UC Irvine** is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News \& World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second\-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.  

  

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.
The UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR) is driven to improve health and wellness of people in Orange County and the world by providing life\-saving clinical trials designed to strengthen and accelerate the pathway of discovery from the medical laboratory to the clinic.  


Responsibilities:

Independently or under the supervision of the Clinical Research Supervisor, Clinical Research Manager, and the Assistant Director of Clinical Research Operations, the incumbent leads the day\-to\-day execution of assigned clinical trials in the UCI Center for Clinical Research (CCR). Serving as primary coordinator on trials of varying complexity, the incumbent is accountable for accurate execution, documentation, and communication for comprehensive coordination and data management of complex phase I – IV clinical research protocols from initiation through close\-out of research projects with human subjects. The incumbent operates in an interdisciplinary model across multiple therapeutic areas. This position facilitates all implementation phases of new clinical research studies as well as the ongoing coordination and maintenance of open and closed studies. Incumbent will conduct interviews with study patients in the clinic, screen participants, facilitate patient care, and collect data in compliance with established study protocols. The incumbent will receive appropriate onboarding and training to ensure proper preparation for this role as well as ongoing training where appropriate.
  

  

Develop and establish process for review and oversight of clinical trials conducted by investigators and ensure study protocols are followed, appropriate documentation is kept, and accurate data is collected according to Good Clinical Practice (GCP)/ International Conference on Harmonization (ICH) guidelines, internal standard operating procedures (SOPs), FDA regulations, and University policies and procedures. This position plays a key role in assisting the Principal Investigator (PI) in recruiting patients for clinical studies and meeting enrollment and retention goals.
  

  

Complete timely and accurate collection and coordination of data submission to study sponsors ensuring quality control and leading to timely milestone payments. This includes responsibility for the compilation and transcription of research patient data and study\-related information into case report forms (CRFs) into sponsor specific electronic data capture systems (EDC). S/he will work with the clinical research team to manage and collect accurate data and assist Principal Investigators and study coordinators for all data management aspects of non\-cancer related trials.
  

  

The incumbent is also responsible for maintaining communication with all elements of a multi\-level research network, interacting with sponsoring agencies and compliance and regulatory groups such as the Institutional Review Board (IRB), Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and sponsor monitors. This individual will interact with subjects, clinic and research staff, laboratory staff, radiology staff and any other medical professionals associated with our clinical research protocols. In addition, this individual must maintain clinical trial information in the clinical trial management system (OnCore) and adhere to institutional policies.
  

  

The main CCR offices and clinics are located at the UCI Medical Center in Orange and the UCI campus in Irvine, as well as various clinics at community sites throughout Orange County. The incumbent will be required to work at both main locations in Orange and Irvine, and sometimes community sites depending on responsibilities and scheduling demands.

* Proven ability to research, properly evaluate information, and prepare clear, concise and well\-organized reports, summaries, and correspondence; ability to think critically, compile data from various sources, analyze and synthesize data/information and present it to others in a clear and concise way
* Proven organizational skills and attention to detail; ability to multi\-task, prioritize a complex and dynamic workload, meet rigid deadlines despite interruptions, frequent workload changes and competing demands, and achieve high productivity/quality within short time frames; skill in working independently, taking initiative and following through on assignments and ability to work as part of a team

At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors

* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

jobs.title: Resolution Account Manager
jobs.description:
WHY JOIN TAXRISE?  


At TaxRise, we don't just provide tax relief services; we provide hope, stability, and solutions to individuals and families facing financial uncertainty. Our team is passionate about reshaping the tax resolution industry through innovation, empathy, and unwavering commitment to our clients.  


Join us and make a tangible difference in people's lives while growing your career with a team that values your contributions.  


ABOUT THE ROLE  


The Case Manager III works directly alongside our Enrolled Agents to help move complex and time\-sensitive tax resolution cases toward successful outcomes.  


While our Enrolled Agents focus on developing resolution strategies and negotiating with the IRS and state taxing authorities, the Resolution Account Manager provides critical case support by communicating with clients, obtaining urgent or additional documentation, coordinating next steps, and ensuring the Enrolled Agents have everything needed to effectively advocate for the client.  


This role will frequently support cases requiring additional attention or urgency, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners. You'll assist with these cases by communicating with the appropriate IRS contacts, tracking requests and deadlines, coordinating required documentation, and keeping the Enrolled Agent informed of important case developments.  


You'll serve as an important connection between the client, the Enrolled Agent, and taxing authorities, helping translate case needs into clear action items and keeping cases moving when timing matters most.  


We're all about that in\-person vibe, so this role is 100% on\-site! If you're excited to work side\-by\-side with our team (or are ready to make the move), then you're a perfect fit. If not, we kindly ask you to hold off on applying. Thanks for understanding and happy job hunting!  


HOW YOU'LL BE REWARDED  


At Tax Rise, Inc., we recognize and reward high performance, ownership, and results.  


Base pay: $24\.00 \- 25\.00 per hour  
Monthly Bonus: Average bonus potential of $1,000 \- $1,500  


Full\-time \| 40 hours per week. Occasional overtime may be required based on business needs.  


WHAT YOU'LL DO  


Enrolled Agents \& Case Support:  


Partner directly with assigned Enrolled Agents to support active tax resolution cases.  
Review case needs and prioritize client outreach based on deadlines, urgency, and direction from the Enrolled Agent.  
Assist with managing priority and time\-sensitive cases, including matters involving Revenue Officers and Offer in Compromise (OIC) Examiners.  
Communicate directly with Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners, as appropriate, to provide requested documentation, obtain case updates, clarify outstanding requirements, and coordinate next steps on behalf of the Enrolled Agent.  
Track IRS requests, deadlines, and follow\-up items to ensure required documentation and information are submitted timely and cases continue moving forward.  
Relay important updates, requests, and deadlines from Revenue Officers and OIC Examiners to the assigned Enrolled Agent and coordinate any necessary client follow\-up.  
Maintain clear documentation of IRS communications and escalate case developments requiring the Enrolled Agent's review, strategy, or negotiation.  


Client Communication:  


Serve as a consistent point of contact for assigned case\-related action items.  
Contact clients by phone, email, or approved communication channels to obtain additional financial and tax documentation requested by the Enrolled Agent, IRS, or state taxing authority.  
Clearly explain what is needed, why it is needed, and applicable deadlines.  
Review incoming documentation and promptly follow up on missing or incomplete information.  


CRM Management \& Case Tracking:  


Maintain detailed and accurate CRM notes documenting client conversations, outstanding items, Enrolled Agent requests, deadlines, and case progress.
