jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Division of HIV
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) is an internationally recognized global leader in HIV clinical care, research and education and has grown to encompass a network of specialty clinics, multiple research and clinical trials, an HIV education program, an international research program in East Africa and a vibrant community forum for clinicians and researchers. Housed within the division is the SCOPE (Study on Consequences of Protease Inhibitors Era) and LIINC (Long\-term Impact of Infection with the Novel Coronavirus) Research Programs that focuses on clinical and translational research.  



The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will work at an independent level to assist the Principal Investigators, project directors, and Senior Clinical Research Coordinators with implementing study protocols, study coordination, data/specimen collection, data management, and quality assurance. The incumbent will recruit, screen, enroll, and follow study participants, and interact with health care providers, clinical researchers, collaborators, funders, and varied administrative and professional staff for a new project known as the PASC\-RECOVER (Post\-Acute Sequelae of SARS\-CoV\-2 Infection \- Researching COVID to Enhance Recovery) Project.  



**ABOUT DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE**

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home\-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983\. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 38 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Knowledgeable in phlebotomy issues, including working knowledge of tubes and procedures required for blood draw of clinical laboratory tests, and sample processing for T\-cell assays, flow cytometry, and other research assays; basic laboratory techniques (safe handling practices, preparing and labeling samples and reagents for studies, proper use, storage, and disposal of reagents)
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* Two years experience in clinical, community health setting and/or research setting
* California Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT) certification
* Conversational Spanish language skills with medical terminology
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.).
* Thorough knowledge of antiretroviral medications. Familiarity with treatments for HIV\-related infections and medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for handling diagnostic specimens including packing/shipping infectious substances
* Certified Safe Shipper \- IATA certification
* Database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Experience with translational research trials, statistics and/or data management; knowledge of clinical research practices and longitudinal cohort studies
* Experience working with culturally and linguistically diverse groups
* Comfortable interviewing subjects on sensitive issues including high risk sexual practices and illegal drug use
* Knowledgeable in phlebotomy issues, including working knowledge of tubes and procedures required for blood draw of clinical laboratory tests, and sample processing for T\-cell assays, flow cytometry, and other research assays; basic laboratory techniques (safe handling practices, preparing and labeling samples and reagents for studies, proper use, storage, and disposal of reagents)
* Demonstrate excellent attendance and reliability. Work during some evening hours and/or early morning hours required
* Advertising/publishing experience a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs with emphasis on Excel, Access, Word, Savvy internet user
* Able to carry boxes and supplies weighing up to 20\-30 pounds, pack specimens into shipping containers, and deliver specimens to lab in a timely manner. Able to file heavy charts (up to 5 lbs.) in file cabinets

jobs.title: CLIENT EXPERIENCE & APPOINTMENT COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
Mason Lane started Fast Lane European in 2011 after years working as a technician inside dealerships. He'd seen what European car owners deserved and too often didn't get, so he built something better — the same expertise and diagnostic capability, without the dealership experience. Audi, BMW, Mercedes\-Benz, Volvo, MINI, and more. European car owners deserve better, and that's the whole reason this shop exists.

Everything here comes down to three things: Quality, Value, and Trust. Quality means the repair is done right. Value means the customer feels the price was fair. Trust is what brings them back and gets them telling their friends — and trust doesn't start with the technician. It starts with whoever answers the phone.

That's this job. You'll be the first voice and face our customers meet, and you'll own that experience from the first phone call through the moment they walk in the door. This is more than answering phones and booking appointments. You'll ask the right questions to understand what a caller actually needs, know when to offer our Free Second Opinion review for someone who's already been quoted elsewhere, and get the right appointments on the calendar — then take ownership of the whole front\-of\-house experience once they arrive.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Answer incoming calls and ask good questions to understand what the customer actually needs before scheduling — including offering our Free Second Opinion review to callers who've already been quoted by another shop.

Schedule and confirm appointments accurately in our shop management system.

Greet every customer warmly and make them feel taken care of from the moment they walk in.

Own the client experience in our lobby and reception area — ambiance, cleanliness, and hospitality touches like water, coffee, or tea, plus any seasonal touches or promotional displays up front.

Support our Service Consultants with data entry, customer profile updates, and follow\-up calls. (Vehicle\-specific conversations — diagnosis, recommendations, pricing — stay with the Service Consultants; your focus is the experience around it.)

Handle day\-to\-day office tasks — incoming and outgoing mail, office supplies, filing repair orders.

Help cash out customers at pickup and close out repairs in our system.

Keep our loaner vehicles gassed up, clean, and ready to go, and handle loaner agreements with customers.

Send out our text and email marketing campaigns to our customer base.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

At least a year of experience in a receptionist, customer service, or administrative role.

A professional, friendly, and welcoming manner on the phone and in person — comfortable asking a few good questions to understand what a caller needs.

Strong organization skills — you can juggle a busy front desk without dropping the ball.

Comfortable with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools.

Reliable, punctual, and detail\-oriented.

An eye for the small things that make a space feel welcoming.

**NICE TO HAVE**

Experience in an automotive, service, or trades environment.

Familiarity with shop management or scheduling software.

Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**SCHEDULE**

Full\-time, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. On\-site.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Decagon**


Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.


Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.


We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.


We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We’re looking for a field marketing manager to continue to build out our field marketing function across conferences, events, and executive dinners to drive awareness and pipeline generation. You will help shape the strategy and execution from the field marketing program. The ideal candidate has experience running field events at a fast growing B2B SaaS startup.

**In this role, you will**

* Partner closely with our GTM leadership team to execute on the right portfolio of events to accelerate demand generation pipelines
* Execute on our event strategy ensuring we’re getting in front of the right audience, generating leads, and reaching out to leads in a timely manner
* Extend the Decagon brand across different event formats including conferences, executive dinners, webinars, product launch events, and more
* Define and measure field marketing success through key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ROI, lead generation, pipeline influence, and sales engagement.
* Own the outcome of the leads generated and driving high ROI of our events

**Your background looks something like this**

* 3\-5 years of experience planning and executing and hosting sponsored events
* 1\-2\+ years of field marketing experience with a B2B SaaS / enterprise software startup
* Excellent attention to detail and operational rigor
* The ability to span events across tradeshows, webinar/virtual, and customer dinners
* The ability to span events across awareness (building awareness of Decagon’s brand and getting in front of new leads) and demand generation (driving demos booked)
* Experience and affinity for evolving projects and experiments into repeatable programs
* Outstanding project management skills, the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, working relationships, cross\-functional partners, and vendors while driving timelines and owning the outcome
* Familiarity with sales processes and systems
* The ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 40%

**Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

Advantage Surgical and Wound Care heals wounds and treats surgical conditions in the post\-acute environment through conservative, evidence\-based care. We limit unnecessary and expensive treatments, emergency room visits, and hospitalizations. We achieve optimal outcomes by coordination, collaboration, and education with patients, their caregivers, and other healthcare professionals.


Our skilled medical providers perform rounds in Skilled Nursing Facilities. The Regional Manager will be responsible for territory growth, sales expansion, customer satisfaction, and account retention in their assigned territory. They will play a key role in driving revenue through upselling services, identifying new business opportunities, and maintaining strong client relationships. This position reports to the Senior Director of Business Development and works closely with the Regional Sales Manager to ensure strategic business growth.

**Responsibilities:**

* Sales \& Revenue Growth:
	+ Drive organic growth and upsell additional services (podiatry, dental, G\-tube, etc.) within existing accounts.
	+ Conduct quarterly business reviews to identify service expansion opportunities and improve service utilization.
	+ Identify underutilized accounts and implement strategies to increase patient encounters.
	+ Leverage facility relationships to generate new leads and business opportunities for the sales team.
	+ Communicate growth potential, competitive insights, and sales trends to the Regional Sales Manager and Business Development team.
	+ Maintain detailed records in Salesforce to track sales opportunities and personnel changes.
* Account Management \& Retention:
	+ Develop and manage strong relationships with key facility leaders, PCPs, and Medical Directors.
	+ Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by addressing concerns, providing education, and maximizing efficiencies.
	+ Conduct quarterly facility visits and provider rounds to ensure smooth operations and service delivery.
	+ Implement account retention strategies, identifying and resolving potential churn risks proactively.
	+ Collaborate with facility teams to optimize provider efficiency (e.g., ensuring residents are prepared for rounds, consent forms signed, etc.).
* Sales \& Marketing Support:
	+ Work closely with the Regional Sales Manager to align territory growth strategies.
	+ Identify and communicate growth opportunities to sales teams based on facility needs and market trends.
	+ Assist in new account rollouts, ensuring a seamless onboarding process for both providers and facilities.

What You Will Do
  
As an Inside Sales Representative, you will play a key role in driving business growth by identifying new opportunities within our existing client base and uncovering new clients. You will focus on customer acquisition through outbound calling, business referrals, and web leads. Working closely with partners and the sales team, you will introduce new and existing products, foster strong relationships, and support revenue goals.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated sales professional to advance their career in the fast\-paced world of Video Technology while being part of an exceptional, collaborative team.
  
Responsibilities
  
* Cultivate, nurture, and strengthen relationships with partners and clients.
* Engage in proactive outreach to identify and develop new business opportunities.
* Understand customer needs and consultatively offer product solutions and services.
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
* Introduce and position new and existing products within a designated territory.
* Record all daily activities accurately within CRM systems, including Zoho and NetSuite.
* Research leads using web searches, business directories, digital resources, and referrals.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create strategic approaches and deliver qualified opportunities.
* Track performance metrics to ensure consistent progress toward goals.
* Direct customers to appropriate resellers for demonstrations and events.
* Handle inbound prospect calls and convert them into business opportunities.
* Maintain a deep understanding of products, industry trends, and the competitive landscape.
* Uphold and communicate brand identity and corporate positioning.


What We Are Looking For
  
We are seeking a passionate, energetic sales professional who excels at building meaningful relationships and thrives in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate is motivated by the art of selling, enjoys connecting with customers, and is driven to exceed targets. You should have a proven track record of sales success, strong communication skills, and a desire to be part of a team that values collaboration, growth, and innovation.
  
Qualifications
  
* Must be based in the Pacific or Mountain Time Zone, with West Coast candidates preferred.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and connecting with new people daily.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build lasting relationships.
* Persuasive, goal\-oriented, and self\-motivated with a positive attitude.
* Previous experience in inside sales, outbound call centers, Sales Development Representative roles, or related positions preferred.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of the video, Pro AV, or digital media industries is a strong asset.
* Proficiency with CRM systems such as Salesforce and NetSuite, as well as Microsoft Office applications including Word, Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, or a related field is an asset.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Familiarity with digital media management, IP/streaming, digital projection, or connectivity solutions is an advantage.
* Demonstrated resilience when facing rejection and the ability to remain enthusiastic and professional.
* Ability to travel occasionally for sales events or trade shows.


Why Join Us
  
  

Ready to join our team? Here’s why …
  
  

* Comprehensive group benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Critical Illness, Short\- and Long\-Term Disability
* Wellness Incentive Program and Employee Assistance Program
* RRSP / 401(k) matching program
* Work\-life balance matters: Flextime, summer hours, paid vacation, and personal time off
* A casual, fun, and collaborative work environment
* Lively social calendar—there’s always something for everyone
* Generous employee discounts on our products
* Ongoing learning and development opportunities
* The chance to work alongside a highly talented, high\-performing team


Workplace Commitments
  
  

We are committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. All employees are expected to follow workplace safety protocols, including compliance with local regulations and internal standards, to ensure the well\-being of everyone.
  
  

We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where individuals feel respected, supported, and able to contribute fully. We recognize that different perspectives and experiences strengthen our teams and drive better outcomes for our employees and customers.

jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Palo Alto
jobs.description:
**MISSION**



Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
* Identify recurring customer, access, and patient\-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Field Insights**


* Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services,

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

* Own commercial strategy across a portfolio of approximately 75–130 SMB and/or Mid\-Market customers, with accountability for GRR, NRR, renewals, and expansion performance
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify customer priorities, business outcomes, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and paths to long\-term growth
* Proactively manage the renewal lifecycle from early strategy and stakeholder alignment through negotiation and close
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, packaging, contract terms, multi\-year agreements, and complex renewal scenarios
* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities across additional licenses, products, and multi\-product offerings to increase NRR
* Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, decision\-makers, and executive stakeholders to reduce churn risk and unlock growth
* Partner closely with Customer Success to connect product adoption and demonstrated customer value to renewal and expansion strategies
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on business priorities, ROI, future needs, and opportunities to expand the partnership
* Proactively identify accounts at risk and develop clear retention and mitigation strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders
* Navigate complex customer situations—including competitive evaluations, budget pressure, organizational changes, product concerns, and procurement—with sound commercial judgment and customer empathy
* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions
* Surface customer insights and trends to Product, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to help improve our product and go\-to\-market strategy
* Contribute to the continued evolution of Account Management by sharing best practices and identifying opportunities to improve processes, playbooks, segmentation, automation, and operating rhythms

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, or another customer\-facing B2B SaaS role
* 1\+ years owning commercial outcomes such as renewals, expansion, upsell, cross\-sell, or revenue retention
* Track record managing and growing a portfolio of B2B SaaS customers and associated ARR
* Proven ability to lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through negotiation and close
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives
* Experience identifying customer risk and developing strategies to protect and improve retention
* Experience managing pipeline and producing accurate forecasts against retention and/or expansion targets
* Ability to build credibility and influence across multiple levels of a customer organization, including senior stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to navigate strategic, commercial, and difficult customer conversations
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, Legal, and RevOps

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience managing SMB and/or Mid\-Market SaaS customers with responsibility for both retention and expansion
* Experience carrying a renewal, expansion, or revenue quota and con

Martindale\-Avvo Leads Division is seeking a sales‑oriented, consultative Account Manager to retain and grow a book of \~200 legal clients. You will act as a trusted advisor, onboard new clients for long‑term success, run data‑driven performance reviews, and drive revenue through strategic upsells while proactively minimizing churn.
Key responsibilities:* Own a portfolio of \~200 law‑firm and legal‑service clients, building strong, long‑term relationships.
* Onboard new clients: set up accounts, establish goals, and ensure successful adoption of products/services.
* Conduct regular, data\-driven performance reviews, leveraging AI\-assisted insights where appropriate to measure ROI, identify opportunities, and recommend optimizations.
* Drive revenue growth through consultative upselling and cross‑selling of relevant Martindale‑Avvo solutions.
* Proactively monitor client health signals and intervene to prevent churn.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Marketing to escalate issues, share feedback, and improve the client experience.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM and prepare clear reporting for leadership.


What success looks like:* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to translate data into clear, actionable insights.
* Measurable upsell/cross‑sell revenue and growth in client lifetime value.
* Strong client satisfaction and adoption metrics (NPS, product usage, goal attainment).
* Consistent, timely delivery of performance reviews and action plans.


Qualifications:* Understand the use of AI tools to work more efficiently, identify account opportunities faster, and spend more time on high\-value client interactions.
* 3\+ years in account management, client success, or consultative sales—experience with legal industry clients strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a portfolio of accounts.
* Comfortable with numbers and using data to drive recommendations.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a proactive, client‑first mentality.
* Organized, self‑directed, and able to prioritize across a large book of business.


Nice to have* Familiarity with Martindale‑Avvo products or similar legal marketing platforms
* Experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and email tools such as Outreach

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the rate for this role to be at $21\.64/hourly plus commission and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.  

  

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well\-being of you and your family. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.

* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions

jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

Health Link Home Health \& Hospice  
Milpitas / Santa Clara County, CA  
Full\-Time \| $41/hour \+ Performance\-Based Bonus  


The Role  


For over 20 years, Health Link Home Health \& Hospice has served patients throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We are seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Account Manager to join our Community Relations team and support continued growth throughout Santa Clara County.  


Working closely with the Director of Business Development, the Account Manager will focus on developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare providers, increasing awareness of Health Link's home health services, and generating new referral opportunities throughout the South Bay.  


This is a field\-based role for someone who enjoys building relationships, connecting with healthcare professionals, and developing business within the community. We are looking for someone who is motivated, consistent, organized, and comfortable being accountable for growth goals.  


You will be supported with a company vehicle, ongoing training, and AI\-powered technology designed to provide referral insights and support efficient territory routing.  


What You'll Do  
Develop and maintain referral relationships throughout assigned areas of Santa Clara County  
Build relationships with hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, physicians, medical groups, clinics, senior living communities, and other healthcare organizations  
Conduct consistent in\-person outreach, account visits, meetings, presentations, and follow\-up  
Introduce new healthcare partners to Health Link and educate them on our home health services, clinical programs, and capabilities  
Maintain regular communication with existing referral partners and strengthen those relationships over time  
Identify new referral opportunities through consistent field outreach and relationship building  
Follow up with prospective referral partners and maintain consistent account contact  
Execute territory priorities and business development initiatives in partnership with the Director of Business Development  
Communicate feedback from referral partners, market activity, and potential growth opportunities to the Director of Business Development  
Collaborate with Intake, Clinical, Operations, and other internal teams to support a strong referral and patient experience  
Meet established referral, admission, and account growth goals  
Represent Health Link professionally throughout the South Bay healthcare community  
What You'll Need  
1\+ year of experience in healthcare sales, business development, account management, community relations, or a related healthcare role preferred  
Strong relationship\-building and communication skills  
Sales\-oriented mindset with the motivation to develop new business and grow referral relationships  
Comfortable conducting in\-person outreach and developing new professional relationships  
Strong follow\-up, organization, and time\-management skills  
Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in the field  
Knowledge of the Santa Clara County healthcare market preferred  
Existing relationships within the South Bay healthcare community are a plus  
Home health, hospice, post\-acute care, senior care, hospital, or skilled nursing experience preferred  
Valid California driver's license and driving record that meets company requirements  
Benefits  
Performance\-based bonus opportunity  
Company vehicle  
AI\-powered technology to support referral insights and efficient territory routing  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance  
401(k) with company matching  
Paid time off

jobs.title: Account Manager (Commercial Landscaping)
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**


Our dedicated team of professionals provide the full spectrum of landscape services. After 3 decades in business and more than 3,000 team members from coast\-to\-coast, we’re incredibly proud of the work that we do.


Our passion is our motivator and our focus is simple – **create an extraordinary culture, care for our team members, give back to our communities \& build a greener future.**

**THE POSITION**


This position is a high\-impact role, working closely with the Branch Manager, Production Manager, and production teams to create and maintain meaningful client relationships. This person will manage existing relationships, develop new business opportunities, and identify networking opportunities within the industry.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**

**Client Service and Retention**

* Drive customer satisfaction and retention by understanding the individual needs of our customers and the spaces that bring them joy and peace
* Provide excellent service and communication with a focus on problem\-solving
* Promote high standards for customer service, safety, and LandCare's culture
* Provide organizational management, leadership and communication between the client and production team
* Maintain LandCare's Landscape Quality Audit process in conjunction with the Production Manager to identify property maintenance needs and enhancement opportunities
* Create client proposals, contracts, and recommendations and estimates that are designed to meet each client's objectives
* Coordinate between client expectations and production reality to ensure every project reflects our commitment to quality

jobs.title: GTM Engineer (Revenue Operations)
jobs.description:
**About Flow**  

Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

**About the role**  

Flow is seeking a GTM Engineer to build and run the systems behind how we find, win, and grow customers. Our customers are hardware teams in aerospace, defense, automotive, and adjacent industries, and our sales motion reflects that: long evaluation cycles, multiple stakeholders across engineering and procurement, and pilots that expand into full deployments. Getting the right data, tooling, and process in place is what lets a small team run that motion well.


This role sits between sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership. You will own our GTM stack end to end, automate the work that slows the team down, and turn pipeline and customer data into something the whole company can trust and act on.

**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve our GTM stack, including CRM, enrichment, sequencing, and analytics tools, and the integrations that connect them.
* Build automated workflows for prospecting, lead routing, enrichment, and account research, using APIs, scripting, and AI tooling where it makes the team faster.
* Design and maintain our pipeline structure, deal stages, and data model so that forecasting and reporting reflect what is actually happening in the business.
* Build dashboards and reporting on pipeline health, conversion, sales cycle, and pilot\-to\-deployment expansion for the GTM team and leadership.
* Partner with sales and customer success to identify friction in how deals move and translate it into process or tooling changes.
* Support planning work such as territory and account segmentation, target account lists, and quota and capacity modeling as the team grows.
* Keep data clean and consistent across systems, including deduplication, field hygiene, and clear ownership of records.

**About you**

* 3\+ years in revenue operations, GTM engineering, sales operations, or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprise customers.
* Hands\-on experience administering a CRM and building automations and integrations across a GTM stack.
* Comfortable writing code or scripts (Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar) to connect systems and move data when no\-code tools fall short.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building reporting that leaders actually use to make decisions.
* Able to work directly with sellers and understand the realities of a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycle.
* Comfortable in a high\-ownership environment where you scope, build, and support your own systems.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at an early\-stage startup building GTM infrastructure from the ground up.
* Familiarity with selling into defense, aerospace, or other regulated industries, including longer procurement cycles.
* Experience using LLMs or AI agents to automate research, enrichment, or outbound workflows.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $235K

jobs.title: X/Twitter Community Manager (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
**About us**


UGLYCASH is built for a generation that earns differently.


The way people work and make money has fundamentally changed. People build businesses online, freelance across borders, create content, sell products, work remotely, and build careers that traditional financial institutions were never designed to understand or serve.


We believe financial opportunity should evolve with the people creating it.


UGLYCASH exists to build financial services for this new generation of earners — especially those earning online and across borders who have historically had less access to stable currency, credit, and the financial tools they need to grow.


We want to do things differently: to replace fine print with candid transparency and brutal honesty, discrimination with global financial inclusion, and cold, distant financial institutions with a human connection to the people we serve.


Our name is a statement of that difference. We don't build trust because of our name. We build trust through authenticity, honesty, and human connection.


But the mission goes deeper. We believe access to stable currency and financial opportunity is a human right. The internet has opened up entirely new ways for people around the world to earn — now the financial system needs to catch up.


UGLYCASH is being built for the people building their lives and careers on the internet.

**Check us out on:**


 Instagram


 TikTok


 Recent overview from Gabo on X (CEO)

**What you’ll be doing:**

* + Manage and grow UGLYCASH's cross\-platform social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, and X
	+ Own and develop the ongoing narrative of UGLYCASH across social
	+ Work closely with the founders and team to identify the stories, personalities, moments, and ideas worth turning into content
	+ Think beyond individual posts — build recurring storylines, formats, and content arcs that give people a reason to keep following
	+ Turn what's happening inside the company — launches, conversations, experiments, wins, failures, events, and everyday moments — into compelling narratives
	+ Partner closely with our film creator to decide what should be captured and how those moments become stories
	+ Develop and maintain the social content calendar and publishing cadence
	+ Stay deeply plugged into internet culture and identify relevant trends, conversations, and formats UGLYCASH can participate in
	+ Continuously experiment with how we tell our story, learn what resonates, and evolve the narrative accordingly

  

**Requirements** **What we look for in you:**

* + Located in the United States and willing to move to San Francisco after hire (relocation support provided)
	+ You're a strong storyteller with an instinct for finding the story people actually care about.
	+ You have experience building and growing an audience — ideally across Instagram and a writing\-led platform like Substack.
	+ You know how to develop clear content pillars and recurring formats that build a recognizable voice.
	+ You think in narratives, not just individual posts.
	+ You have strong editorial and creative taste and know what feels culturally relevant.
	+ You're deeply internet\-native and understand how people consume, share, and engage with content online.
	+ You're strategic but hands\-on — you can shape the story and make sure it gets executed.

* **Compensation:** We offer a competitive compensation plan that includes cash \& the potential for a token grant

* **Nomadic/remote work opportunities:** Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely for 2 months a year

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. This role fosters dignity, respect, and learning while helping to create a safe, supportive, and homelike environment. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.
* Ensures the safety, health, and well\-being of the people we support at all times.
* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.

* Administers medications as an Approved Medication Administration Personnel (AMAP), following agency protocols and under nursing supervision.
* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.
* Participates in housekeeping, laundry, and light maintenance tasks to ensure a safe, clean, and supportive environment.
* Attends and participates in staff meetings, trainings, and in\-service sessions to support ongoing development and quality care.
* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.
* Maintains confidentiality of all resident information and documentation.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

* High School Diploma or GED required.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**COMPENSATION:** $20\.17/hour (after probation) \+ Industry\-Leading Benefits for all full\-time employees.

We continuously seek opportunities for the organization to foster a more positive, respected, united, and collaborative culture.

jobs.description:
**Turn Recess Into Something Kids Look Forward To!** ⚽

Program Coordinator – Recess Coach

**Love working with kids? Enjoy sports, games, movement, and bringing positive energy wherever you go?**

ITAV is looking for energetic, dependable, and enthusiastic **Program Coordinators – Recess Coaches** to help us transform recess into a fun, safe, inclusive, and meaningful part of the school day.

This isn't a job where you simply stand on the sidelines and watch.

You'll be **leading games, getting kids moving, encouraging teamwork, helping students work through conflicts, building confidence, and creating the kind of recess experience students can't wait to be part of.**

If you love working with young people and believe play can be a powerful way to teach leadership, communication, teamwork, and confidence — **we want to meet you!**

**Who We Are**

**ITAV** is a sports\-based youth development organization that uses sports, fitness, structured play, and engaging activities to help young people build confidence, communication skills, leadership, accountability, and positive relationships.

We believe kids learn some of life's most important lessons while they're moving, playing, competing, communicating, and having fun.

What You'll Be Doing

As a **Program Coordinator – Recess Coach**, you'll help bring energy, structure, and FUN to the school day.

**You'll:**

* Lead fun, age\-appropriate sports, games, and movement activities.
* Get students excited about participating — including kids who may not usually join in.
* Encourage teamwork, communication, sportsmanship, and fair play.
* Help students build confidence and leadership skills through play.
* Help students work through disagreements and practice healthy conflict resolution.
* Create an environment where every child feels welcomed and included.
* Actively supervise students and keep activities safe, organized, and engaging.
* Adapt games and activities to support students with different abilities and needs.
* Build positive relationships with teachers, school staff, students, and the ITAV team.
* Respond appropriately to student concerns, injuries, incidents, or unexpected situations.
* Support field days, special events, after\-school activities, and other ITAV programs when needed.

**You'll Be Great at This If You...**

* Genuinely enjoy working with children and young people.
* Bring positive energy into a room — or onto a playground!
* Aren't afraid to jump into a game and participate.
* Can confidently lead and engage groups of children.
* Know how to be fun **and** maintain appropriate boundaries.
* Are patient, dependable, responsible, and professional.
* Communicate well with children and adults.
* Can stay calm when things don't go exactly as planned.
* Believe every child should have an opportunity to participate and feel successful.
* Enjoy being part of a team.

What We're Looking For

**Required:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Experience working with children or youth.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to lead games, activities, and groups of students.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
* Dependability and punctuality.
* Ability to work in active indoor and outdoor environments.

**Even Better If You Have:**

* Experience as a coach, camp counselor, recreation specialist, group leader, school aide, paraprofessional, or after\-school instructor.
* Experience working with students with disabilities or behavioral support needs.
* Sports, fitness, recreation, or youth development experience.
* Knowledge of positive behavior management or conflict\-resolution strategies.
* CPR or First Aid certification.

**This Role Is Active!**

You won't spend your day sitting behind a desk.

You'll be walking, moving, demonstrating games, setting up activities, interacting with students, and spending time indoors and outdoors.

If you enjoy an active workday, this may be a great fit.

**Why Join ITAV?**

Because **recess is more than free time.**

It's where kids can learn to communicate.

It's where they practice teamwork.

It's where confidence grows.

It's where new friendships happen.

And sometimes, it's where a young person discovers that they're a leader.

At ITAV, you'll have an opportunity to make those moments happen every day.

Ready to Bring the Energy?

If you're ready to **move, motivate, mentor, and make an impact**, we'd love to hear from you.

**Apply today and help ITAV create playgrounds and programs where every child has an opportunity to play, connect, grow, and thrive!**

Pay: $18\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

We’re looking for someone who thrives both independently and as part of a team, adapts easily to shifting priorities, and is eager to grow. We represent companies at every stage of development, from entrepreneurial start\-ups to multibillion\-dollar global corporations, as well as the venture firms, private equity firms, and investment banks that finance and advise them. The firm has approximately 1,100 attorneys in 17 offices: 13 in the U.S., two in China, and two in Europe. Our broad spectrum of practices and entrepreneurial spirit allow exceptional opportunities for professional achievement and career growth.


The firm seeks a Recruiting Coordinator to join our dynamic Lateral Recruiting Team. Based in New York or Washington, D.C., you’ll support attorney recruiting firmwide, with a special focus on our East Coast, London, and Brussels offices serving as a key point of contact for candidates, hiring partners, and internal business teams. Core responsibilities include candidate screening, interview coordination across multiple time zones, and supporting our European hiring process.


We’re looking for someone who thrives both independently and as part of a team, adapts easily to shifting priorities, and is eager to grow. You’ll collaborate closely with recruiters, the Onboarding Coordinator, Professional Development, and Human Resources, as well as our London and Brussels office management teams to help attract, hire, and retain top, diverse legal talent.


This position is available as a hybrid work schedule.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Reviewing candidate materials, including resumes, law school transcripts and GPA information, and writing samples or deal sheets, and introducing candidates to practice group leaders and hiring partners with all relevant information.
* Coordinating interview scheduling for East Coast offices (Boston, DC, New York, Wilmington), London, and Brussels, managing the complexity of multi\-office scheduling across time zones.
* Ensuring seamless candidate communication and experience throughout the interview process.
* Preparing initial drafts of European employment contracts, offer letters and employment agreements, and confirming receipt of appropriate documents from candidates.
* Coordinating with London and Brussels office management on candidate logistics and hiring processes.
* Confirming London and Brussels benefits information with HR as needed and updating templates to reflect any revisions.
* Supporting recruiting events, including logistics, invitations, and materials, for Patent Agent hiring.
* Maintaining candidate tracking systems and producing recruiting reports.
* Partnering with recruiters and the Onboarding Coordinator to ensure a smooth transition from interview to hire.
* Meeting deadlines and making process efficiency recommendations as the subject matter expert on East Coast and European interview coordination.
* Ensuring compliance with all processes and maintaining a high level of confidentiality.
* Proactively identifying process improvements and challenging the status quo to enhance the candidate experience.
* Maintaining records in viRecruit and Workday, updating as needed.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------


* Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
* 2\+ years of corporate recruiting experience in a law firm or professional services is strongly preferred.
* Experience or familiarity with European employment contracts, offer letters, transcript requirements, and other European\-specific hiring procedures is a plus.
* Outstanding organizational, communication (written and verbal), and critical thinking skills.
* Knowledge of the attorney recruiting process and legal employment issues.
* The ability to set priorities, work independently, and handle a variety of duties effectively across multiple time zones and offices under time constraints.
* An understanding of unconscious bias and its effect on recruiting and hiring.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work well with different levels of firm personnel and external candidates.
* Superior analytical, attention to detail, planning, and organizational skills.
* Highly motivated and creative with the ability to make sound business decisions.
* The ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with the appropriate discretion.
* Proficiency with MS Office and applicant tracking systems, preferably Workday and LawCruit/viRecruit.

jobs.title: Culinary Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Schedule**: 40 hours per week, primarily weekdays, with flexibility for occasional early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays based on event needs.


For more than 18 years, Dish Food \& Events has created memorable NYC events by pairing delicious food with Heart Hospitality. The Culinary Operations Coordinator provides the administrative coordination that keeps our events organized and production\-ready. Working closely with Sales, Culinary, and Operations, this role communicates event details, maintains accurate information in Total Party Planner and Galley, prepares event materials, and helps every team deliver an exceptional guest experience.

 **Key Responsibilities*** Partner with the Executive Chef to co\-lead Dish's weekly production meeting, and additional meetings as needed. Bring together Sales, Culinary, and Operations to align on each event's client experience and execution plan.
* Own event readiness in Total Party Planner (TPP): audit menus, guest counts, quantities, dietary needs, custom items, service style, timing, staffing, labor, rentals, equipment, packing, delivery, and on\-site setup before production deadlines.
* Document production\-meeting decisions; enter and update TPP and Galley information; confirm required tasks are complete; and follow through with Sales, Culinary, and Operations to resolve open items, data discrepancies, and entry errors.
* Maintain accurate, organized TPP and Galley records, including menu items, recipes, ingredients, yields, allergens, production notes, and custom requests. Confirm approved recipes and required details are entered before production.
* Prepare and distribute TPP reports, event\-chef binders, and related event paperwork, including event details, timelines, service notes, recipes, production guidance, and available plating or presentation photos. Ensure materials are complete, current, and sent on time; the Executive Chef remains the culinary point of contact for Event Chefs.
* Communicate approved changes to kitchen, warehouse, and logistics teams; coordinate last\-minute updates and escalate issues that could affect cost, quality, timing, or guest experience.
* Create practical checklists and workflows for order processing, recipe setup, custom\-item entry, production\-meeting follow\-up, and final event readiness. Identify ways to reduce errors, waste, rework, and last\-minute scrambling.

  

**Qualifications*** 2\+ years of administrative coordination experience in catering, food production, event operations, hospitality, or a related environment.
* Practical understanding of food production, catering logistics, and how event details affect kitchen production, warehouse packing, transport, staffing, and on\-site service.
* Experience with Total Party Planner (TPP), Galley, or similar catering and recipe\-management software preferred; ability to learn systems quickly is essential.
* Experience reading and documenting standardized recipes, including yields, ingredients, allergens, portioning, and production notes.
* Strong data\-entry skills, exceptional accuracy, organization, follow\-through, and ability to manage multiple events, deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound judgment, and comfort working across Sales, Culinary, and Operations. Professional, collaborative, and service\-minded approach.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and spreadsheets; knowledge of food safety and sanitation practices. ServSafe certification is a plus.
* Calm, practical, solutions\-oriented approach in a fast\-paced environment.

  

**Culture \& Core Values*** Embody Dish's Mission, Core Values, and Heart Hospitality standards in every interaction and event.
* Foster positive, proactive communication across Sales, Culinary, Operations, and the broader Dish team.
* Actively participate in Dish's Culture \& Growth Program, including regular 1:1s, check\-ins, and annual performance reviews.
* Contribute to a supportive, collaborative, and accountable work environment.

**Benefits**  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Paid time off, paid holidays, paid family leave, sick pay, and short\- and long\-term disability insurance.
* 401(k) plan after 12 months of full\-time employment and commuter benefits.
* Paid Volunteer Time Off and daily family meal.

jobs.title: Outreach Coordinator (Evening Shift)
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US:** \- We believe that everyone deserves a home!
  
  

Breaking Ground operates nearly 4,000 units of housing across New York City, along with housing in upstate New York and Connecticut. Supportive housing \- affordable housing paired with services designed to help people maintain their homes for the long\-term \- is widely recognized as a proven and cost\-effective solution to chronic homelessness.
  
  

But we didn't stop at providing housing. Breaking Ground's programs and services help people experiencing street homelessness \- especially those who have been on the streets the longest \- to come indoors. Through our Street to Home outreach program and transitional housing resources, we help people get, and stay, on the path to a permanent home.
  
  

Breaking Ground’s Street to Home program makes regular contact with more than 2,000 street homeless individuals and connects more than 500 individuals to housing, medical and mental health services, substance abuse counseling, and other essential supports each year. The caring, individually tailored attention clients receive at each stage of their journey from street to home ensures that more than 95% of people who Breaking Ground places remain stably housed.
  
  

Reporting to the Assistant Director, Programs, Outreach, the Outreach Coordinator manages and supervises street outreach teams, providing coordination across the teams to ensure there is always staff deployed in the field and helps to triage and prioritize urgent requests or developing situations. The Outreach Coordinator ensures the teams utilize Harm Reduction and Housing First approaches when conducting street outreach and engage with individuals to determine homelessness history, services needed, and appropriate placement options from the field in the moment. The Outreach Coordinator creates shift schedules, ensuring continual coverage in the field, and that Housing Advocate teams are compliant with data entry requirements into DHS’ system contractual requirements.
  
  

The Outreach Coordinator is responsible for gaining a holistic understanding of the homeless population and works in collaboration with the community and other partners to implement appropriate housing and service solutions. The Outreach Coordinator manages their teams’ responses to community concerns, oversees Code Red/Blue alerts, identifies new hotspots and encampments, plans weekly canvass schedules for the teams, and oversees all 9\.58 assessments and removals for the shift.
  
  

Programs staff are required to locate and assist street homeless individuals under the most extreme weather conditions. Managers are required to be in the field during Code Reds and Code Blues. Staff must be willing to engage with street homeless individuals and can handle multiple tasks in a fast paced, dynamic, team environment.
  
  

This position is primarily the evening shift and has a 35\-hour work week as well as on\-call responsibilities.
  
  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITES:**  

Successful oversight and performance management of street outreach teams including Housing Advocates and a Team Leader II who supervises an additional street outreach team and a part time Social Worker
  
  

Provide regular, structured supervision meetings for direct reports
  
  

Responsible for implementing supervisory strategies, and systems of accountability to ensure that staff have adequate support, guidance, and oversight at all times
  
  

Create and implement shift schedules that ensure teams are deployed at all times; find coverage for callouts, vacations, and vacancies
  
  

Ensure canvassing incorporates feedback from the team, community, DHS, historical 311 data, etc
  
  

Promote effective strategies for outreach work, following Housing First, Harm Reduction, Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI), Motivational Interviewing and trauma\-informed care models of practice
  
  

Ensure adherence to program contracts, regulatory requirements, and internal guidelines, ensuring all performance targets and service delivery benchmarks are consistently met
  
  

Responsible for ensuring documentation, reporting, and referrals are accurately completed on time and in compliance with DHS and Breaking Ground requirements
  
  

Provide support and guidance to staff in managing difficult situations and successfully de\-escalating conflict
  
  

Oversee and participate in Code Blue/Red Alerts, providing clinical leadership to the teams when they encounter challenging situations
  
  

Assess and complete 9\.58 involuntary removals to a hospital and ensure all required documentation is accurate and completed on time
  
  

Serve as a liaison with community partners, intergovernmental stakeholders, DHS staff and other community stakeholders to respond to emergent concerns, including 311 calls and encampment engagement
  
  

Develop strong collaborative relationships with external partners and service providers, NYPD, EMS, etc
  
  

Attend onsite meetings with community partners
  
  

Provide on call coverage as needed for the program
  
  

Perform other duties as assigned
  
  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:**  

NYS Licensed Masters Social Worker (LMSW) required
  
  

Minimum 3 years supervisory experience required
  
  

Obtain 9\.58 credentialing within first 3 months of hire required
  
  

Understanding of Housing First, client centered motivational interviewing, Harm Reduction models, behavioral and medical health systems
  
  

Experience with crisis intervention, including, risk assessments and incident management
  
  

Excellent communication skills (verbally and written) and ability to work with diverse population
  
  

Superb collaborative skills; ability to work successfully with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders
  
  

Detailed oriented and can manage team tasks
  
  

Excellent scheduling skills
  
  

Valid NY, NJ, CT, or PA driver’s license with a good driving record, as defined b

jobs.title: Print Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**SEEN is looking for a highly organized, detail\-driven Print Production Coordinator to help bring campaigns from approved artwork to the streets.**

This role sits at the center of our print and campaign operations, coordinating artwork, production, delivery, and installation across a high volume of campaigns. You’ll work closely with our sales, operations, production, and installation teams to make sure every campaign is produced accurately, delivered on time, and installed exactly as planned.

This is a hands\-on role for someone who likes moving quickly, keeping details straight, solving problems, and seeing their work physically come to life in the city.

**What You’ll Do**

* Coordinate print campaigns from artwork approval through production, delivery, and installation
* Review campaign specs, quantities, sizes, materials, artwork, and production requirements
* Coordinate with internal production teams, printers, installers, and vendors
* Track production schedules and campaign deadlines across multiple active projects
* Confirm artwork is properly prepared and production\-ready
* Manage print orders and ensure the correct materials and quantities are produced
* Coordinate delivery of printed materials to warehouses, installers, and job sites
* Maintain accurate campaign trackers, production schedules, and status updates
* Communicate campaign updates and potential issues to internal teams
* Identify production or scheduling issues early and help find solutions
* Work closely with installation teams to make sure the right materials arrive at the right location at the right time
* Help manage last\-minute changes, reprints, rush orders, and other real\-world campaign needs
* Keep detailed records of campaign materials, costs, deliveries, and completion
* Support post\-campaign reconciliation and reporting
* Additional duties around billboard installation and or tasks may arise during your employment.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2\+ years of experience in print production, advertising, OOH, media, marketing operations, or a related field
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent communication skills and follow\-through
* Comfortable working with printers, production vendors, and internal teams
* Ability to understand print specifications, materials, quantities, and production requirements
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change quickly
* Resourceful problem solver who doesn’t wait around for someone else to fix an issue
* Someone who takes ownership and understands that the details matter

**The SEEN Mindset**

We work in the physical world. Things have to get printed, delivered, installed, and seen.

That means this role requires someone who is comfortable getting into the details and figuring things out. You should be organized enough to keep hundreds of moving pieces straight, but practical enough to pick up the phone and solve a problem when something doesn't go according to plan.

You don't need to know everything about outdoor advertising on day one. You do need to be curious, accountable, organized, and willing to get into the work.

**About SEEN**

SEEN is an independent outdoor media company built around the streets, cities, and culture that make advertising matter.

We work directly with brands, record labels, artists, agencies, and cultural partners to bring campaigns into the physical world — from street\-level posters and barricades to billboards and large\-scale outdoor installations.

Our work is built to be seen in the places where people actually live, work, move, and play.
