jobs.title: Syndicated Loan Transaction Coordinator - Associate
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You have an undergraduate degree plus a minimum of 5 years of Syndicated Loan experience. Join a team that supports your career growth, advancement and expanding opportunities! At JPMorganChase we take pride in valuing our employees' individualities, while supporting an inclusive culture of teamwork. This is the team for you.


As a **Syndicated Loan Transaction Coordinator – Associate** within the Wholesale Lending Services team at JPMorganChase, you will be responsible for coordinating complex syndicated loans, and letter of credit transactions for the Corporate Investment and Commercial Banks. You will work closely with the JPMorganChase Origination Businesses, ensuring all required documents, reference data, and critical information are reviewed for operational feasibility, optimal execution mechanics, regulatory requirements and mitigation of operational risk.


The Wholesale Lending Services team partners with various internal and external parties including, but not limited to, Debt Capital Markets, Credit Risk, Loan and Agency Services, Product Control, Legal, Trade Settlements, as well as JPM Borrowers and Lender Clients. The team also interacts with their international counterparts in Europe and the Asia Pacific on cross\-border deals originating out of North America.

**Job responsibilities**

* Assign, Manage, and maintain Investment and Commercial Bank transaction pipeline.
* Ensure a broad understanding of the loan products, and the overall industry in order to effectively assist the junior analysts on the team, acting as the point of escalation.
* Collect and review legal loan documentation for operational feasibility, optimal execution mechanics, regulatory requirements and mitigation of operational risk.
* Coordinate and review of internal closing documentation with Debt Capital Markets, Credit Risk, Loan and Agency Services, Product Control, Legal, Trade Settlements, as well as Borrowers and Lenders.
* Discuss and advise funding mechanics and operational requirements as it pertains to internal booking locations, regional, and currency policies.
* Initiate trade settlement process and coordinate with trade settlement teams for Institutional Term Loan transactions.
* Provide effective communication and coordination of fee documentation and recognition and execute best practices and control, risk mitigation and escalate point of contact.
* Identify and address control gaps by engaging global partners. Propose solutions to improve the process at a global scale.
* Participate with various working groups created to enhance performance and efficiency and interact/coordinate with international counterparts on cross\-border deals originating out of North America.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Undergraduate degree plus a minimum of 5 years of Syndicated Loan experience.
* Knowledge of the Loan product / Syndicated Loan business, including a strong understanding of a credit agreement, loan funding mechanics, deal structure, ticking fees, funds flows, etc.
* Demonstrated understanding of financial services, specifically within Investment Banking.
* Prior experience working with clients to collect and review pre\-syndicated loan documentation ahead of closing large syndicated structures.
* Proven ability to collaborate with team members and senior management across and within the lines of business with a keen attention to detail and strong analytical capability.
* Demonstrated experience operating in a challenging and rapidly changing environment with a desire to accept new assignments and the ability to learn new principles and dynamic systems quickly.
* Critical decision\-making abilities including the ability to identify, escalate, and propose solutions to problems.


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Outreach Coordinator


**Location:** New York, NY


**FLSA Status:** Full Time, Non\-Exempt


**Classification:** Professional


**Department:** Immigration Legal Services


**Reports to:** Program Manager


**Supervisory Responsibilities:** Yes\_\_\_\_\_No\_\_\_X\_\_\_\_

**Salary:** $30\.77 \- $35\.71 per hour, this is a non\-exempt hour position based on a 35 hours work week.

 **Summary:** The Outreach Coordinator will join Catholic Charities Community Services (CCCS) as part of a coordinated citywide initiative to reach immigrant communities across New York City. Through community presence and outreach efforts, the outreach coordinator will help connect individuals to the appropriate CCCS program and/or the MOIA hotline for free immigration legal services, referrals, or information. The coordinator will ensure that the community knows what services CCCS provides for immigrants and asylum seekers and how to access CCCS programs for free, safe, confidential legal services. This position is ideal for someone who feels comfortable engaging vulnerable communities and who is committed to the mission of supporting immigrant families.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Plan and coordinate an outreach strategy to community partners, including parishes, DOE schools, and community\-based organizations.
* Attend community events to promote the CCCS legal services, including eligibility screenings, referrals for specialized services, and general immigration information at resources fairs, PTA/SLT meetings at schools, partner organizations staff meetings, etc.
* Develop and distribute trainings, presentations and outreach materials for communities that we work with as well as materials distributed during Know Your Rights presentations.
* Regularly review and update resources in our attendee packets and information about other service providers in the community.
* Help with the tracking of outreach presentations and attendance via internal CRM and data systems in collaboration with the data team.
* Maintain knowledge of city agencies and community resources for non\-legal needs and external referrals for wraparound services.
* Work with program coordinators to ensure full capacity clinics.
* Support and provide coverage for program coordinators, which may include appointment scheduling and attendee confirmations to ensure deliverables are met.
* Support the intake coordinator with communication when people reach out asking for updates, while maintaining client confidentiality.
* Other duties as needed.

 **Requirements** **Position Type and Expected Hours of Work:**

  

This is a full\-time position that will require working out in the field when conducting outreach, when necessary. The remaining time will be spent performing admin and outreach work at CCCS’ office and/or remotely. Days and hours of work are generally 9:00 AM to 5 PM Monday \- Friday. Position requires willingness to travel to all five (5\) boroughs and availability to work some weekend and evening hours. Additional hours may be required to meet case\-related and/or program deadlines, or client needs.

 **Working conditions and physical demands required:**

  

The demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

* Travel at least 50% of the time using public transportation or vehicle, traverse city streets, occasionally ascend/descend stairs, and be exposed to outside weather conditions.
* Remain stationary at a workstation, in meetings, and use a computer at least 50% of the time.
* Remain stationary and/or ambulate to instruct and monitor during trainings and presentations.
* Carry a laptop to offsite work locations.

 **Qualifications**

**Education and/or experience required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent professional training related to the position.

 **Skills, Licenses, and/or competencies** ***required*****:**

* Bilingual: English plus Spanish.
* Ability and experience working with diverse individuals and communities.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Highly organized.
* Excellent interpersonal, organizational, administrative, communication (in particular public speaking is a plus) and coordination skills.
* Ability to convene and lead meetings.
* Adept at using Microsoft office suite programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Ability to work both independently and in a highly collaborative team environment.
* Willingness to travel to all five (5\) boroughs.
* Availability and readiness to work some weekend and evening hours.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.*

jobs.title: Clinical Administrative Coordinator - New York
jobs.description:
At UnitedHealthcare, we're simplifying the health care experience, creating healthier communities and removing barriers to quality care. The work you do here impacts the lives of millions of people for the better. Come build the health care system of tomorrow, making it more responsive, affordable and optimized. Ready to make a difference? Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together**


The Clinical Administrative Coordinator is an integral member of the NY MAP (New York Medicaid Advantage Plus) \& NYLTSS (New York Long Term Services and Supports) clinical team, providing the administrative support necessary to ensure that enrollees and members receive their Long\-Term Services and Supports (LTSS). Working closely with Care Managers (CMs) and CM Managers, this role serves as a key operational resource \- triaging calls, coordinating with LTSS vendors, maintaining accurate clinical documentation, and monitoring eligibility and assessment data in New York State systems. This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment that requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence in supporting vulnerable Medicaid populations.


This position is full\-time (40 hours/week) Monday \- Friday from 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.


If you are in New York state, you will have the flexibility to telecommute\* as you take on some tough challenges.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

**Administrative Support to the Clinical Team**

* Serve as an integral administrative partner to the NY MAP \& NYLTSS clinical team, providing day\-to\-day operational support to Care Managers and CM Managers to facilitate seamless delivery of LTSS to members
* Ensure required internal clinical documentation is accurately saved in each member's record; identify and report any documentation gaps or missing records to the appropriate clinical staff in a timely manner
* Review, organize, and disseminate Excel\-based reports to CM staff as needed to support care management workflows, caseload monitoring, and compliance tracking

**Member \& Provider Call Triage and Escalation**

* Triage inbound calls and requests from NY MAP \& NYLTSS enrollees, family members/caregivers, and LTSS providers, accurately assessing the nature and urgency of each inquiry
* Escalate member and provider issues to the assigned Care Manager or CM Manager in accordance with established NY MAP \& NYLTSS protocols, ensuring warm handoffs and complete documentation of the concern
* Document all interactions thoroughly within the care management system, maintaining HIPAA compliance and adherence to NY MAP \& NYLTSS record\-keeping requirements

**LTSS Vendor Coordination \& Service Gap Management**

* Collaborate with contracted LTSS vendors \- including home care agencies, personal care providers, adult day health programs, and other community\-based service organizations \- to confirm that authorized services are in place and being delivered to members
* Identify and communicate service gaps or initiation delays to the assigned Care Manager for timely resolution, ensuring members do not experience interruptions in their authorized LTSS
* Track and document vendor follow\-up activities, maintaining a clear record of service status and outreach efforts within the care management platform

**Eligibility \& Assessment Review in NYS Systems**

* Review member Medicaid eligibility status in New York State systems (e.g., ePACES) and flag any lapses, pending renewals, or changes that may impact LTSS service continuity
* Monitor assessment completion status in NYS systems (e.g., UAS\-NY), ensuring that required assessments are current and coordinating with Care Managers when follow\-up is needed
* Report eligibility and assessment discrepancies to the clinical team and escalate to the CM Manager as appropriate to maintain compliance with NYSDOH MLTC/MAP \& NYLTSS requirements


This is a high\-volume, service\-oriented environment. You will need to be efficient, productive, and thorough in supporting NY MAP \& NYLTSS members and the clinical team. You must be able to work a flexible schedule that may include evening hours. You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you, give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role, and provide development opportunities for other roles you may be interested in.


You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma/GED
* 2\+ years of customer service experience
* Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Word (create, edit, and save documents), Microsoft Excel (create, edit, and save spreadsheets), and Microsoft Outlook (email and calendar management)
* Must reside in New York State
* Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy
* Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high\-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high\-speed internet service

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working within the health care industry and with health care insurance, particularly in a Medicaid, MLTC, or Managed Care environment
* Familiarity with New York State Medicaid systems including ePACES and UAS\-NY
* Experience working with LTSS vendors, home care agencies, or community\-based service providers
* Clerical or administrative support background in a clinical or managed care setting
* Knowledge of ICD\-10 and CPT codes
* Experience working in a call center or high\-volume telephonic environment

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritiz

**Job Description**
-------------------


Open to candidates who are permanent.
  

  

The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s Division of Environmental Health works to prevent and control illness and injury related to environmental and occupational health risks through outreach, education, surveillance, and enforcement. With staff of 1,000, the Division covers a broad range of subject matter, including oversight of environmental investigations, lead poisoning, prevention, occupational health, food safety, childcare, radiation control, recreational and drinking water quality, air quality, climate health, vector control, veterinary public health, and pest control. The Bureau of Food Safety and Community Sanitation (BFSCS) protects the public, including New York's most vulnerable citizens from a broad range of hazards that may pose a threat to health or safety. DOHMH is mandated to inspect 26,000 restaurants annually, school cafeterias, and mobile food vending unit, adult day care centers, senior centers, soup kitchens, homeless shelters, and other facilities.
  

  

DUTIES WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT BE LIMITED TO:
  

* Serve as a point of contact for al front\-end MFV customer service interactions, maintaining high\-quality care and effectively routing inquiries.
* Prepare and maintain various data and facility reports, logs, and tracking analyses to support informed decision\-making by the Regional Director.
* Provide customer care services through phone and in\-person interactions regarding mobile food vending permits and licenses, including guiding customers on required documentation.
* Assist in logistical planning and execution of operations, including scheduling appointments for Mobile Food Vendors pre\-permit inspections, and inventory control.
* Organize and host training sessions, ensuring designated facility space is available for administrative and custodial staff.
* Address inquiries from the Bureau’s Health \& Safety Coordinator and maintain compliance with health and safety regulations.
* Collaborate with Human Resources regarding personnel matters such as training and documentation.
* Work with the Director of Communications to ensure the facility has up\-to\-date literature and messaging for customer service needs.
* Support the Bureau’s Project Support Specialist with updates on vehicle usage and documentation.
* Coordinate with the Sr. Procurement Coordinator to monitor supplies and report any IT or resource issues.
* Assist with additional administrative duties and special projects as assigned to support the program.

  

PREFERRED SKILLS:
  

* Excellent communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Excellent decision making and problem\-solving skills.
* Proficient with Microsoft Office
* Bilingual

  

Why you should work for us:
  

  

* Loan Forgiveness: As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal/state loan forgiveness and repayment assistance programs that lessen your payments or even fully forgive your full balance. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website (https://studentaid.gov/pslf/)
* Benefits: City employees are entitled to unmatched benefits such as:

o a premium\-free health insurance plan that saves employees over $10K annually, per a 2024 assessment.
  

o additional health, fitness, and financial benefits may be available based on the position’s associated union/benefit fund.
  

o a public sector defined benefit pension plan with steady monthly payments in retirement.
  

o a tax\-deferred savings program and
  

o a robust Worksite Wellness Program that offers resources and opportunities to keep you healthy while serving New Yorkers.
  

* Work From Home Policy: Depending on your position, you may be able to work up to two days during the week from home.

\- Job Security \- you could enjoy more job security compared to private sector employment and be able to contribute to making NYC a healthy place to live and work.
  

  

Established in 1805, the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (NYC Health Department) is the oldest and largest health department in the U.S., dedicated to protecting and improving the health of NYC. Our mission is to safeguard the health of every resident and cultivate a city where everyone, regardless of age, background, or location, can achieve their optimal health. We provide a wide array of programs and services focused on food and nutrition, anti\-tobacco support, chronic disease prevention, HIV/AIDS treatment, family and child health, environmental health, mental health, and social justice initiatives. As the primary population health strategist and policy authority for NYC, with a rich history of public health initiatives and scientific advancements, from addressing the 1822 yellow fever outbreak to the COVID\-19 pandemic, we serve as a global leader in public health innovation and expertise.
  

  

Come join us and help to continue our efforts in making a difference in the lives of all New Yorkers!

jobs.title: Mid-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused Advertising Sales Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.

  

The Mid\-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager is responsible for owning and growing a portfolio of advertisers through strategic account planning, consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and high\-quality execution. This role combines hands\-on client engagement with broader responsibility for revenue performance, account health, and delivery excellence.


You will operate as a trusted advisor to advertisers, translating business objectives and performance data into clear growth strategies and practical recommendations. Success requires sound commercial judgement, confidence engaging senior stakeholders, strong ownership of complex work, and the ability to influence outcomes in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment.

  

What You Will Be Doing

  

Strategic Account Ownership \& Customer Engagement

* Own a portfolio of advertisers and serve as the primary commercial and strategic point of contact throughout the account lifecycle
* Develop account plans that identify growth opportunities, risks, client objectives, and clear actions to improve revenue, retention, and advertiser value
* Build trusted relationships with client decision\-makers and confidently lead consultative conversations, performance reviews, and recommendations
* Drive proactive outreach through calls, email, and scheduled follow\-ups, balancing activity expectations with the quality and complexity of each opportunity
* Diagnose advertiser needs and recommend tailored advertising products, campaign strategies, and optimization actions aligned with business goals
* Lead complex or sensitive account discussions, resolve issues, and coordinate the appropriate internal support to protect the client relationship
* Identify expansion, cross\-sell, and retention opportunities using performance trends, market context, and commercial insight
* Partner with sales, product, operations, and support teams to deliver a consistent end\-to\-end advertiser experience

  

Pipeline, Forecasting \& Commercial Discipline

* Maintain a structured, accurate, and strategically prioritized pipeline within Salesforce or an equivalent CRM
* Own revenue pacing and forecast quality for assigned accounts, identifying gaps early and developing recovery or acceleration plans
* Apply sound judgement to prioritize opportunities, client needs, and daily activities against commercial impact
* Meet agreed activity, conversion, revenue, retention, and service\-level expectations while maintaining a high standard of customer engagement
* Ensure clear documentation of client objectives, decision criteria, commercial opportunities, risks, commitments, and next steps
* Use account and pipeline data to provide concise updates, surface trends, and recommend actions to leadership
* Independently manage competing priorities and escalate material risks with clear context and proposed solutions

  

Quality, Leadership \& Continuous Improvement

* Set a strong standard for customer interactions across calls, meetings, and written communication
* Ensure all work complies with agreed processes, turnaround times, quality controls, and data and privacy requirements
* Translate recurring client feedback and performance trends into actionable recommendations for leadership and partner teams
* Identify operational inefficiencies, shape practical improvements, and support implementation of more scalable ways of working
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance, peer support, and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members without direct people\-management responsibility
* Support onboarding, calibration, and best\-practice sharing across the team as required
* Represent Accenture professionally and act as a credible, customer\-centric advocate in all internal and external interactions

  

Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum 4 years of experience in Advertising Sales or Advertising Account Management

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Demonstrated ownership of a client portfolio, revenue target, sales pipeline, or account\-growth plan
* Proven ability to lead consultative client conversations, influence decisions, and
* convert data into clear commercial recommendations
* Experience managing complex client needs, competing priorities, and escalations with limited supervision

jobs.title: SMB Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**

Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.

You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

* Own commercial strategy across a portfolio of approximately 75–130 SMB and/or Mid\-Market customers, with accountability for GRR, NRR, renewals, and expansion performance

* Proactively manage the renewal lifecycle from early strategy and stakeholder alignment through negotiation and close

* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities across additional licenses, products, and multi\-product offerings to increase NRR
* Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, decision\-makers, and executive stakeholders to reduce churn risk and unlock growth
* Partner closely with Customer Success to connect product adoption and demonstrated customer value to renewal and expansion strategies
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on business priorities, ROI, future needs, and opportunities to expand the partnership

* Navigate complex customer situations—including competitive evaluations, budget pressure, organizational changes, product concerns, and procurement—with sound commercial judgment and customer empathy
* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions
* Surface customer insights and trends to Product, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to help improve our product and go\-to\-market strategy
* Contribute to the continued evolution of Account Management by sharing best practices and identifying opportunities to improve processes, playbooks, segmentation, automation, and operating rhythms

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, or another customer\-facing B2B SaaS role
* 1\+ years owning commercial outcomes such as renewals, expansion, upsell, cross\-sell, or revenue retention
* Track record managing and growing a portfolio of B2B SaaS customers and associated ARR
* Proven ability to lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through negotiation and close
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives
* Experience identifying customer risk and developing strategies to protect and improve retention
* Experience managing pipeline and producing accurate forecasts against retention and/or expansion targets
* Ability to build credibility and influence across multiple levels of a customer organization, including senior stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to navigate strategic, commercial, and difficult customer conversations
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, Legal, and RevOps

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience managing SMB and/or Mid\-Market SaaS customers with responsibility for both retention and expansion
* Experience carrying a renewal, expansion, or revenue quota and con

jobs.title: Account Manager, Touchland Amazon
jobs.description:
A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

  

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

  

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.


United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

**Job Summary**
===============


Church \& Dwight is seeking an Account Manager to join our team. The Account Manager that will act as the holistic channel owner for Amazon for the Touchland brand. The candidate will act as the lead owner of Touchland seller central account as well as lead advertising strategy (partially agency support) with a focus on maximizing profitable sales growth in the channel.  



  

  

**About the Role**
==================


This is a “Hands on” role with significant leadership opportunity that would be ideal for a strong early career amazon brand manager. This position reports to the Associate Director, 3P Marketplace and will work closely with the broader Touchland team including Brand marketing, Ecommerce Brand Manager, and DTC/Affiliate.

**Work Environment:**
=====================

**Hybrid:** This is a hybrid role based in Ewing, NJ or New York City and requires in\- person attendance.

* Ewing, NJ requires in\- person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays.
* NYC requires in\- person attendance on Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays, with remote work options on Wednesdays and Fridays.

**Role Accountabilities and** **Responsibilities**
==================================================

**Core Responsibilities**

**Sales and Revenue Generation:**

* Own full P\+L and sales call for Amazon channel with oversight from associate director, 3p marketplace.
* Drive strategy and push execution and development of all advertising, promotion, and content execution/merchandising for the channel managing broker resource as needed.
* In partnership with ecommerce brand manager specialty skin care, ensure strong brand content and creative throughout the amazon ecosystem including PDPs, brand stores, and other merchandised touchpoints.
* Develop and implement Sponsored Ads strategy driving broker/agency to drive incremental sales, increase AOV, and maximize Return on Ad Spend
* Develop Amazon DSP strategy in coordination with broker/agency and
* Lead and maintain the Amazon Marketing Cloud reporting objectives for Touchland
* Report Amazon Ads and Amazon Sales performance to Touchland and CHD leadership teams, including weekly, bi\-weekly, and quarterly results against baseline KPIs

**Operations Management:**

* Oversee broker source management of all of the day to day tasks needed to support the Touchland Amazon business including catalog management, promotional execution, and troubleshooting any and all business issues.
* Partner with customer logistics for day\-to\-day operations related to Amazon, including inventory management, listing uptime, and FBA replenishment
* Partner with Demand Planning Manager for SKU\-level demand planning and inventory forecasting.

**Strategic Channel Leadership**

* Set future strategies and growth expectations for the channel with oversight from associate director, 3p marketplace
* Define product launch strategies, as well as assortment, channel profitability and price pack architecture needs
* In partnership with sales strategy and EBM, manage channel conflicts and needs as brand is rolled into new channels
* Partner with international team to ensure smooth global roll\-out with minimal conflicts across amazon
* Work closely with DTC/affiliate team and EBM to ensure best practice sharing and tight coordination on launch and campaign activation strategy

**Education and Experience**
============================

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, with a focus on Amazon marketplace management and advertising. Proven track record of successfully driving sales and revenue growth on the Amazon platform.
* Beauty experience a plus
* Familiarity with Amazon’s policies, algorithms, and best practices.
* Comfort in leading strategic agency direction.
* Understanding of sales, advertising, and business reporting with an ability to concisely deliver updates and actions
* Expert in using Amazon Seller Central and related tools, such as Helium10, Perpetua, PacVue, DataHawk, GETIDA, and other comparable SaaS integrations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and make data\-driven decisions.
* Experience with e\-commerce analytics and reporting tools.
* Detail oriented with strong organizational ability to diligently oversee day to day operations of the Touchland Amazon business
* Strong analytical ability
* Excellent communication skills to interact effectively with internal teams and external partners

**Compensation and Benefits**
=============================


The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is $110,900\-$157,900\. This position is also eligible for a bonus.

  

As a Church \& Dwight US employee, you (and eligible dependents, as applicable) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid vacation and sick time, and Paid Parental Leave. U.S. employees are entitled to paid holidays, floating holidays, and vacation days starting in their first year of employment depending on hire date. You are also able to participate in our 401k retirement plan (with company match and profit\-sharing) and Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

jobs.description:
### **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

### **The Opportunity**


Are you a results\-driven sales professional with over five years of experience in managing enterprise accounts and a passion for building lasting client relationships? If so, you will thrive in our dynamic remote environment and play a crucial role in driving revenue growth as you collaborate with a dedicated team to deliver exceptional value to our clients in Cincinnati and beyond.### **About the Team**


The Advisory Enterprise Account Manager role will be part of the Sales team at Nutanix, specifically located in the greater NYC area. This dynamic and diverse team is focused on delivering innovative solutions to enterprise clients, fostering a culture of collaboration and high performance. With a mission to empower organizations through cutting\-edge technology, the team emphasizes customer\-centric service, ensuring that clients achieve their business goals through Nutanix's offerings.
You will report to the Director of Sales, who is known for a supportive and empowering leadership style that encourages individual growth and team success. The work setup for this position is remote, providing flexibility for the new hire, with no requirement to go into the office unless desired.
This role includes a required travel commitment of approximately 30%, allowing you to engage with clients and build relationships in various locations, while contributing to the overall success of the team's objectives.### **Your Role**

* Manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts to drive revenue growth and achieve sales targets.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within assigned accounts.
* Identify client needs and align solutions to meet their business objectives.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure successful delivery of products and services.
* Conduct regular business reviews to assess performance, uncover opportunities, and mitigate risks.
* Lead negotiations and close contracts while ensuring compliance with company policies.
* Monitor market trends and competitor activities to inform sales strategy.
* Set and achieve objectives for client satisfaction and revenue growth within the first year.

### **What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise account management or related field.
* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build and maintain strong client relationships.
* Effective problem\-solving and analytical thinking abilities.
* Familiarity with remote sales strategies and tools.
* Adaptability to a fast\-paced and changing environment.
* Understanding of market trends and industry dynamics.

### **Work Arrangement**


Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in\-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.
The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ 300,000 and USD $ 450,000 per year.
However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith.

Job No. R00358773 \| New York City, NY
  
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused Advertising Sales Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.

  

The Mid\-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager is responsible for owning and growing a portfolio of advertisers through strategic account planning, consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and high\-quality execution. This role combines hands\-on client engagement with broader responsibility for revenue performance, account health, and delivery excellence.


You will operate as a trusted advisor to advertisers, translating business objectives and performance data into clear growth strategies and practical recommendations. jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

jobs.description:
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused SaaS Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.


In this role, you’ll serve as the primary commercial point of contact for your assigned accounts. You will build trusted customer relationships, understand each organization’s goals and AI strategy, increase product adoption, identify expansion opportunities, and proactively address risks that could affect the customer experience or commercial relationship.

  

You’ll be responsible for developing and executing account plans, managing a healthy expansion pipeline, and coordinating internal teams to resolve customer needs. This includes identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across relevant products, features, use cases, and services.

  

This role is ideal for someone who combines consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

  

Responsibilities:

  

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

* Own and actively manage a portfolio of existing customer accounts.
* Serve as the primary commercial point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business priorities, AI strategy, use cases, organizational structure, and success criteria.
* Build strong relationships with customers across multiple levels, including users, champions, decision\-makers, procurement teams, and senior executives.
* Establish a consistent engagement cadence through discovery meetings, business reviews, strategic check\-ins, and proactive outreach.
* Create and maintain strategic account plans outlining customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, commercial potential, risks, and next actions.


Growth and Expansion

* Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within the existing customer portfolio.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, account activity, and business priorities to uncover expansion opportunities.
* Recommend appropriate products, features, commercial structures, and use cases based on the customer’s needs.
* Build and manage a healthy expansion pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasts and clear next steps.
* Lead consultative commercial conversations, including discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and deal progression.
* Partner with relevant sales teams when an opportunity requires additional commercial or technical expertise.
* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion revenue, pipeline generation, adoption, and account engagement targets.


Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long\-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.
* Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong account health and ensuring commercial risks are identified early.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback, product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring challenges to internal stakeholders.


Customer Issue Coordination

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process, including timelines, progress updates, and next steps.
* Escalate high\-impact or time\-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with Sales, Renewals, Customer Success, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.


CRM and Operational Excellence

* Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, account plans, opportunities, risks, and next steps in Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.
* Prepare account updates and communicate progress, blockers, and support needs to leadership.
* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of product capabilities, pricing, commercial policies, customer use cases, and the competitive landscape.
* Follow established sales, contracting, forecasting, escalation, and customer communication processes.

  

Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum of 4 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, or renewals.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience working with SaaS, AI, or cloud\-based solutions.

  

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Excellent executive level written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience managing mid\-market or enterprise custom

jobs.title: Account Manager, Hospitality
jobs.description:
**About Ande**  

We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use.

**About the Role**  

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join the Supply team to support client success after they go live. That means retention, growth, and the kind of relationship that makes operators choose Ande for every new location and every new initiative. You'll sit at the intersection of revenue and relationship, monitoring health signals, running strategic reviews, and building the trust that converts a live account into a long\-term, expanding partner. You are the operator's advocate, their data interpreter, and the first person to know when something is off, or when there's an opportunity worth chasing.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the post\-live revenue relationship: manage adoption, retention, and growth across an assigned book of accounts, with accountability for product usage, Net Revenue Retention, churn, and expansion
* Execute a segmented coverage model, calibrating your time and depth of engagement to revenue impact across your book
* Run proactive lifecycle management: show up before operators know they need you, at the right moments in the account lifecycle, with the right context, before friction has a chance to settle in
* Monitor and interpret product signals: track leading indicators across usage, adoption, and revenue to identify at\-risk patterns before they become churn events
* Translate what you see in the data into a clear narrative, for the operator and for your internal team
* Drive expansion in partnership with Sales: surface upsell and expansion signals early, before the operator asks and before the AE has to chase, and bring the context that makes the handoff worth acting on
* Build champions who understand the value Ande is delivering and are willing to say so

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a client\-facing revenue role
* Someone who wants to work in an AI\-first environment, who actively looks for ways to use it to do better work, move faster, and show up sharper for their accounts
* Experience managing a tiered book of business with multiple account types, coverage models, and competing priorities at once
* Comfort with data; you know how to pull signals from a dashboard, translate them into a coherent narrative, and take action proactively
* A genuine bias toward proactive outreach over reactive firefighting; you're already thinking about the next touchpoint before the last one ends
* Cross\-functional fluency; you know how to work with Sales, Product, and leadership without dropping the ball or losing the relationship thread
* Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, MixMax, Claude, G\-Suite, etc., and a general comfort picking up new tools quickly

**Bonus Points**

* You've worked in hospitality, restaurant tech, or payments; you understand the operational rhythms of a venue and what actually moves operator behavior
* You have a track record of executing in ambiguous environments
* You've worked in a high\-growth or early\-stage company and know what it feels like when the process is still being written and your job is to help write it
* You've gone beyond managing to KPIs; you've helped define what good looks like, built the scorecards, and held yourself accountable to them
* You've used AI tooling in your actual workflow, not as a novelty but as a genuine lever for doing your job better

**Why This Role Matters**  

Every venue that goes live with Ande is a relationship that needs to be earned. You'll own that relationship: the retention, the growth, and the trust that makes operators choose us for the next location and the next product. You'll have real ownership over a book of business, direct access to leadership, and the opportunity to help build the CS motion as we scale.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**  

*Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status.*


Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

jobs.description:
**City:** New York
  

**Department:** Business Development


**Recruiter:** Marcus Gipson

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


We're looking for a motivated and driven **Business Development Representative** who will be responsible for leading, managing and strengthening relationships with our bus operator partners, ensuring long\-term success, and identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion. The Business Development Representative will also be responsible for sourcing new partners to work with Flix.


This role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in business development, adept at navigating complex negotiations and fostering long\-term relationships.


**About the Role**


* Manage and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring mutual growth and profitability
* Identify and secure new partnerships with intercity bus operators and other relevant stakeholders to expand Flix's presence in the US East region
* Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, informing strategic decisions
* Work closely with internal teams, including Network Planning, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, to ensure cohesive strategy execution
* Develop processes and coordinate a variety of projects, making sure the interactions between departments are fluid and results are delivered in a timely manner
* Analyze and optimize partner performance using data\-driven insights, collaborating with internal teams to adjust network strategy and maximize profitability
* Serve as a Flix ambassador at industry events, conferences, and meetings, enhancing brand visibility and credibility

**About You**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Communications or a related field
* 3\-5 years of experience in an externally facing role (business development, sales, account management, consulting or strategic roles)
* Full of ambition, not afraid of rapid change, and able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong analytical abilities, strong negotiation skills, excellent communication skills, proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and capable of building strong relationships with various types of companies and stakeholders
* Entrepreneurial mindset, self\-motivated, and capable of working autonomously to achieve ambitious targets
* Willingness to travel, up to 20% of time

*Salary Range: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00* *USD*


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Comprehensive Wellness Coverage**\- Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).
* **401(k) Matching**– 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.
* **Flexible Time Off**\- Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.
* **Paid Parental Leave**\- 8 weeks of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.
* **Company Paid Life Insurance**– Basic company\-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account** – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle\-related services.
* **Tuition Support**\- Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.
* **24/7 Employee Assistance Program**\- Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.
* **Free Travel Perks**– Complimentary travel on FlixBus and Greyhound for you, family, and friends.
* **Work from (M)Anywhere** \- Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location,


**Why Join Flix?**


At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
  

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.


If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

jobs.description:
New York
Full\-time
Permanent employee
  
**Introduction:**
-----------------


quantilope is looking for a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our Growth Team. As an SDR, you will use a variation of channels to reach out to prospective clients to build a qualified pipeline for the US Sales team. In this role, you will own your own territory, while also pair with Account Executives on specific target accounts in order to create sustainable and scalable growth for the company. Utilizing a mixture of different software to execute your daily tasks, you will manage your own book of business while attending and participating in continuous training programs and learning \& development programs.  

  

Are you curious and want to shoot for the stars, open to giving and receiving feedback, hungry for empowerment and always taking a hands\-on approach? Well then we want to chat. quantilope automates consumer research to unlock high quality insights with speed \& ease. We’re a fast growing organization looking for the right people to join our team.  

  

Keep scrolling to learn more..**What you will be doing:**
---------------------------

* Communicate quantilope’s value and help solve problems related to market research processes
* Conduct cold calls, send emails and LinkedIn messages
* Research your own book of business in order to expand quantilope’s footprint
* Be an active participant in team trainings and certification programs
* Schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives on the sales team
* Data management and reporting in our CRM system
**Who you are:**
----------------

* Someone with strong communication skills
* You are persistent and resilient in the face of adversity
* Have exceptional active listening skills
* Self\-motivated and goal\-oriented
* A fast learner and can quickly adapt to changes
* A strong team player that lifts up others around them through their work and actions
**Nice to have:**
-----------------

* **Industry knowledge (Market Research) or Previous Sales Experience:** While it is not mandatory for you to have extensive market research knowledge or experience, it can be a valuable asset. Having familiarity with the industry or the specific product/service being sold allows the candidate to quickly understand customer needs, ask relevant questions, and engage in more meaningful conversations with potential leads.
* **Technical aptitude:** While not mandatory, having a good level of technical aptitude can be advantageous for an SDR at quantilope. It will enable you to quickly understand and effectively communicate the technical aspects of the product. This trait can be particularly beneficial when engaging with leads from the Market Research space, as it helps establish credibility and provide accurate information during the sales process.
**Benefits of working at quantilope:**
--------------------------------------

Flexible work environment: With flexible PTO, flexible working hours and remote/hybrid opportunities, we believe you can succeed from anywhere. Did we mention that everyone has the opportunity to work abroad for up to 6 weeks per year?  

* 

Ongoing learning: With our dedicated learning budget for every employee and company\-wide workshops with the best in the biz, we believe in providing our employees with all the tools they need to excel.  
* 

Wellness is key: We offer full benefits (health, dental, and vision) as well as the support of certified mental health first aiders. We also have Quantiwell days which are global mental health days twice a year where the whole company takes a day for themselves.  
* 
* Diverse \& inclusive community: Our team spans the globe, driving diverse ways of working and thinking. With the help of an incredible Community Committee, we are committed to advancing education and awareness.

Planning for the future: At quantilope, we keep your financial wellness top of mind with a 401k program and a 3\.5% annual match.  
* 
* Team bonding: Team offsites, summer and holiday parties.. .where in the world will we bring the team together next? We’re all working hard and know how important it is to have fun along the way.

  

Compensation: $67k base salary \+ Commission ($87k OTE)  

  

\#LI\-Hybrid

------------


Meet quantilope: Great people, innovative technology, and the foundation to create an impact. quantilope automates consumer research with AI\-driven solutions to support data\-driven decision making. Founded in 2014, we're recognized for our innovation and rapid growth. quantilope provide insights in brand awareness, market segmentation, advertising testing, product concepts, pricing analysis, and more for 300\+ brands.  

  

As a consumer research technology company, we know the importance of diversity not only in our data but also across our team. At quantilope, we celebrate and welcome all people regardless of their gender identity, age, sexual orientation, race, religion, or ethnicity. We strongly believe that best ideas come from sharing and collaborating across diverse perspectives and experiences.  

  

Join us and let's see what we can build together!

We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. We are seeking energetic and motivated Solar Sales Representatives and Solar Sales Teams to drive growth within our innovative EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) solar energy model. In this dynamic role, you will be the frontline ambassador for solar energy solutions, engaging with potential clients to educate, inspire, and close sales. jobs.title: Retail Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description:
At L\+M Development Partners, working together to build stronger communities is our mission. Our double bottom line philosophy means that we measure success not only in financial returns but also by the positive impacts we make in the communities we serve.
  
  

Founded in 1984, L\+M is a full\-service real estate development firm that develops, invests, constructs, and manages properties with industry\-leading innovation in a variety of urban markets nationwide, primarily in the New York Tristate Area. Recognized as one of the top affordable housing developers in the country, L\+M and its affiliate companies are responsible for approximately $20 billion in development and investment, and combined have over 57,000 high\-quality residential units in construction or that have been acquired, preserved, or completed.
  
  

**Please visit our website for more information:** http://lmdevpartners.com. To learn more about our mission and values, go to https://lmdevpartners.com/mission\-and\-values/
  
  

**Summary:**  

The Assistant Project Manager will be responsible for construction execution, tenant communication and oversight of Tenant Improvements (TI) and Tenant Allowances (TA) for all new/existing tenants. This role, reporting to the Retail Construction Project Manager, will act as the primary liaison between L\+M Development Partners and the tenant from the point of lease execution, up until the time the space is delivered, the time final documents are received, or when the final TIA payment is made.
  
  

**Responsibilities Will Include:**  

* Prepare/obtain all requested construction budgets/pricing
* Support leasing team during lease negotiations related to construction costs/issues
* Track all deals for lease execution
* Obtain tenant contact information from leasing team
* Collect all required insurance documentation from tenant/tenant’s contractors
* Develop landlord’s scope of work, competitively bid and contract for all required work
* Manage all outside GC’s or direct landlord’s GC for all required improvements
* Review and approve tenant construction drawings
* Track the permitting and bidding process by each tenant
* Oversee all tenant work for compliance with code, protection of base building systems, safety
* Monitor critical milestone dates to ensure timely completion of work
* Coordinate the close out of all open permits/inspections
* Inform leasing team upon the completion or work to facilitate rent commencement letter
* Process TIA payments
* Coordinate the transfer of utility accounts for tenants with property management


**Job Qualifications:**  

* Excellent writing skills and attention to detail
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)
* Ability to appropriately interface with executive management/leasing team
* Must be adaptable to constantly changing schedules
* Outgoing personality with good communication skills
* Excellent time management a must
* “Team Player” perspective in the workplace


Requirements
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in engineering, architecture or construction management or equivalent, relevant experience
* 10 years of directly relevant experience in commercial real estate, ideally retail
* Prior experience with document review, inclusive of certificates of insurance, contractor indemnity and lien releases
* Ability to read and understand construction drawings
* Retail real estate construction experience strongly preferred


**Additional Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* MS Word and Excel are required.
* AutoCAD is recommended
* Bluebeam


L\+M offers competitive compensation and benefits and tremendous potential with a growing residential real estate developer/builder organization.
  
  

L\+M is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
  
  

**Disclaimer:** Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.
