jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Location:
Atlanta, GA, US, 30339  

  

**Best People \+ Right Culture. These are the driving forces behind JE Dunn’s success.**


**By hiring inspired people, giving them interesting and challenging work, enabling them with innovative tools, and letting them share in the company’s rewards, we’ve found a sustainable way to grow in our industry for the last 100\+ years.**


**Our diverse teams around the country strive to enrich lives through inspired people and places everyday, and we need inspired people like you to join us in building authentic partnerships.**


**Role Summary**
----------------


The Project Coordinator will provide routine administrative support to internal and external project management team members. This position will collect, process, input, organize and file data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders in order to support the administrative, documentation, data, reporting, compliance and communications needs of projects. All activities will be performed in support of the strategy, vision and values of JE Dunn.


* Autonomy \& Decision Making: Follows directions and refers all exceptions to supervisor.
* Career Path: Senior Project Coordinator
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Core**
-------------------------------------


*PROJECT COORDINATOR – CORE*
  

* Utilizes responsibility matrix (WorkSmart) to ensure alignment with ongoing business process improvement efforts, supporting full project lifecycle.
* Collects, processes, inputs, organizes and files data and documentation from various sources and stakeholders as requested by project management team in accordance with established business processes.
* Processes information within specific timeframes in order to maintain efficiency and timeliness.
* Provides timely and effective communication to internal and external stakeholders.
* Supports project management during the bidding process, with deliverables such as creating bid invitations, preparing specifications documents, addressing regulatory and compliance requirements and creating, tracking and following up on bid communications.
* Supports project management during the award process by;

o Issuing and/or preparing bond memos
  

o Setting up, issuing, and fully executing subcontracts
  

o System access to dashboards
  

* Organizes information into standard formats and reports in various systems and locations such as the project dashboard, CMiC, electronic signature tools, etc. Maintains documents per established file structure.
* Coordinates submission of project documentation per project requirements. Prepares routine correspondence (such as letters, emails, meeting notes and proposals) and reviews outgoing materials for conformance with best practice standards and formats.
* Creates and distributes potential change items (PCIs) and requests for information (RFIs). Follows up as needed to include pricing efforts and distribution of change orders.
* Supports project management with project deliverables, such as managing information on the project dashboard and electronically processing various documents (such as submittals, pay applications, bills of sale, compliance documentation, requests for information and change documents).
* Tracks, monitors and/or collaborates with internal stakeholders to ensure necessary documentation (such as badging, certified payroll, diversity reporting, insurance certificates, bonds, lien waivers, affidavits, etc.) meets compliance requirements before releasing payments to subcontractors.
* May receive and direct incoming telephone calls and visitors or provide additional administrative support to other functions to help meet business and staffing needs.
* Shares subject matter expertise to support teamwork and deliver results.
* Utilizes discretion and integrity with highly confidential and sensitive information.
* Demonstrates commitment to the highest standards of customer satisfaction by displaying courtesy and sensitivity and responding promptly to customer needs.
* Manages difficult or emotional customer situations promptly and efficiently.
* Meets client commitments; recognizes and acts upon service opportunities.
* Solicits and applies feedback to improve quality and service.
* May support various administrative needs for the project team as needed, such as arranging team member travel, managing expense reporting, etc.
**Key Role Responsibilities \- Additional Core**
------------------------------------------------


N/A


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
----------------------------------


* Ability to perform work accurately and completely, and in a timely manner
* Communication skills, verbal and written
* Proficiency in MS Office
* Organizational skills
* Ability to work collaboratively and cross\-functionally to obtain information or solve problems in support of the team’s goals
* Critical thinking ability
* Ability to deliver quality through attention to detail
* Ability to learn and use a variety of software, tools and systems necessary to meet business needs
* Knowledge of administrative, office and general billing procedures
* Ability to build relationships and collaborate within a team, internally and externally
**Education**
-------------


High School Diploma or GED (Required).


**Experience**
--------------


* 2\+ years administrative or clerical support experience (Required)
* 2\+ years construction project support experience (Preferred)
**Working Environment**
-----------------------


* Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds
* May require periods of travel
* Must be willing to work non\-traditional hours to meet project needs
* Normal office environment, but may be exposed to extreme conditions (hot or cold)
* Frequent activity: Sitting, Viewing Computer Screen
* Occasional activity: Standing, Walking, Bending, Climbing, Reaching above Shoulder, Pushing, Pulling
**Benefits Information**
------------------------


The benefits package aligned to this position is Professional Non\-Unio

jobs.title: National Account Manager

**National Account Manager**
============================

### **Where customer relationships meet strategy, growth, and impact.**


**Location:** Remote  

**Company:** UniPro Foodservice / National Distribution Alliance  

**Team:** National Distribution Alliance — reports to the President of NDA  

✈️ **Travel:** Up to 15%, including overnight


You’ve managed accounts. You’ve built relationships. You’ve solved problems when the stakes were high.


But what if your next role wasn’t simply about managing a book of business?


What if you were the person connecting customers, independent distributors, suppliers, and internal teams — turning relationships into growth, strategy into execution, and data into decisions?

**That’s the seat we’re looking to fill.**


National Distribution Alliance is looking for a **National Account Manager** to lead the strategic growth, retention, and overall success of assigned NDA customers and member organizations.


This isn’t a “check in with the customer and update the CRM” role.


It’s a **strategic relationship leadership** role — one where you’ll develop account strategies, identify growth opportunities, manage performance and risk, lead complex initiatives, and bring the right people together to deliver measurable value.


And if you know foodservice, understand how businesses operate, and know how to earn trust at every level of an organization, we’d like to meet you.

**What You’ll Actually Own**
----------------------------

**Own the relationship.** Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for assigned customers and members, building trusted relationships from operational teams to executive leadership.

**Build the strategy.** Develop account plans that connect customer, member, and NDA priorities — including growth opportunities, KPIs, risks, and action plans.

**Find the growth.** Identify opportunities to expand relationships, increase program utilization, strengthen member engagement, and demonstrate the value NDA brings through products, services, and strategic initiatives.

**Make the numbers tell the story.** Monitor account KPIs, analyze business performance, identify trends and gaps, and turn insights into actionable strategies that improve results, retention, satisfaction, and overall account health.

**Lead the conversation.** Develop and deliver customer and member business reviews that move beyond reporting the numbers to explaining what they mean — and what should happen next.

**Drive strategic initiatives.** Lead initiatives such as SKU rationalization, assortment optimization, program implementation, communication strategies, regional expansion, and other business priorities.

**Solve the complicated stuff.** Manage contracts, renewals, compliance, relationship risks, and complex business issues. Identify challenges early and negotiate solutions that work for all parties.

**Connect the dots.** Coordinate NDA departments, member distributors, customers, suppliers, and external partners to keep strategic priorities moving from idea to execution.

**Be the executive in the room.** Prepare and deliver presentations, business reviews, reports, and recommendations that clearly communicate performance, opportunities, risks, and priorities.

**Own the customer experience.** Partner with Customer Experience and internal teams to ensure proactive communication, timely issue resolution, and a consistent, high\-value experience.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


You become a trusted strategic partner to your customers and members.


Account plans aren’t sitting in a folder — they’re driving action.


KPIs aren’t just being reported — they’re being used to identify opportunities and improve performance.


Customer relationships are growing stronger.


Programs are being adopted and utilized.


Strategic initiatives are moving forward because you’ve brought the right people together.


And when a customer or member has a complex business challenge, **you’re one of the first people they call.**

**What You Bring to the Table**
-------------------------------

### **The non\-negotiables:**

* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, with at least **5 years of progressive experience** in foodservice distribution, account management, sales, customer success, or an adjacent industry.
* Experience managing complex customer relationships and developing strategies that support retention and growth.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to analyze performance, KPIs, and customer needs and turn insights into action.
* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal, negotiation, and collaboration skills.
* The ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
* Strong organization and follow\-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly **Excel and PowerPoint**, along with familiarity with CRM and business management systems.
* Willingness and ability to travel overnight up to **15%**.

### **Extra gold stars for:**

* **7\+ years** of relevant experience, particularly managing national, multi\-unit, or enterprise\-level accounts.
* Experience in **foodservice distribution, a buying group/GPO, manufacturing, supplier, or a related industry.**
* Experience leading cross\-functional initiatives, contract negotiations, renewals, compliance, or complex account escalations.
* Experience developing executive\-level business reviews, strategic account plans, KPI reporting, and customer presentations.

**Why This Role Is Special**
----------------------------


This isn’t just account management.


It’s about being the person who understands the customer, understands the business, understands the data — and knows how to bring all three together.


You’ll work across **customers, independent distributors, suppliers, and NDA teams**, helping align different priorities

The Account Manager is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational health of assigned HPG client accounts and serves as a key link between clients, Site Leads, Security Guards, and Operations leadership. The role oversees scheduling and coverage, site operations, field communication, personnel accountability, report compliance, client service, and operational follow\-through. Account Managers are expected to resolve routine matters within their authority, maintain accurate documentation, identify emerging risks, and escalate higher\-risk issues with clear context and a recommended solution.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **Scheduling \& Coverage:** Maintain schedules for assigned account(s), identify and resolve coverage gaps, coordinate available resources, communicate schedule changes, and track recurring staffing issues or patterns.

* **Guard \& Site Lead Accountability:** Maintain active communication with assigned Guards and Site Leads; address attendance, uniform, post\-order, conduct, and performance concerns; coach and document follow\-up; and elevate matters requiring formal discipline or termination review.
* **Escalation \& Problem Solving:** Serve as the first operational contact for routine guard and site concerns. Resolve issues within delegated authority and escalate client risk, formal discipline, termination recommendations, or other higher\-risk decisions with clear facts, context, and a recommended solution.
* **Systems, Reporting \& Documentation:** Support first\-level Connecteam troubleshooting; confirm correct site, department, form, and workflow assignments; monitor Daily Activity Reports and incident reports for completion and quality; and maintain timely Monday.com, email, and operational records.
* **Training \& Client Service:** Reinforce HPG standards, support field onboarding and role training, coach personnel on communication, reporting, client service, and post orders, flag skill gaps, and maintain professional, responsive relationships with assigned clients.
* **Site Transitions \& Reporting Up:** Support account handoffs, client and guard communications, system reassignments, documentation, and follow\-up. Provide recurring updates to the reporting manager on coverage, personnel concerns, client risks, report compliance, open tasks, and operational trends.
 **Qualifications**

* Experience in security operations, account or client service, scheduling, site coordination, or a comparable field\-based service environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, coverage needs, site concerns, and routine operational issues with sound judgment and consistent follow\-through.
* Strong leadership, coaching, problem\-solving, de\-escalation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and documentation skills for working with clients, Security Guards, Site Leads, peers, and leadership.
* Working proficiency with Connecteam, Monday.com, email, and other company\-designated scheduling, reporting, and communication systems, or the ability to learn them quickly.
* Ability to satisfy applicable background screening and maintain any license, credential, certification, driver qualification, or company training required for assigned duties or client locations.
 **Physical \& Work Requirements**

* Ability to conduct regular client\-site visits and field oversight, including standing, walking, or patrolling for extended periods when operationally necessary.
* Ability to work in varying indoor and outdoor environments, including heat, cold, and rain, during site visits or interim field coverage.
* Ability to travel between HPG offices and assigned client locations and use computer/mobile technology for scheduling, communication, documentation, and operational systems.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
**Work Schedule, Location \& Availability**


This is a full\-time position generally scheduled for approximately 40 hours per week. Work may be performed from HPG’s Buckhead headquarters and/or assigned client site(s), with specific days, hours, and location based on the assigned account and operational needs. Account Managers must remain reachable during scheduled work hours and travel to assigned locations as needed.

Work Model: Hybrid – flexible in\-office and remote schedule

We are a specialized business consulting firm focused on liquidity management, corporate treasury, cash flow optimization, working capital, and financial advisory. Our Atlanta team is growing, and we are looking for a Junior Account Manager to support our client relationships and consulting projects across the region.

This is a client\-facing role at the intersection of financial consulting and account management. You will work alongside senior consultants and treasury advisors, serving industrial companies, commercial enterprises, financial institutions, and investment funds. If you are early in your career and eager to build deep expertise in liquidity management while developing strong client relationship skills, this position offers a structured path forward.

You will report to a Senior Account Manager and collaborate daily with teams in Financial Consulting, Treasury Advisory, Compliance, Data Analytics, and Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**

Client Portfolio Assistance

Partner with the Senior Account Manager to oversee a portfolio of domestic and international clients. Handle day\-to\-day operational tasks, administrative coordination, and routine reporting to keep accounts running smoothly.

Client Communication \& Support

Act as the initial point of contact for client inquiries related to our liquidity management services — including cash forecasting, working capital optimization, cash flow management, and treasury operations. Ensure every response is prompt, professional, and accurate.

Consulting Project Collaboration

Work with senior consultants to gather and analyze client financial data. Help prepare reports, executive\-level presentations, and commercial proposals. Track project milestones and flag any issues that need attention.

Client Onboarding

jobs.title: Inside Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Manager**



Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


**Transform the everyday with us!**


**We are looking for an Inside Sales Manager. This position will be based at Alpharetta, GA with 3 days per week in office.**



As an Inside Sales Manager dedicated to Siemens Digital Industries, you ensure our Inside Sales Account Managers work closely with our B2B customers to provide innovative and environmentally friendly solutions through our digital channels. You guide your team to drive overall customer happiness and are responsible to achieve annual sales growth aspirations.


**You’ll make an impact by:**



* **Lead with Growth Mindset \& Team Management**


* Leads Inside sales team in the hub ensuring alignment with regional and global sales strategies
* Provides direction, coaching, and performance management to teams.
* Oversees and manages recruitment, sales workforce and succession planning, ensuring an efficient team structure and the right skills, sales capabilities, expertise, and leadership pipeline aligned with business needs
* Oversees and drive team activity to support the adoption and implementation of established best practice processes and procedures for creating winning Sales teams
* **Sales Strategy \& Execution**


* Develops and implements a multi\-year sales strategy
* Defines business plans broken down ensuring that sales teams are effectively positioned for success.
* Aligns inside sales teams and business functions with strategy and G2M approach
* Monitors and adjusts sales strategy based on market trends, customer insights, and competitive positioning
* Ensures the adoption of digital tools, CRM systems, and sales automation technologies
* **Business \& Financial Management**


* Oversees budgeting, investment priorities, and resource allocation
* Ensures that financial goals and revenue and order intake growth targets are met
* Implements risk management strategies to mitigate commercial risks and optimize profitability.
* Regularly reviews pipeline performance and adjusts resource distribution for maximum impact
* **Customer \& Market Engagement**


* Ensures Siemens’ value proposition is effectively communicated to customers
* Leads initiatives focused on customer retention
* **Internal Collaboration \& Compliance**


* Ensures strong collaboration with cross\-functional teams involving sales organizations
* Implements governance frameworks to track and enforce compliance across all sales activities
* Implements sales reporting mechanisms and performance tracking to ensure transparency in execution
* Drives best\-practice sharing across regions to optimize sales effectiveness


**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of relevant work experience with 3\+ years of proven experience in inside sales, preferably in a B2B setup.
* Excel in team leadership and coaching, are motivated to be part of a fresh and innovative setup, and are eager to build and manage a team
* Demonstrate strong planning and execution skills, ability to lead from the front, mentor and coach team members to achieve desired goals
* Enjoy working in Sales and are inspired to see the vision for Inside Sales come alive.
* Have a customer\-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem\-solving
* See Virtual Selling as more than a buzzword: You understand the seamless integration of digital engagement (e.g., Digital Selling, virtual communication, use of social media) with customers to ensure outstanding customer experience
* You share our passion for (Siemens) technology, software, products, and services within the area of industrial automation and digitalization. You understand their value and can help customers get the most out of our portfolio. (e.g., HMI, SINAMICS, TIA Portal, Mindsphere).
* Demonstrate excellent listening skills and have an open, communicative style that conveys excitement over phone or video calls.
* Have experience managing international teams spread across different countries
* Excel in data analytics and understand how to drive performance.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equal professional work experience.
* Industrial background in Technology sales
* Prior experience using Salesforce as a CRM


**About Siemens:**



We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.


**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce:**



We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

  

As a key member of the NWSL Atlanta 2028 front office, the Executive Assistant to the President of Football, VP and Chief Business Officer, VP and Chief Finance Office and is responsible for a wide range of administrative and organizational functions supporting the NWSL executive office. The Executive Assistant (“EA”) will provide scheduling, logistical, and general administrative support, and will play an active role in key projects as directed. They will serve as liaison for communication to the office of the president and will provide personal support related to the executive’s daily routines.  



  

The EA will proactively and confidentially manage the executive’s calendar and email, coordinate and prepare for meetings and games, and support internal and external teammates and groups, representing the President and front office in a professional manner at all times. This role will report directly to the Office of the President’s Head of Executive Operations.

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is skilled at building relationships and creating winning outcomes. They enjoy working independently and with colleagues across all levels within the organization. They are flexible, proactive, calm under pressure, resourceful, and efficient. Superior written and verbal communication skills, strong decision\-making, critical thinking, sense of urgency and attention to detail are crucial to the success of this role. A high degree of professionalism, confidentiality, discretion, and customer focus are a must.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Proactively and efficiently manage the NWSL executive’s calendars; schedule appointments with internal and external individuals and groups; coordinate with other assistants and department liaisons to schedule meetings and briefings
* Serve as primary point of contact for the executive’s availability
* Maintain the executive’s email communications, internal and external contacts and other Microsoft Outlook data
* Coordinate executive travel using Concur system; provide and maintain detailed travel itineraries, agendas, and advances; submit timely expense reports and reimbursement requests on behalf of the president
* Assist with travel coordination, partnering with travel \& operations and aviation teams as needed
* Independently gather, compile and analyze information from multiple sources; prepare a variety of detailed correspondence, memos, reports, and itineraries which are generally confidential in nature. Use various PC software (Microsoft Office, Teams, Forms, Excel, Power Point, Outlook) to produce high\-quality documents
* Conduct basic research, compile information and prepare documents for presentation to executives, team members, and other key stakeholders
* Prepare for meetings, presentations, and speaking engagements including logistics, catering, audio, and IT requirements; attend select meetings to scribe, compile and distribute notes
* Receive and screen phone calls with exemplary telephone manner
* Create and maintain efficient organizational systems using Microsoft OneNote
* Seamlessly coordinate with other front office team members on a continuous basis, including preparation for meetings, activities, special events, and celebrations, including but not limited to NWSL, MLS, MLS Next Pro and other league offices.
* Serve as a liaison between the executive’s and the owner/chairman regarding meeting and event scheduling, preparation of materials, and support of the president in any required interaction with the owner/chairman
* Coordinate and provide support for the executive’s gameday suite and guests before and during NWSL Atlanta 2028 home games
* Assist with merchandise and apparel orders for departments, partnering with key stakeholders on budget management
* Assist with departmental catering needs
* Process invoices for payment through the Concur system
* Provide support for the executive’s spouse and family, as needed, including but not limited to travel, game tickets, and parking
* Provide overall support to the executive office as needed to assist with daily office/life management; may include supporting in a personal manner as needed
* Professionally represent the executive office with complete integrity and discretion

 **Qualifications and Education Requirements**

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**
* Paid time off
* Stock options plan
* Company parties
**About YARDZ**  

YARDZ is a fast\-growing technology company helping businesses better manage their equipment, rentals, assets, and operations. Our platform brings critical information together in one place, giving customers greater visibility, control, and efficiency across their organizations.  

We are a small, driven team, which means every person at YARDZ has an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We move quickly, solve problems together, and are looking for people who take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.  

**The Role**  

YARDZ is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and driven **Customer Success Manager** to help manage and grow our customer relationships.  

This is not simply a customer support position.  

You will work directly with customers to understand their needs, coordinate projects and requests, run meetings, manage schedules and follow\-ups, organize customer data, and help ensure our customers are getting maximum value from the YARDZ platform.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable juggling multiple customers, projects, meetings, spreadsheets, and deadlines at the same time while maintaining strong attention to detail.  

Because we are a growing company, you must also be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where team members often wear multiple hats.  

**What You'll Do**  

* Build strong, professional relationships with YARDZ customers
* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts
* Lead recurring customer meetings and keep conversations focused, productive, and organized
* Create meeting agendas, document action items, and ensure follow\-up items are completed
* Coordinate customer schedules, meetings, implementation activities, and internal resources
* Track customer requests, projects, outstanding items, and deadlines
* Work closely with sales, development, operations, and leadership to resolve customer needs
* Help onboard and train new customers on the YARDZ platform
* Monitor customer adoption and identify customers who may need additional assistance or training
* Work extensively with Excel and customer data
* Review, organize, clean, and manipulate spreadsheets and data provided by customers
* Maintain accurate internal documentation and customer records
* Communicate product updates, project status, and next steps clearly to customers
* Identify opportunities to improve customer processes and the overall customer experience
* Help prioritize customer requests while setting clear and realistic expectations

Take ownership of problems and follow them through to resolution  
* 

**What We're Looking For**  

You should be someone who is naturally organized and doesn't need constant direction to keep things moving.  

**Required skills and qualities:**  

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience scheduling and leading professional meetings
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable communicating directly with customers, including managers and executives
* Ability to document conversations, decisions, action items, and deadlines
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to learn new software and technology quickly
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently
* Able to work effectively within a small team
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced startup environment

Willing to take ownership and step outside a narrowly defined job description when needed  
* 

**Excel \& Data Skills**  

Candidates should be comfortable working with spreadsheets on a regular basis. Experience should include many of the following:  

* Sorting and filtering large datasets
* Formulas and functions
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot tables
* Conditional formatting
* Identifying duplicates and inconsistencies
* Cleaning and organizing data
* Comparing information across spreadsheets
* Importing/exporting CSV files

Advanced Excel or data\-analysis experience is a plus.  
* 

**What Will Make You Successful at YARDZ**  

We are looking for someone who sees something that needs to be done and takes ownership of it.  

You don't need to know everything on day one, but you do need to be resourceful, curious, organized, and willing to figure things out.  

**You'll likely be a great fit if you:**  

* Keep detailed notes and rarely let something fall through the cracks
* Naturally create lists, schedules, and systems to stay organized
* Are comfortable running a meeting instead of simply attending one
* Follow up without needing to be reminded
* Can confidently manage several competing priorities
* Stay calm when priorities change
* Enjoy solving customer problems
* Communicate clearly when something is delayed or needs attention
* Are comfortable asking questions and finding answers
* Prefer taking ownership over saying, \\"That's not my job\\"

Enjoy being part of a smaller company where your work has a visible impact  
* 

**Preferred Experience**  

Experience in one or more of the following is beneficial but not required:  

* Customer Success
* Account Management
* SaaS/software companies
* Software implementation or onboarding
* Project coordination or project management
* Construction
* Equipment rental
* Fleet or asset management
* Telematics

Operations  
* 

**Why YARDZ?**  

At YARDZ, you won't be one person buried inside a huge organization. You'll work closely with customers, leadership, developers, sales, and operations and have the opportunity to directly influence how we serve our customers and grow the company.  

We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job—we want someone who enjoys building, improving, solving problems, and growing with a company.

Flexible work from home options avail

jobs.description:
Independent Outside Sales Representative – Foodservice

**MaMajestic \| U.S. Market**  
**Independent Contractor \| Commission\-Based Outside Sales**

About MaMajestic

MaMajestic is a minority\-owned food products company supplying restaurants, hospitality businesses and other professional foodservice operators.

We develop seasonings, marinades, sauces and food mixes for commercial kitchens, with products serving applications across pizza, steak, poultry, seafood, pasta, prepared foods and specialty menu offerings.

Our portfolio includes **NY Pizza Flour Mix, Steakhouse Steak Spice, Rotisserie Chicken Marinade, Roast Chicken Seasoning, Salmon Seasoning and Bolognese Seasoning**, along with sauces, marinades and specialty products such as our **Jerk Chicken Marinade**.

As we expand our U.S. foodservice business, we are adding independent outside sales representatives to develop new accounts and build long\-term customer relationships.

The Opportunity

This is a business\-development sales role focused on restaurants, hospitality and commercial foodservice.

A major area of focus is our **NY Pizza Flour Mix**. Representatives will pursue established pizzerias looking for an elevated, consistent flour mix, as well as restaurants, cafés, hotels, bars and grills and other operators interested in adding New York\-style pizza to their menu.

For qualified operators entering the pizza category, **we support the complete setup**—from the flour mix and production process to equipment, accessories, preparation stations, kitchen setup and training. This allows representatives to develop business beyond existing pizzerias by identifying foodservice operators looking to add pizza as a new menu category and revenue stream.

The same approach extends across our portfolio. Representatives identify where MaMajestic products fit an operation, reach the appropriate decision\-makers and develop those opportunities into long\-term purchasing accounts.

Compensation

This is a **commission\-only independent contractor opportunity with no base salary and no commission cap.**

The compensation model is straightforward: **higher commission for developing new business, followed by recurring commission on repeat business from the accounts you build.**

New Account Commission

Representatives earn **17\.5% commission on each new customer's first two qualifying orders**.

When that customer completes its **sixth qualifying order**, the representative earns an **additional 17\.5% retention commission based on each of the customer's first two orders**, bringing total commission on those initial orders to **35%**.

Recurring Commission

Representatives earn **5% recurring commission on qualifying repeat purchases from the accounts they develop**, subject to the terms of the independent sales representative agreement.

The objective is to build a book of repeat foodservice business. Representatives earn strong commissions for developing new accounts and continue participating in qualifying sales as those accounts reorder.

**There is no commission cap.**

Compensation is entirely performance\-based. Earnings vary according to sales activity, account size, purchasing frequency, customer retention and the number of accounts developed.

Who You'll Sell To

Our potential customers span the U.S. commercial foodservice market, including **restaurants, pizzerias, hotels, resorts, cafés, steakhouses, seafood restaurants, Italian restaurants, bars and grills, sports bars, food trucks, caterers, country clubs, banquet and event operations, restaurant groups, multi\-location operators, commissary kitchens, prepared\-food businesses, independent grocers, butcher shops and meat markets.**

Depending on the account, decision\-makers may include owners, executive chefs, food and beverage directors, purchasing managers, general managers and other operational leaders.

Responsibilities

* Prospect and develop new commercial foodservice accounts
* Conduct in\-person, telephone and other direct B2B sales outreach
* Build relationships with owners, chefs, purchasing managers and other decision\-makers
* Understand each prospect's menu, operation and purchasing needs
* Present the MaMajestic products most relevant to each account
* Identify established pizzerias and other operators suited to our NY Pizza Flour Mix
* Identify qualified businesses interested in establishing a new pizza program
* Introduce pizza prospects to MaMajestic's equipment, setup and training support
* Convert qualified prospects into purchasing customers
* Maintain relationships with accounts developed by the representative
* Develop repeat business and additional product placements within existing accounts
* Pursue restaurant groups, hospitality operators and other multi\-location opportunities
* Maintain accurate prospect and account records

This is an outside sales role. Representatives should be comfortable prospecting independently, visiting businesses and developing their own sales pipeline.

Qualifications

We are looking for sales professionals who understand **B2B relationship selling and new\-account development**.

Experience in **outside sales, foodservice, hospitality, restaurant operations, food distribution, wholesale, restaurant supply or independent sales representation** is preferred.

Strong candidates will be comfortable approaching businesses that have no existing relationship with MaMajestic, reaching the appropriate decision\-maker, understanding the operation and identifying a genuine sales opportunity.

Existing relationships within the restaurant, hospitality or broader foodservice industry are valuable but not required.

Representatives should be self\-directed, organized, professional with customers and consistent with prospecting and follow\-up.

This field\-based position provides exposure to sales, clinical environments, and account management while building a foundation for long\-term career development.

 **About the Business:**

 **Interventional Spine (IVS)**  

Our Interventional Spine portfolio includes minimally invasive technologies designed to help physicians treat spinal conditions and improve procedural efficiency and patient outcomes.

 **IVS Product Portfolio:** Stryker \| Interventional Spine

 **What You Will Do**

* Support territory growth by assisting with sales activities, account management, and customer engagement across assigned territory.
* Prepare for and support product evaluations, clinical procedures, and customer interactions across operating room, office\-based, and procedural care settings.
* Provide product support and education to surgeons, nurses, clinicians, and healthcare staff to help ensure appropriate product use and a positive customer experience.
* Manage inventory levels, product availability, and case preparation activities within the territory.
* Track sales and territory activities, maintain account information, and support reporting requirements.
* Partner with the Sales Representative(s) to identify business opportunities and support account development initiatives.
* Participate in product training and apply technical and clinical knowledge to support customer education and engagement.

 **What You Will Need**

 **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Valid driver's license and ability to travel throughout the assigned territory including but not limited to customer sites, healthcare facilities, and business meetings.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in outside sales, field sales, business development, account management, customer success, territory management, or a customer\-facing role.
* Experience managing responsibilities through work experience, athletics, academic programs, military service, or leadership activities.
* Exposure to medical device, healthcare, clinical, life sciences, business\-to\-business sales, or other performance\-driven environments.
* Experience supporting customers in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment.

 **What We Offer**

  

At Stryker, you’ll be part of a collaborative, high\-performing team focused on making an impact for our customers and patients. We offer a dynamic environment with strong opportunities for growth and long\-term career development within a global leader in medical technology.


If you’re looking for a role where you can build meaningful relationships, grow your territory, and support innovative surgical technologies in the field, we’d welcome the opportunity to connect.

  

$70,000 salary and may be eligible to earn a bonus \+ benefits


Health benefits include: Medical and prescription drug insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, critical illness insurance, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, personalized healthcare support, wellbeing program and tobacco cessation program. Financial benefits include: Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), 401(k) plan, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), basic life and AD\&D insurance, and short\-term disability insurance. Stryker offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. Depending on customer requirements employees and new hires in sales and field roles that require access to customer accounts as a function of the job may be required to obtain various vaccinations as an essential function of their role.

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**\*\*The base salary range for this position is between 60,000\-$78,000 plus commissions\*\***

**Who We Are**


OWL Services is the premier sales, installation, program management and service provider to retail, commercial, fleet, aviation and marine, EV Charging, and emergency power generation companies across the U.S.


With 33 offices and distribution centers and more than 1,400 field service professionals, OWL delivers on a service platform that includes construction, compliance and testing, maintenance and repair, modernization and re\-imaging, and EV charging solutions to keep businesses and people moving 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.


OWL Services’ companies have received numerous awards over the years for exemplary customer service. Most recently it was the recipient of EVgo’s Deployment Excellence Award in its first\-ever class of awardees in the National EV Charging Recognition Program.


Come join us! For more information visit OWLServices.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**The Role:**


We are seeking a dynamic and hardworking **Sales Representative** to join our team and drive growth within the **petroleum service industry**. This individual will be responsible for developing, leading, and executing sales strategies that expand our market presence in Georgia \& Alabama, strengthen customer relationships, and position OWL Services as a trusted partner. The ideal candidate brings experience selling petroleum\-related products/services and has a strong understanding of customer operations in this space. This is a long\-term career opportunity with a growing company.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify new business opportunities by targeting prospects, evaluating their needs, and understanding their role within the industry.
* Use a consultative sales approach to understand customer operations, challenges, and future needs.
* Determine requirements for new products and services and introduce solutions that support customer goals.
* Maintain outstanding customer service levels while providing continuous support, information, and timely resolution to issues.
* Foster long\-term relationships with customers, ensuring consistency, follow\-through, and high\-quality service.
* Keep customers updated on equipment, technology, and service enhancements.
* Maintain accurate and organized customer files, including contact details, proposals, and promotional activity.
* Monitor industry trends, competitor offerings, and market activity to identify opportunities for growth or differentiation.
* Recommend strategies that strengthen our market position and address emerging customer needs.

**Requirements and Skills:**

* 2\+ years of sales experience in petroleum industry
* Proven success growing accounts or managing a sales territory
* Knowledge of petroleum equipment or fuel systems preferred
* Strong communicator with excellent listening and customer service skills
* Entrepreneurial, self\-motivated, and able to work independently
* Organized, detail\-oriented, and highly professional
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record
* Proficiency in MS Office; CRM experience a plus

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* 10 Paid Holidays
* Flexible Time Off
* base salary \+ commissions
* 401(k) with Company Match
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* HSA and FSA
* Disability \& Occupational Accident Insurance
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Career development through world\-class training programs

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Dean
jobs.description:
**Application Instructions:**
=============================

**External Applicants:** Please upload your **resume** on the **Apply** screen. Your application will automatically populate your resume details, and you may verify and update data on the **My Information** page.

  

IMPORTANT: Please review the job posting and load **ALL**documents required in the job posting to the Resume/CV document upload section at the bottom of the **My Experience** application page. Use the **Select Files** button to add multiple documents including your Resume/CV, references, cover letter, and any other supporting documents required in the job posting. The "**My Experience"** page is the only opportunity to add your required supporting document attachments. ***You will not be able to modify your application after you submit it*****.**

  



**Current Mercer University Employees****:** Apply from your existing **Workday** account. **Do not apply from the external careers website**. Log in to **Workday** and type **Jobs Hub** in the search bar. Locate the position and click **Apply**.

**Job Title:**
--------------


Executive Assistant to the Dean**Department:**
---------------


Dean's Office, College of Pharmacy**College/Division:**
---------------------


College Of Pharmacy **Primary Job Posting Location:**


Atlanta, GA 30341**Additional Job Posting Locations:**

*(Other locations that this position could be based)*

**Job Details:**
----------------


Mercer University's College of Pharmacy is searching for an Executive Assistant to the Dean on the Atlanta, Georgia campus. **Responsibilities**:


The Executive Assistant to the Dean provides high\-level administrative support to the Dean and the Dean’s Office, ensuring efficient operations and effective communication within the College and across the University. This position works independently under general to indirect supervision and serves as a key liaison between internal and external stakeholders. Responsibilities include managing schedules, coordinating meetings and events, handling confidential information, and other duties as assigned.

  

Duties include:


Executive Support:

* Manage the Dean’s calendar, schedule meetings, and coordinate travel arrangements.
* Prepare and edit correspondence and reports.

  

Office Operations:

* Oversee day\-to\-day operations of the Dean’s Office, including supervising student workers and managing office supplies.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for inquiries and communications.

  

Event and Meeting Coordination:

* Organize and support College meetings, committees, and special events.
* Coordinate logistics, prepare agendas, and record minutes.

  

Records, Reporting, and Data Management:

* Maintain accurate records and ensure compliance with University policies.
* Compile and analyze data for reports, including annual reports and accreditation documentation.
* Maintain databases and ensure data integrity.

  

Communication and Liaison:

* Interface with faculty, staff, students, and external partners professionally and effectively.

 **Qualifications**:


A bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university and one year of prior administrative support experience is required. In lieu of education, equivalent directly relevant experience, preferably as an administrative or executive assistant, will be considered.

 **Knowledge/Skills/Abilities**:

* Knowledge of scheduling, record\-keeping, and administrative workflows.
* Familiarity with expense tracking, procurement, and basic financial reporting.
* Awareness of FERPA regulations and institutional confidentiality standards.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, calendar management systems, and virtual meeting platforms.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and complex schedules efficiently.
* Strong written and verbal communication for drafting correspondence and reports.
* Skilled at anticipating needs, resolving scheduling conflicts, and handling unexpected issues.
* Ability to plan and execute meetings, conferences, and special events.
* Competence in data entry, document formatting, and using collaboration tools (e.g., Teams, Zoom).
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
* Capacity to work in a fast\-paced environment and adjust to changing priorities.
* Ability to build positive relationships with faculty, staff, and external stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of software systems (e.g., Workday, etc.).
* Excellent attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in documents, schedules, communication, etc.
* Ability to work collaboratively.
* Ability to compile, analyze, and present data accurately.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and make sound administrative decisions.

 **Background Check Contingencies:**

* Criminal History

 **Document Attachments**:

* Resume
* Cover letter
* List of three professional references with contact information

 **About Mercer University**


Founded in 1833, Mercer University is a distinguished private institution recognized for its commitment to academic excellence, leadership development, and community engagement. With campuses across Georgia, Mercer’s twelve schools and colleges offer a wide range of undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs. The university cultivates a close\-knit, student\-centered environment where innovation, service, and personal growth are deeply valued. Mercer’s employees are at the heart of its mission, dedicated to advancing innovation, supporting student success, and strengthening both our local and global communities through service. At Mercer, we believe in the power of relationships and the importance of in\-person collaboration. Accordingly, our employees are expected to serve in\-person as it fosters real\-time problem solving, mentoring, and the meaningful connections that strengthen both our work and service to our students and the broader university community.

**Why Work at Mercer U

jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

jobs.description:

* Facilitate and oversee day\-to\-day operations of the safe passage programs and services.
* Ensure program safety by implementing and enforcing all CPS, School Site, and Safe Passages policies.
* Immediately communicate all safety concerns and issues to Safe Passages, the Principal, and CPS staff. This should include the SGA HR Department and your Supervisor.

* Observe, document, and evaluate program staff on an ongoing basis.

* Enforce systems for student and staff documentation, including staff sign in/out logs.
* Design and maintain efficient, organized office systems.
* Manage reporting requirements, including monthly attendance, service deliverables quarterly reports, data collection, and survey administration.
* Submit appropriate requests for expenditures.
* Manage budget line items and track expenditures.
* Build strong relationships with Site Administration Coordinator and other school site support staff to support students.
* Participate in Principal meetings with Safe Passages supervisor.
* Serve as a resource to families, students, staff, and community members.
* Develop and maintain relationships with program partners and funders.
* Collaborate with personnel from relevant agencies/schools/churches/communities.
* Performs other duties as assigned.


Requirements:  



**Attributes/Skills Required/Sought:**

* Familiarity with youth development theory and best practices.
* At least two years of program coordination, preferably on an urban school site.
* Program management experience.
* Database experience; data analysis; using data to inform programming.
* Ability to develop strong relationships and work collaboratively with diverse individuals and organizations.
* Clear and effective communication skills.

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator - Skokie, IL
jobs.description:
Folio Clinical Research


Job: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator


Location: Skokie, IL (5x a week)


About Folio Clinical Research


Folio Clinical Research is a leading urologic research network treating urologic cancers, urinary stones, Peyronie’s disease, sexual and erectile dysfunction (ED), low testosterone, prostate disorders, urinary incontinence, and more. We partner with leading physician practices to create a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture, facilitating best practice sharing across our platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broad suite of clinical trials, providing significant benefits to both physicians and patients.


Position Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works directly under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) to manage all aspects of clinical trial activities. The CRC is essential in facilitating and coordinating daily clinical trial activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency throughout the trial process. This role involves direct collaboration with the PI, sponsors, and other key stakeholders. The CRC will interact with patients during the recruitment and screening process. The CRC will also facilitate the informed consent process and provide ongoing participant support as needed.


About You:

* Experienced Clinical Research Leader: You have a proven track record in managing clinical research operations, from feasibility assessments to study close\-out.
* Operational Expertise: You have deep experience managing day\-to\-day research site operations, ensuring adherence to protocol and regulatory standards
* Mentorship Skills: You have training experience and can successfully collaborate with Principal Investigators, particularly those with minimal research experience.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You always plan ahead and are proactive about having contingency strategies in place.
* Business Acumen: You execute with a sense of urgency, maintaining a keen focus on both research objectives and business outcomes.
* Commitment to Quality and Timeliness: You manage study timelines without compromising on quality.
* Passion for Innovation: You are dedicated to bringing life\-altering treatments to market, driven by patient outcomes.
* Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and regularly, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring a smooth study.
* Self\-Driven: You thrive with minimal supervision, taking ownership and responsibility for your deliverables.


Key Responsibilities:

* Regulatory and Institutional Compliance: Support the Principal Investigator and relevant departments to ensure all clinical research activities comply with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.
* Documentation Management: Maintain secure and accurate storage of all study documents, including consent forms, case report forms, and investigational material records, in compliance with both sponsor and institutional requirements.
* Study Oversight: Support the PI in ensuring the study meets compliance standards, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals, health and safety requirements, conflict of interest disclosures, and adherence to financial terms.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain regular and effective communication with Sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and internal team members (e.g., Investigators, Nurses, Medical Assistants) to facilitate study progress.
* Meeting Participation: Engage in Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and other key study meetings as required.
* Problem\-Solving and Adaptation: Identify and anticipate potential obstacles to study timelines or deliverables, offering creative solutions to maintain momentum and study integrity.
* Inventory and Equipment Management: Manage study\-specific inventory, including identification, ordering, calibration, and secure storage of equipment required for the study.


Qualifications:

* Minimum of five years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience.
* Experience with various Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of urology and other associated therapeutic areas, medical terminology, to effectively execute clinical trials.
* Deep knowledge of ICH\-GCP, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to implement these effectively throughout the clinical trial.
* Experience with data management processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data collection, entry, and reporting, in line with Good Clinical Data Management Practices (GCDMP).
* Experience ensuring and prioritizing patient safety and data integrity, embodying a commitment to the ethical conduct of clinical trials.
* Experience maintaining the highest quality standards, while focusing on ongoing process improvements that lead to enhanced clinical trial efficiency and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, both written and verbal. Can easily interface with team members and external stakeholders. Proven ability to develop positive relationships with internal teams, physicians, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic research environment.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, M PowerPoint, etc.) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS, RTSM, etc.)
* Ability to prioritize tasks, effectively manage time, and allocate resources efficiently to meet tight study deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field.

Substance use disorder continues to be a devastating public health crisis. Americans die from drug overdoses at a rate of roughly 210 to 300 people per day. In 2023, there were 105,007 total drug overdose deaths in the United States. In Illinois, 3052 residents died from an accidental drug overdose in 2023, which is more than twice the number of fatal motor vehicle accidents and more than twice the number of homicides. The increase in the number of fatalities is attributed to the rise of synth3etic opioids, such as fentanyl. Since 2013, synthetic opioid deaths in Illinois have increased 3,341%.

Live4Lali has been serving suburban Chicagoland for nearly sixteen years providing critical prevention, education, treatment access, support programs, community solutions\-building initiatives, risk reduction, and overdose prevention services to decrease the devastating toll of the opioid epidemic. mission is to reduce stigma and prevent substance use disorder among individuals, families, and communities, and minimize the overall health, legal and social harms associated with substance use.

Identify areas of greatest need across Kane/Dupage Counties on the street and within existing services (such as our Mobile Outreach Program) to connect with participants and distribute risk reduction supplies

Assist with stocking, maintaining, and delivering risk reduction inventory

Accurately log and report data collected during outreach.

Provide on the spot training and education in risk reduction, overdose response, and distribute naloxone, the opioid overdose reversal medication across the county

Identify and collaborate with a range of organizations and entities including but not limited to treatment providers, housing providers, social service organizations, healthcare providers, businesses, government agencies, etc to scale up access to naloxone

Develop and implement substance use prevention programs targeted at the community

Identify, build, and maintain relationships with community resources—including treatment providers, housing programs, social services, food access programs, and other supports—to develop partnerships and serve as referral and warm handoff resources for participants with identified needs

Identify and develop safety plans with participants who are at increased risk of overdose

Maintain confidentiality and HIPAA compliance at all times

Identify and maintain appropriate communication with team regarding issues, observations, and opportunities

Perform other duties as assigned

* Desired Qualifications

Direct service delivery experience in the community social services sector with a demonstrated working knowledge of community\-based programs and community support systems;

Demonstrated ability to establish rapport with a diverse range of clientele including individuals who are actively using substances and living with significant health challenges;

Proficiency in technology, including but not limited to Google Drive, Zoom, Microsoft Office Suite and GoToMeeting;

Demonstrated attention to detail and strong organizational skills;

Patient Experience \& Outreach Coordinator

Part\-Time \| Chicago, IL \| 9–18 Hours/Week

About Framed

Framed Eyewear is an independent optical business focused on providing a highly personalized, luxury patient experience. We are a small, growing company that values craftsmanship, professionalism, education, and genuine relationships over the traditional high\-volume retail environment.

We're looking for a Patient Experience \& Outreach Coordinator to become an important part of our growing Chicago team.

This is a people\-focused position for someone who enjoys making people feel welcome, building relationships, creating opportunities, and representing a business they genuinely believe in.

The role combines patient experience, appointment generation, community outreach, light styling, and day\-to\-day showroom support.

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including opticians, optical technicians, retail professionals, hospitality professionals, and people with strong customer\-service and relationship\-building experience.

What You'll Do

Patient Experience

Patient experience comes first whenever a patient or visitor is in the showroom.

* Welcome every patient and visitor in a warm, professional, and genuine manner
* Serve as the first point of contact for walk\-ins, phone calls, messages, and inquiries
* Help create a polished, elevated, and personalized showroom experience
* Assist with light frame styling when appropriate
* Anticipate patient needs and look for opportunities to make their experience easier, more comfortable, and more personalized

Scheduling \& Patient Follow\-Up

* Schedule appointments for new and prospective patients
* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, messages, and other patient inquiries
* Follow up with prospective patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled
* Confirm upcoming appointments and assist with rescheduling when needed
* Track inquiries and follow\-up so that prospective patients don't fall through the cracks
* Follow up with patients as appropriate before and after appointments

Community Outreach \& Business Development

* Identify businesses and organizations that may be a natural fit for Framed's patient base
* Initiate conversations with prospective community partners and look for mutually beneficial opportunities and follow up
* Identify opportunities to generate new patients through local outreach and relationship\-building
* Participate in local events and community activities when appropriate

Showroom \& Administrative Support

* Keep the showroom clean, organized, polished, and presentation\-ready throughout the day
* Restock basic supplies and showroom materials as needed
* Receive, organize, and put away deliveries when needed

Who We’re Looking For

Optical experience is welcome but not required. Opticians and optical technicians, particularly those earlier in their careers, are encouraged to apply.

* Naturally personable and comfortable talking with people they don't know
* Understands and embraces the expectations of a luxury, high\-touch environment
* Polished, professional, warm, and dependable
* Attentive to detail and understands that small details can make a significant difference
* Confident approaching local businesses and starting conversations
* Comfortable working independently
* Curious and eager to learn

* Interested in eyewear, fashion, design, hospitality, or exceptional customer experience
* Comfortable with sales and asking for the appointment, but never pushy
* Someone who wants to be part of building something rather than simply clocking in and out

Our Philosophy

At Framed, we believe luxury is about the experience, not simply the product.

We don't believe in pressure, gimmicks, or treating people like transactions. The best business growth comes from earning people's trust, not pressuring them into a purchase.

Our goal is for every person who walks through our door to feel that their time, their needs, and their experience genuinely matter.

A Career, Not Just a Job

We believe there should be no ceiling on what you can become at Framed.

As Framed grows, this role may expand in hours and responsibility, with opportunities to develop additional optical, patient\-experience, business\-development, and leadership skills. For the right candidate, this part\-time position has the potential to develop into a full\-time salaried position with significantly greater responsibility and earning potential.
