**Move Your Career Forward with DAC as an Account Manager**

 **Who We Are**


We are DAC—a global full\-funnel performance media agency dedicated to delivering transformative results. With expertise spanning SEO/GEO, paid media, creative production, analytics, and local optimization, we combine the brightest minds with innovative technology to deliver seamless, forward\-thinking strategies. Powered by AI, data, and creative ingenuity, we deliver integrated campaigns that engage customers at every touchpoint—from global audiences to individual store locations.

 **Position Summary**


We are looking for a passionate and solution\-oriented Account Manager to be responsible for multiple client accounts. The Account Manager's responsibilities include maintaining a thorough knowledge of our business and offerings, strengthening client relationships, coordinating with internal teams to deliver on client expectations, and developing and implementing strategic plans to grow accounts.

 **What You’ll Do**

 ***Client Relationship Management \& Client Satisfaction***

* Act as the daily contact for assigned clients, managing communications and maintaining strong, trusted relationships.
* Understand your clients’ business goals and pain points, proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
* Champion a client\-first mindset that consistently drives satisfaction and retention
* Collaborate with cross\-functional internal teams to ensure client needs are met on time, on brief, and on budget.
* Provide ongoing support to the account team that will enhance their relationships with their day\-to\-day contacts.
* Deliver effective and efficient documentation, communication and dissemination of
* Assist Account Leads in the development of annual account plans that meet revenue growth and profit margin targets for assigned clients.
* Demonstrate in depth knowledge of DAC’s product offerings, such as full\-funnel media, search engine marketing (SEM), search engine and generative engine optimization (SEO/GEO), local SEO, reputation management, content strategy, and customer relationship management (CRM)
* Remain knowledgeable about on\-going program activities
	+ *DAC will provide support through proper industry and platform training as needed*

 ***Project Management \& Execution***

* Manage internal aspects of project implementation including preparation of client engagement briefings and proposals, tracking client data, QA validation, and reporting of internal and external client activities and communications.
* Lead the day\-to\-day delivery of large full\-funnel media and SEO/GEO client programs, ensuring seamless execution across deliverables and timelines.
* Ensure project requirements are documented.
* Develop internal relationships with all delivery teams to ensure collaboration that delivers on set client objectives and goals.
* Support Account Directors on larger programs with executional coordination, task management, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Track progress against KPIs, deliver regular status updates to clients and internal stakeholders, and maintain overall project health via the use of internal project management tools.

 ***Scope \& Budget Management***

* Manage and track scopes of work and change orders, ensuring all work is delivered within the agreed budget and timeline.
* Effectively communicate scope implications to internal teams and clients, and negotiate updates or additions as needed.
* Maintain clear documentation of deliverables and financial parameters across your programs.

 ***Program Reporting***

* Prepare and present weekly, monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for assigned accounts with cross\-functional teams, translating data into actionable insights and opportunities.
* Collaborate with senior team members to contribute to QBRs on larger, more complex programs.

 **What You Bring**

* A creative, capable, agency\-experienced professional who takes a wide range of account\-level responsibilities in their stride, including defining short\-term goals and long\-term strategy, KPI monitoring and financial reporting
* 4–6 years of experience in a digital marketing agency or similar client\-facing role.
* Strong understanding of digital channels (paid search, social, display, local, etc.) and performance marketing best practices.
* Experience leading day\-to\-day program execution with cross\-functional teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* A strategic mindset paired with strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Comfort with scope and budget discussions, including tracking and negotiating.
* Understanding of Google AdWords, Google Analytics and other digital ad and analytics platforms
* A tenacious, positive person, who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and can easily manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Analytical skills, with the ability to see all of the pieces and how each piece fits together
* Ability to report data and to relate results to client objectives
* Good interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop positive relationships with members of various internal teams as well as clients and prospects
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Competency with MS Office products including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook

 **What You’ll Get**

* **Professional Growth**: Work with top\-tier clients and cutting\-edge tools in the digital performance marketing industry.
* **Collaborative Culture**: Be part of a global organization that values curiosity, transparency, and innovation.
* **Competitive Benefits**:
	+ Competitive salary and comprehensive health benefits.
	+ Generous PTO, wellness initiatives and parental leave.
	+ Retirement saving plans.
	+ Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
	+ A supportive, collaborative, and casual work environment.

 **How We Work**


This role requires three in\-office days per week.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Integrated Marketing and Strategy
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE**



Interdependence is a tech\-powered, integrated marketing and communications agency built around one core belief: strategy comes first.



Founded in public relations, we've grown into a full\-service partner spanning PR, social media, paid media, brand strategy and consulting, event marketing, influencer marketing, website strategy and development, and integrated marketing planning. We continue to expand our capabilities based on what our clients need and where we can make the greatest impact.



Our approach starts with our clients' goals, not a predetermined set of services. We look at the bigger picture, identify the channels and strategies best positioned to drive results, and build the right plan around them. When the best solution falls outside our own capabilities, we're willing to say so. Achieving our clients' goals is always the priority.



We combine smart strategy, experienced people and technology, including our Newsweek AI Impact Award\-winning Interviewed™ platform, to deliver measurable results. Just as importantly, we believe how we work matters. Kindness, collaboration, curiosity and accountability shape how we partner with our clients and each other. As a remote team, we're building an agency where great people can do great work, grow their careers and feel valued along the way.

  


**THE MISSION**


**Help turn client goals into organized, thoughtful marketing programs while becoming a trusted, proactive contributor to the Integrated Marketing \& Strategy team.**



Our team supports clients across influencer marketing, events, brand strategy and identity, website strategy and development and other integrated marketing needs. Account Executives help connect the client, the strategy and the people responsible for bringing the work to life.



Your job is to keep projects moving, communicate clearly, anticipate what is needed next and help solve problems before they become roadblocks. As you grow in the role, the expectation is that you look beyond assigned tasks, develop stronger client and business judgment, and take greater ownership of day\-to\-day work.

  


**THREE** **PRINCIPLES**


* **Client goals come first.** Start with what the client needs to accomplish, then help determine the channels, partners and next steps best positioned to support that goal.
* **Stay one step ahead.** Do not wait to be asked for the obvious next step. Keep the team informed, flag risks early and think about what the client or project will need next.
* **Be curious and resourceful.** You will not always have an immediate answer. Ask smart questions, research options, talk to new people and bring forward a recommended path rather than stopping at the problem.

  


**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**


* **You are not expected to arrive as an expert in every marketing channel.** Specific influencer, event, brand or website experience is helpful but not required. You are expected to learn quickly, understand how different disciplines work together and build broader channel knowledge over time.
* **You are not expected to lead client strategy alone.** Senior team members own overarching strategy, senior counsel and complex client conversations. You are expected to understand that strategy, contribute ideas and increasingly connect your work to the client's broader goals.

  


**KEY** **RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Client \& Account Support**


* Support day\-to\-day client relationships while developing a strong understanding of each client's business, goals, audiences and ways of working.
* Prepare meeting agendas and materials, participate in client calls, capture decisions and next steps and complete follow\-ups without repeated prompting.
* Translate client questions and feedback into clear direction for internal teams, asking questions when details or priorities are unclear.
* Keep account leads informed of progress, next steps, opportunities and potential challenges.


**Integrated Project Management**


* Help manage projects from kickoff through delivery, keeping scopes, timelines, budgets, approvals, deliverables and outstanding decisions organized.
* Coordinate work across account, strategy, creative, web, paid media, PR and outside partners so everyone understands what is needed and when.
* Support assignments across influencer campaigns, events, brand strategy and identity, website redesigns, consulting engagements and website builds as client needs shift.
* Identify potential roadblocks early, raise them with the appropriate team members and help develop practical solutions that keep the work moving.
* Review materials for accuracy, completeness and alignment with the brief before they are shared internally or with clients.


**Influencer Programs \& Events**


* Research creators, partners, vendors, venues and other resources that align with client goals, audiences and budgets.
* Support outreach, vetting, contracting, logistics, content reviews, approvals, product shipments, guest lists, invitations and other program details.
* Communicate professionally with creators, vendors and new contacts and confidently ask the questions needed to evaluate options or solve problems.
* Provide on\-site event and activation support as needed and remain calm, flexible and solutions\-focused when plans change.


**Creative \& Strategic Contribution**


* Actively contribute ideas during brainstorms, planning sessions and account discussions.
* Conduct research that helps the team understand audiences, competitors, cultural trends, potential partners and new approaches.
* Show genuine interest in creative work and help move ideas from early concepts through final execution.
* Begin thinking strategically about the client's broader goals and recommend ideas to the account lead that could improve the work or create greater business value.

jobs.description:
Description: **JOB DESCRIPTION**


Date: December 2025


Position: Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist (Independent Contractor)


Department: Marketing


Reports to: Executive Director


Location: 515 North State Street, Chicago


Supporting: Chicago Cosmetic Surgery \& Dermatology, Skin Science, and the Skin Spa

 **How You Will Make an Impact**

* Manage and execute social media strategies across platforms for all three brands, including development and management of monthly content calendars.
* Develop engaging digital content and campaigns for social media, websites, email, and other digital channels, adapting content, messaging, timing, and publishing strategy for each platform and audience.
* Film, photograph, edit, and produce engaging digital content, including short\-form video, across multiple platforms.
* Collaborate closely with the graphic designer to bring content concepts, campaigns, promotions, and brand initiatives to life visually.
* Develop thought leadership and B2B content for LinkedIn with guidance from the leadership team.
* Write bi\-weekly blog content for all three brands, maintaining appropriate brand voice and incorporating SEO best practices.
* Support brand initiatives, promotions, events, and launches through cohesive digital storytelling across relevant channels.
* Monitor and manage social media communities, including comments and direct messages; identify issues requiring escalation; engage appropriately; and recognize recurring questions or conversations that can inform future content.
* Ensure all digital content is accurate, compliant, on\-brand, and thoroughly proofread, with particular attention to patient privacy, medical information, provider names and credentials, treatment names, promotional terms, dates, links, and before\-and\-after content.
* Update in\-clinic tabletop and banner stands, troubleshoot Yodeck displays and monitors, develop monitor content, and create in\-room reels with music.
* Set up event marketing materials; film and edit procedures for the website, lectures, and social media; and participate in staff and in\-house marketing events.
* Manage materials and sales for twice\-yearly events.

**Performance Requirements**


Self\-directed and proactive. This role requires a high level of autonomy and is not task dependent. The Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist is expected to identify opportunities, develop ideas, establish priorities, and determine what content should be created without waiting for a detailed weekly list of assignments. They should be able to evaluate analytics, upcoming initiatives, treatment priorities, promotions, provider needs, events, seasonality, FAQs, trends, and the marketing calendar to recommend what should be created next.


Able to turn business priorities into an actionable content strategy. Must be comfortable taking broad organizational priorities and translating them into effective social media and digital content plans. Content should have a clear purpose, whether that is building authority, educating patients, increasing awareness, generating consultations, supporting a promotion, driving event registrations, selling products, or achieving another defined business objective.


Strong project management and organizational skills. Must independently manage multiple brands and content streams, including filming schedules, content calendars, campaign timelines, approvals, assets, promotions, provider availability, deadlines, and publishing schedules.


Able to lead content capture with providers. Physicians and staff should not be expected to arrive with social media ideas prepared. The Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist should come to filming sessions with concepts, questions, hooks, shot lists, and a clear plan and be comfortable directing content capture efficiently.


Able to translate subject\-matter expertise into consumer\-friendly content. Must recognize what is relevant and interesting to patients and translate provider expertise into content that is understandable, engaging, credible, and appropriate for social and digital channels.


Strong copywriting and digital storytelling skills. Must be able to write effective hooks, CTAs, captions, reel overlays, blogs, campaign messaging, and other digital copy while maintaining the appropriate voice for each brand.


Strong attention to detail and quality control. Accuracy is particularly important when communicating provider names and credentials, treatment names, dates, promotional terms, medical information, links, before\-and\-after information, and content involving patient privacy.


Able to communicate and collaborate across teams. Must be comfortable obtaining information and approvals from providers, leadership, design, and clinical teams while continuing to own the marketing recommendation and move projects forward.


Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and technologies. Must understand current social media and digital marketing practices and be able to tailor content and publishing strategies for different audiences, including Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.


Able to apply trends appropriately to a premium brand. Must recognize relevant social and digital trends and determine when and how to use them in a way that supports premium/luxury brand positioning. Content should feel elevated, calm, credible, aspirational, and approachable rather than overly promotional, gimmicky, or trend driven.


Effective community manager. Must be comfortable monitoring comments and direct messages, engaging appropriately, identifying issues requiring escalation, and using audience questions and feedback to identify opportunities for future content.


Working knowledge of CRM\-driven marketing. Must understand audience segmentation, messaging, campaign execution, and the role of CRM platforms in supporting digital marketing initiatives.


Requirements: **Education Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree

new_jobs.title: Salesforce Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team
* Coach clients on Agile practices and champion the right Agile frameworks based on the type of work
* Use effective decision making to control risk and minimize uncertainty while being proactive through strategic thinking to strive to find new and innovative ways to deliver successful results
* Implement streamlined, effective processes through change management
* Mentor and train entry level team members; play a key role in the interviewing and onboarding process for new Project Managers
* Operate as an innovative thought leader; contribute significantly to the overall growth and quality of the department through knowledge sharing and coaching on current best practices and market trends

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in technology\-focused project management
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience working with Agile teams on technology projects
* Experience managing and forecasting budgets
* Ability to provide attention to detail and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment
* Experience creating and maintaining a project plan from inception through completion
* Demonstrated success in leading multiple enterprise strategic projects from end\-to\-end
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to C\-Level management
* Excellent organizational, multi\-tasking, facilitation, and time management skills
* Excellent interpersonal skills; able to maintain solid rapport through the various working styles of team members as well as clients
* Ability to collaborate and apply critical thinking and problem\-solving skills as required
* We appreciate talent from all over the United States and are willing to consider candidates who may not be located near a Crowe office location for this role/opening.
* Bachelor’s degree

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in Agile, Project Management, or Business Process Management, highly preferred (or willingness to achieve identified certification within first 12 months of employment)
* Experience working with Salesforce, highly preferred

  

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.


In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.


The wage range

new_jobs.title: Sales Representative-Retail Accounts
new_jobs.description:
Peter Pan Novelty Company, Inc. (PPNC) is looking for a motivated, energetic, and sales\-driven **Retail Sales Specialist** to help grow our retail business.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys building customer relationships, developing new business, identifying product opportunities, and working directly with retail buyers.

You will work with both existing and prospective retail customers across grocery, value, specialty, convenience, drug, and other retail channels. From identifying an opportunity and presenting products to securing purchase orders and supporting the account afterward, you will play an important role in growing PPNC's retail business.

What You'll Do

**Grow Retail Sales**

* Manage and develop assigned retail accounts.
* Build strong relationships with buyers, assistant buyers, planners, and other customer contacts.
* Identify opportunities for new products, seasonal programs, reorders, additional categories, and expanded distribution.
* Present available inventory, new products, and relevant programs to customers.
* Work toward measurable account growth and sales results.

**Develop New Business**

* Prospect and develop new retail customers.
* Research prospective retailers and identify appropriate buyer contacts.
* Conduct outreach through email, phone, LinkedIn, trade shows, referrals, and other sales channels.
* Secure buyer meetings and present PPNC products and capabilities.
* Maintain an active pipeline of prospects and sales opportunities.

**Present Products \& Ideas**

* Prepare for buyer meetings, line reviews, product presentations, and customer visits.
* Create and coordinate presentations, line sheets, pricing sheets, assortment proposals, and samples.
* Follow up consistently after presentations and sample deliveries.
* Help move opportunities from initial conversation through purchase order.

**Identify Product \& Retail Trends**

* Stay current on trends in toys, play balls, novelty, impulse, collectibles, sensory products, squish, and seasonal merchandise.
* Research retailers, competitors, social media, marketplaces, and consumer trends.
* Identify products, themes, colors, packaging concepts, price points, and assortment opportunities that may appeal to retail customers.
* Share market insights with the sales and design teams.

**Support Customer\-Specific Product Development**

* Work with PPNC's design and product teams to develop programs for individual retailers.
* Communicate buyer feedback and customer requirements to internal teams.
* Help guide product selection, target retail pricing, packaging, themes, colors, and assortments.
* Coordinate revisions and follow\-up based on customer feedback.

**Own the Customer Follow\-Through**

* Stay informed and involved after a purchase order is received.
* Review purchase orders for basic accuracy, including products, quantities, pricing, ship dates, cancel dates, and customer requirements.
* Track important customer deadlines and communicate internally with operations, logistics, production, design, and management.
* Identify potential issues early and help coordinate solutions before they impact the customer.
* Maintain accurate account, opportunity, and project information in Monday.com and other company systems.

What We're Looking For

* 1–3\+ years of experience in sales, business development, account support, retail, consumer products, toys, gifts, novelty, or a related field preferred.
* Retail buyer or consumer\-product experience is a plus.
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Comfortable prospecting and developing new business.
* Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with pricing and customer requirements.
* Comfortable working independently while collaborating across departments.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and similar business tools.
* Experience with Monday.com, CRM platforms, or project\-management systems is a plus.
* Interest in retail products, consumer trends, toys, and emerging product opportunities.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this position means growing assigned accounts, developing new retail customers, building strong buyer relationships, converting presentations into purchase orders, identifying new product opportunities, and consistently following through on customer commitments.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for opportunities—someone who actively looks for the next customer, product, program, reorder, or sales opportunity.

Compensation

**Starting Base Salary: $73,000–$83,000 per year**

Final compensation will be based on relevant experience, qualifications, retail sales background, and demonstrated ability to develop and grow customer accounts.

**About PPNC**

PPNC is a consumer\-products company specializing in toys, play balls, squish products, novelty items, and other fun and trend\-driven merchandise sold through retail channels.

This is an opportunity to join a hands\-on team where sales works closely with product development, design, operations, logistics, and leadership to bring products from concept to retail shelves.

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $82,000\.00 per year

new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Title:** Site Safety and Operations Coordinator  

**Organization:** Boys and Girls Clubs of San Leandro  

**Location:** School–based Site  

**Department:** Programming

**Reports to:** Program Manager

**Direct Reports:** None  

**Exempt Status:** Non\-Exempt

**Position Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

**Compensation:** $23\-$30/hr

**Position Overview:**


The Site Safety \& Operations Coordinator (SSOC) is a key leader in fostering a safe, structured, and welcoming after\-school environment for youth and staff. This role ensures smooth daily operations by overseeing safety protocols, managing site logistics, and supporting staff in upholding the highest standards of care. Through proactive training, incident response, and collaboration with school and organizational leadership, the SSOC plays a vital role in creating an environment where students can learn and thrive.


This position is central to the BGCSL’s mission by ensuring that safety and operational excellence are seamlessly integrated into the program. By maintaining compliance, training staff in emergency procedures, and strengthening site security, the SSOC helps sustain a program where students feel secure and supported, allowing them to fully engage in enriching after\-school experiences.


What makes this role unique is its dynamic blend of safety leadership, hands\-on operational management, and staff development. The SSOC not only ensures compliance and emergency readiness but also plays a key role in coaching staff and fostering a culture of safety. This is a role for a proactive, solutions\-oriented individual who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is passionate about creating a safe and structured space for youth development.

**Our Values in Action:**

**Transformative Leadership:** We aspire to transform possibilities into probabilities. By embodying emotional intelligence, vulnerability, and empathy, we foster positive change with humility, authenticity, and continuous self\-improvement.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Leading with empathy and authenticity, creating a safe, supportive, and collaborative environment for staff and youth. Empowering and mentoring YDPs, providing strong onboarding, training, and ongoing development. Continuously improving safety and operations, approaching challenges with adaptability and a solutions\-focused mindset.

**Resilience:** We approach every situation with a growth mindset, demonstrating flexibility and courage, reframing challenges as opportunities. We acknowledge our current state, embrace change, and adapt as needed, maintaining a solutions\-oriented approach throughout our growth journey.

* ***What that looks like in this role:*** Leading with adaptability and a growth mindset, turning challenges into opportunities for improvement. Staying solutions\-focused and flexible, adjusting to changing needs while ensuring safety and efficiency. Maintaining confidence and composure under pressure, guiding the team through unexpected situations.

**Youth Centered Approach:** Every organizational action or maneuver is designed to directly impact and benefit the youth we serve. We value and prioritize the youth perspective, making decisions with a focus on their needs and well\-being, rather than adult convenience.

* ***What that looks like in this role:***Prioritizing the safety, well\-being, and experience of youth, ensuring all operations support their growth and success. Making decisions with a youth\-first mindset, creating a safe, engaging, and supportive after\-school environment. Advocating for youth needs, collaborating with staff to implement policies and practices that benefit them directly.

**Essential Functions:**

* **Daily Operations \& Compliance**: Oversee daily site operations, ensuring adherence to BGCSL, School Site, and District policies while maintaining a structured and efficient environment.
* **Safety Protocols \& Emergency Preparedness**: Implement and lead safety procedures, conduct regular drills, and work closely with the Director of Club Safety and Operations to align on best practices.
* **Incident Management \& Reporting**: Investigate, document, and implement corrective actions for safety incidents while ensuring compliance with safety standards through monthly inspections.
* **Staff Training \& Development**: Lead onboarding, ongoing training, and certification programs for staff in collaboration with Learning \& Development and HR, ensuring CPR and first aid compliance.
* **Student \& Facility Oversight**: Manage student enrollment, class assignments, and check\-in/out processes through MyClubHub while ensuring a safe, organized, and functional site environment.
* **Regulatory Compliance \& Documentation**: Maintain accurate safety records, incident reports, and compliance documentation while coordinating with school administration for facility access and resources.
* **Collaboration \& Communication**: Provide regular updates to leadership on safety improvements and operational needs while partnering with district safety teams to align protocols and best practices.
* **Culture of Safety \& Teamwork**: Foster a proactive, safety\-focused environment where all staff are engaged in maintaining security, order, and student well\-being.


Requirements:
**Required Qualifications \& Experience:**

* Experience: At least two years of experience working with school\-aged youth in an educational or after\-school setting (excluding daycare environments).
* Certifications: Current First Aid and CPR certification or willingness to obtain before the start date.
* Commitment: Availability for the entire academic school year, including training sessions and after\-school closeout operations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with students, staff, parents, and external partners.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities si

new_jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Division of HIV
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital (ZSFG) is an internationally recognized global leader in HIV clinical care, research and education and has grown to encompass a network of specialty clinics, multiple research and clinical trials, an HIV education program, an international research program in East Africa and a vibrant community forum for clinicians and researchers. Housed within the division is the SCOPE (Study on Consequences of Protease Inhibitors Era) and LIINC (Long\-term Impact of Infection with the Novel Coronavirus) Research Programs that focuses on clinical and translational research.  



The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will work at an independent level to assist the Principal Investigators, project directors, and Senior Clinical Research Coordinators with implementing study protocols, study coordination, data/specimen collection, data management, and quality assurance. The incumbent will recruit, screen, enroll, and follow study participants, and interact with health care providers, clinical researchers, collaborators, funders, and varied administrative and professional staff for a new project known as the PASC\-RECOVER (Post\-Acute Sequelae of SARS\-CoV\-2 Infection \- Researching COVID to Enhance Recovery) Project.  



**ABOUT DIVISION OF HIV, INFECTIOUS DISEASES AND GLOBAL MEDICINE**

The Division of HIV, Infectious Diseases and Global Medicine at the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) is an internationally recognized global leader in clinical care, research, and education. With its home\-base located at Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital and Trauma Center (ZSFG), the Division has been ranked as the top facility in the country for AIDS care since 1983\. The Division’s work is featured frequently in the media, and it is often visited by numerous international, national, state, and local dignitaries and delegations. The Division consists of approximately 38 faculty members, 11 fellows/postdoctoral scholars and 170 academic and staff employees. It is the largest Division of the Department of Medicine (DOM) at ZSFG, with a total expenditure budget of approximately $52 million dollars.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience/training
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Knowledgeable in phlebotomy issues, including working knowledge of tubes and procedures required for blood draw of clinical laboratory tests, and sample processing for T\-cell assays, flow cytometry, and other research assays; basic laboratory techniques (safe handling practices, preparing and labeling samples and reagents for studies, proper use, storage, and disposal of reagents)
  

Preferred Qualifications:


* Two years experience in clinical, community health setting and/or research setting
* California Certified Phlebotomy Technician (CPT) certification
* Conversational Spanish language skills with medical terminology
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of UCSF and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.).
* Thorough knowledge of antiretroviral medications. Familiarity with treatments for HIV\-related infections and medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for handling diagnostic specimens including packing/shipping infectious substances
* Certified Safe Shipper \- IATA certification
* Database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Experience with translational research trials, statistics and/or data management; knowledge of clinical research practices and longitudinal cohort studies
* Experience working with culturally and linguistically diverse groups
* Comfortable interviewing subjects on sensitive issues including high risk sexual practices and illegal drug use
* Knowledgeable in phlebotomy issues, including working knowledge of tubes and procedures required for blood draw of clinical laboratory tests, and sample processing for T\-cell assays, flow cytometry, and other research assays; basic laboratory techniques (safe handling practices, preparing and labeling samples and reagents for studies, proper use, storage, and disposal of reagents)
* Demonstrate excellent attendance and reliability. Work during some evening hours and/or early morning hours required
* Advertising/publishing experience a plus
* Proficient in Microsoft Office programs with emphasis on Excel, Access, Word, Savvy internet user
* Able to carry boxes and supplies weighing up to 20\-30 pounds, pack specimens into shipping containers, and deliver specimens to lab in a timely manner. Able to file heavy charts (up to 5 lbs.) in file cabinets
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:
	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)

new_jobs.title: CLIENT EXPERIENCE & APPOINTMENT COORDINATOR
new_jobs.description:
Mason Lane started Fast Lane European in 2011 after years working as a technician inside dealerships. He'd seen what European car owners deserved and too often didn't get, so he built something better — the same expertise and diagnostic capability, without the dealership experience. Audi, BMW, Mercedes\-Benz, Volvo, MINI, and more. European car owners deserve better, and that's the whole reason this shop exists.

Everything here comes down to three things: Quality, Value, and Trust. Quality means the repair is done right. Value means the customer feels the price was fair. Trust is what brings them back and gets them telling their friends — and trust doesn't start with the technician. It starts with whoever answers the phone.

That's this job. You'll be the first voice and face our customers meet, and you'll own that experience from the first phone call through the moment they walk in the door. This is more than answering phones and booking appointments. You'll ask the right questions to understand what a caller actually needs, know when to offer our Free Second Opinion review for someone who's already been quoted elsewhere, and get the right appointments on the calendar — then take ownership of the whole front\-of\-house experience once they arrive.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

Answer incoming calls and ask good questions to understand what the customer actually needs before scheduling — including offering our Free Second Opinion review to callers who've already been quoted by another shop.

Schedule and confirm appointments accurately in our shop management system.

Greet every customer warmly and make them feel taken care of from the moment they walk in.

Own the client experience in our lobby and reception area — ambiance, cleanliness, and hospitality touches like water, coffee, or tea, plus any seasonal touches or promotional displays up front.

Support our Service Consultants with data entry, customer profile updates, and follow\-up calls. (Vehicle\-specific conversations — diagnosis, recommendations, pricing — stay with the Service Consultants; your focus is the experience around it.)

Handle day\-to\-day office tasks — incoming and outgoing mail, office supplies, filing repair orders.

Help cash out customers at pickup and close out repairs in our system.

Keep our loaner vehicles gassed up, clean, and ready to go, and handle loaner agreements with customers.

Send out our text and email marketing campaigns to our customer base.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

At least a year of experience in a receptionist, customer service, or administrative role.

A professional, friendly, and welcoming manner on the phone and in person — comfortable asking a few good questions to understand what a caller needs.

Strong organization skills — you can juggle a busy front desk without dropping the ball.

Comfortable with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools.

Reliable, punctual, and detail\-oriented.

An eye for the small things that make a space feel welcoming.

**NICE TO HAVE**

Experience in an automotive, service, or trades environment.

Familiarity with shop management or scheduling software.

Bilingual in English and Spanish.

**SCHEDULE**

Full\-time, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. On\-site.

Pay: $24\.00 \- $28\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Decagon**


Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.


Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.


We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.


We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

**About the Role**


We’re looking for a field marketing manager to continue to build out our field marketing function across conferences, events, and executive dinners to drive awareness and pipeline generation. You will help shape the strategy and execution from the field marketing program. The ideal candidate has experience running field events at a fast growing B2B SaaS startup.

**In this role, you will**

* Partner closely with our GTM leadership team to execute on the right portfolio of events to accelerate demand generation pipelines
* Execute on our event strategy ensuring we’re getting in front of the right audience, generating leads, and reaching out to leads in a timely manner
* Extend the Decagon brand across different event formats including conferences, executive dinners, webinars, product launch events, and more
* Define and measure field marketing success through key performance indicators (KPIs) such as ROI, lead generation, pipeline influence, and sales engagement.
* Own the outcome of the leads generated and driving high ROI of our events

**Your background looks something like this**

* 3\-5 years of experience planning and executing and hosting sponsored events
* 1\-2\+ years of field marketing experience with a B2B SaaS / enterprise software startup
* Excellent attention to detail and operational rigor
* The ability to span events across tradeshows, webinar/virtual, and customer dinners
* The ability to span events across awareness (building awareness of Decagon’s brand and getting in front of new leads) and demand generation (driving demos booked)
* Experience and affinity for evolving projects and experiments into repeatable programs
* Outstanding project management skills, the ability to organize and manage multiple priorities, working relationships, cross\-functional partners, and vendors while driving timelines and owning the outcome
* Familiarity with sales processes and systems
* The ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 40%

**Benefits**


We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees:

* Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family
* Life Insurance and Disability Benefits
* Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)
* Parental Leave
* Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot
* Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance
* Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best
* Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

*These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.*


Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we're looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high\-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.



The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight\-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross\-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow\-through.


**JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Territory Strategy \& Business Performance**


* Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
* Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
* Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high\-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
* Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.


**Strategic Account Management \& Network Development**


* Identify, prioritize, and develop high\-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
* Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision\-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
* Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow\-through.
* Map influence and decision\-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
* Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.


**Clinical Aptitude \& Customer Engagement**


* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
* Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
* Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
* Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Influence \& Impact**


* Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
* Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change\-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
* Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries


**Customer, Patient \& Caregiver Impact**


* Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
* Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow\-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
* Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
* Identify recurring customer, access, and patient\-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Field Insights**


* Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services,

new_jobs.description:
**About Handshake**
===================


Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.


In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.

**Why join Handshake now:**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue

  

**About the Role**
==================


Account Management at Handshake owns **Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), renewals, and expansion revenue** across our customer base.


As an **Account Manager, SMB / Mid\-Market**, you'll own the commercial relationship and growth strategy for a portfolio of approximately **75–130 customers**, acting as a strategic commercial owner rather than a contract\-execution renewal rep. You’ll be accountable for retaining and growing revenue while helping customers maximize the value of their partnership with Handshake.


You’ll partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, RevOps, Product, Support, Finance, and Legal to develop account strategies, mitigate risk, navigate complex customer needs, and identify opportunities to deepen and expand customer relationships.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing **strategic account management, consultative selling, customer advocacy, and operational rigor**. You’ll manage customers at different stages of their lifecycle and prioritize your time based on retention risk, expansion potential, and overall business impact.

* Own commercial strategy across a portfolio of approximately 75–130 SMB and/or Mid\-Market customers, with accountability for GRR, NRR, renewals, and expansion performance
* Develop and execute strategic account plans that identify customer priorities, business outcomes, retention risks, expansion opportunities, and paths to long\-term growth
* Proactively manage the renewal lifecycle from early strategy and stakeholder alignment through negotiation and close
* Lead commercial negotiations involving pricing, packaging, contract terms, multi\-year agreements, and complex renewal scenarios
* Identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities across additional licenses, products, and multi\-product offerings to increase NRR
* Build multi\-threaded relationships with champions, decision\-makers, and executive stakeholders to reduce churn risk and unlock growth
* Partner closely with Customer Success to connect product adoption and demonstrated customer value to renewal and expansion strategies
* Lead strategic customer conversations focused on business priorities, ROI, future needs, and opportunities to expand the partnership
* Proactively identify accounts at risk and develop clear retention and mitigation strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders
* Navigate complex customer situations—including competitive evaluations, budget pressure, organizational changes, product concerns, and procurement—with sound commercial judgment and customer empathy
* Maintain a clear understanding of portfolio health, including renewal status, expansion pipeline, account risk, stakeholder engagement, and growth potential
* Own accurate and timely forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity hygiene across revenue systems
* Prioritize your portfolio effectively, balancing high\-touch strategic engagement with scalable account management motions
* Surface customer insights and trends to Product, Sales, Customer Success, and leadership to help improve our product and go\-to\-market strategy
* Contribute to the continued evolution of Account Management by sharing best practices and identifying opportunities to improve processes, playbooks, segmentation, automation, and operating rhythms

  

**Desired Capabilities**
========================

* 2\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Renewals, or another customer\-facing B2B SaaS role
* 1\+ years owning commercial outcomes such as renewals, expansion, upsell, cross\-sell, or revenue retention
* Track record managing and growing a portfolio of B2B SaaS customers and associated ARR
* Proven ability to lead renewal and expansion opportunities from strategy through negotiation and close
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance customer needs with business objectives
* Experience identifying customer risk and developing strategies to protect and improve retention
* Experience managing pipeline and producing accurate forecasts against retention and/or expansion targets
* Ability to build credibility and influence across multiple levels of a customer organization, including senior stakeholders and decision\-makers
* Strong prioritization and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple customer opportunities and deadlines simultaneously
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to navigate strategic, commercial, and difficult customer conversations
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, Finance, Legal, and RevOps

  

***Extra Credit***
==================

* Experience managing SMB and/or Mid\-Market SaaS customers with responsibility for both retention and expansion
* Experience carrying a renewal, expansion, or revenue quota and con

Martindale\-Avvo Leads Division is seeking a sales‑oriented, consultative Account Manager to retain and grow a book of \~200 legal clients. You will act as a trusted advisor, onboard new clients for long‑term success, run data‑driven performance reviews, and drive revenue through strategic upsells while proactively minimizing churn.
Key responsibilities:* Own a portfolio of \~200 law‑firm and legal‑service clients, building strong, long‑term relationships.
* Onboard new clients: set up accounts, establish goals, and ensure successful adoption of products/services.
* Conduct regular, data\-driven performance reviews, leveraging AI\-assisted insights where appropriate to measure ROI, identify opportunities, and recommend optimizations.
* Drive revenue growth through consultative upselling and cross‑selling of relevant Martindale‑Avvo solutions.
* Proactively monitor client health signals and intervene to prevent churn.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Marketing to escalate issues, share feedback, and improve the client experience.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM and prepare clear reporting for leadership.


What success looks like:* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to translate data into clear, actionable insights.
* Measurable upsell/cross‑sell revenue and growth in client lifetime value.
* Strong client satisfaction and adoption metrics (NPS, product usage, goal attainment).
* Consistent, timely delivery of performance reviews and action plans.


Qualifications:* Understand the use of AI tools to work more efficiently, identify account opportunities faster, and spend more time on high\-value client interactions.
* 3\+ years in account management, client success, or consultative sales—experience with legal industry clients strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to manage and grow a portfolio of accounts.
* Comfortable with numbers and using data to drive recommendations.
* Strong problem‑solving skills and a proactive, client‑first mentality.
* Organized, self‑directed, and able to prioritize across a large book of business.


Nice to have* Familiarity with Martindale‑Avvo products or similar legal marketing platforms
* Experience with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and email tools such as Outreach

At Internet Brands, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the rate for this role to be at $21\.64/hourly plus commission and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.  

  

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well\-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, and life and AD\&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, commuter benefits as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well\-being coaching services. In addition, employees can take advantage of voluntary benefits such as home, auto and pet insurance, and discounted legal and financial services. For more details, feel free to inquire during the interview process.  

  

Internet Brands®, headquartered in El Segundo, Calif, is a fully integrated online media and software services company focused on four high\-value vertical categories: Health, Automotive, Legal, and Home/Travel. The company's properties and platforms include the WebMD, Medscape, and Henry Schein ONE networks, which are the global leaders in their markets; Nolo, Avvo, and Martindale, which form the largest consumer information provider in the legal market; and CarsDirect, Fodor's Travel, and many others which are leaders in their key vertical markets. Internet Brands' award\-winning consumer websites lead their categories and serve more than 250 million monthly visitors, while a full range of web presence offerings has established deep, long\-term relationships with SMB and enterprise clients. The company's powerful, proprietary operating platform provides the flexibility and scalability to fuel the company's continued growth. Internet Brands is a portfolio company of KKR and Warburg Pincus.  

  

Internet Brands is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations, including the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance (FCIHO).

new_jobs.title: GTM Engineer (Revenue Operations)
new_jobs.description:
**About Flow**  

Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.

**About the role**  

Flow is seeking a GTM Engineer to build and run the systems behind how we find, win, and grow customers. Our customers are hardware teams in aerospace, defense, automotive, and adjacent industries, and our sales motion reflects that: long evaluation cycles, multiple stakeholders across engineering and procurement, and pilots that expand into full deployments. Getting the right data, tooling, and process in place is what lets a small team run that motion well.


This role sits between sales, marketing, customer success, and leadership. You will own our GTM stack end to end, automate the work that slows the team down, and turn pipeline and customer data into something the whole company can trust and act on.

**What you'll do**

* Own and evolve our GTM stack, including CRM, enrichment, sequencing, and analytics tools, and the integrations that connect them.
* Build automated workflows for prospecting, lead routing, enrichment, and account research, using APIs, scripting, and AI tooling where it makes the team faster.
* Design and maintain our pipeline structure, deal stages, and data model so that forecasting and reporting reflect what is actually happening in the business.
* Build dashboards and reporting on pipeline health, conversion, sales cycle, and pilot\-to\-deployment expansion for the GTM team and leadership.
* Partner with sales and customer success to identify friction in how deals move and translate it into process or tooling changes.
* Support planning work such as territory and account segmentation, target account lists, and quota and capacity modeling as the team grows.
* Keep data clean and consistent across systems, including deduplication, field hygiene, and clear ownership of records.

**About you**

* 3\+ years in revenue operations, GTM engineering, sales operations, or a similar role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company selling to enterprise customers.
* Hands\-on experience administering a CRM and building automations and integrations across a GTM stack.
* Comfortable writing code or scripts (Python, JavaScript, SQL, or similar) to connect systems and move data when no\-code tools fall short.
* Strong analytical skills, with experience building reporting that leaders actually use to make decisions.
* Able to work directly with sellers and understand the realities of a complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycle.
* Comfortable in a high\-ownership environment where you scope, build, and support your own systems.

**Nice to have**

* Experience at an early\-stage startup building GTM infrastructure from the ground up.
* Familiarity with selling into defense, aerospace, or other regulated industries, including longer procurement cycles.
* Experience using LLMs or AI agents to automate research, enrichment, or outbound workflows.


Compensation Range: $175K \- $235K

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About OpenMind**
------------------


OpenMind builds the brain and infrastructure for robots that work alongside people. Our OS runs across quadrupeds, humanoids, and wheeled platforms, and we deploy them into real operations. We are a fast\-growing team backed by leading investors, and we are moving robots out of our lab and into paying deployments.

**About the Role**
------------------


As our Sales Development Representative, you will build the top of OpenMind's sales pipeline. You will find the organizations that need robots, start the conversation, qualify the opportunity, and work with our Business Development team to close it. You will work cross\-functionally and will help shape how we sell into new markets.

**What You Will Do**
--------------------

* Build and execute outbound campaigns into our priority markets
* Research target accounts and run multi\-channel outreach
* Qualify opportunities on use case, budget, decision process, and timeline
* Own the accuracy of the CRM for every account you touch
* Feed buyer objections and market signals back to the product and marketing teams
* Hit weekly and monthly targets for qualified meetings and pipeline generated

**What We Are Looking For**
---------------------------

* Strong written communication; you can write a cold email that gets a reply
* High output and resilience; you are comfortable with volume and rejection
* Curiosity about robotics and AI, and the ability to explain why a robot solves a specific operational problem
* Self\-direction in a fast\-moving, ambiguous environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience


Compensation Range: $60K \- $90K

new_jobs.title: Specialty Sales Representative
new_jobs.description:
The Sales Representative is responsible for driving appropriate utilization and growth of assigned therapies within a defined geography by developing strategic customer relationships, executing account plans, navigating complex access environments, and collaborating with client counterparts. The Sales Representative serves as a trusted partner to healthcare providers, health systems, pharmacies, and other stakeholders to improve patient outcomes and ensure access to innovative therapies.

  

The Sales Representative demonstrates strong business acumen, customer focus, market expertise, and accountability while effectively collaborating across functions to deliver value for customers, patients, and the organization.

 **Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:
* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company\-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions

It's more than a job; it's a calling. It's where passion meets purpose. ADAPT Community Network, formerly United Cerebral Palsy (UCP) of NYC provides a multitude of services to people with developmental disabilities. At ADAPT, we are 3,000 strong, and it takes every one of us to empower the lives of the people we support. With caring and great resources at hand, we know what it takes to help people live fuller, happier, healthier lives. Our employees show their commitment to the people we support every day, and we all deliver on our promise to provide innovative and comprehensive services to individuals with developmental disabilities.


For your next career move, apply with us at ADAPT Community Network! Wherever you work among our many locations around New York City, ADAPT offers paid training, competitive benefits, and we foster a team culture of learning, support, collaboration and career growth.

**SUMMARY**


Under the general direction of the program director or designee, the Residence Program Specialist is responsible for supporting the care, development, and independence of individuals living in an ADAPT Community Network residential facility. The Residence Program Specialist provides direct support, skill\-building, and advocacy to ensure that the people we support achieve their personal goals and enjoy the highest quality of life possible.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


The duties and responsibilities of the Residential Program Specialist will include, but are not limited to the following:

* Provides care and supports the people we support in achieving greater independence and personal development.

* Teaches and assists with activities of daily living (ADLs), including self\-help, social, and community living skills.
* Maintains a personalized, homelike, and respectful atmosphere within the residence.
* Participates actively in interdisciplinary treatment plans and implements individualized program goals.
* Documents daily activities, progress notes, incident reports, and other required records accurately and in a timely manner.

* Contacts emergency personnel (police, fire, ambulance) when necessary to ensure safety of the people we support and staff.

* Provides transportation for the people we support to program, work, appointments, and recreational activities as needed.
* Assists with meal planning, grocery shopping, and meal preparation to promote nutrition and independence.

* Promotes dignity, respect, and person\-centered approaches in all interactions with the people we support, families, and staff.

* Performs other related duties as assigned.

* High School Diploma or GED required.

* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for working effectively with the people we support, families, coworkers, and community partners.
* Ability to respond appropriately to crisis situations and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and safeguarding the rights of the people we support.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

**Discover your next career at** **Mygrant Glass****!** **About Us:** **Mygrant Glass** was established in 1926, we've journeyed from a single location in California to becoming the largest independent wholesale distributor of automotive glass in the United States. Our enduring success is built on a foundation of unparalleled inventory, an extensive warehouse network, and uncompromising quality standards. We thrive on forming lasting partnerships that drive the success of our valued customers.**Account Manager****Exempt****Reports To: Regional Sales Director**  

 Compensation: Pay range for position is $90,000\-$105,000 based on experience. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS**:* Accurately present the “Mygrant message” to current and prospective customers.
* Participate with management in updating territory plans and setting sales goals.
* Identify emerging markets and market shifts.
* Analyze sales potential for new and existing customers through inquiry, observation or research to grow market share.
* Travel in the respective territory utilizing time and territory management skills to promote Mygrant products and services, identify customer needs, and to develop and improve company's relationship with customers.
* Engage and partner with clients to determine a competitive offering of the company's products and services while implementing company’s sales strategies.
* Interface with clients to pinpoint and overcome potential obstacles such as competition, pain points, budgets, and timelines.
* Communicate closely with Branch Manager and sales team on customer opportunities, status, proposals, and service levels, and make recommendations regarding same.
* Assist customers with special requests and problems (supply information, resolve complaints, etc.).
* Communicates information across internal teams with recommendations that will contribute to the development of brands, sales growth, and distributor effectiveness.
* Continuously update company’s CRM program.
* Additional duties may be assigned.

 **SPECIAL KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, ABILITIES**  

* Exceptional team player with organizational astuteness to prioritize, and multi\-task.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented
* Customer\-facing experience, working with auto parts/auto glass customers is a plus
* Solid organizational \& planning skills with attention to detail
* Ability to build strong relationships with a variety of customer types and co\-workers
* Strong aptitude for consultative selling
* Prior usage of CRM tools
* Solid interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written
* Frequent travel (20% or more of time)

 **QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS**  

* A Bachelor’s degree, or a combination of successful equivalent work experience and education, is strongly preferred
* 3 years of professional experience working in sales
* Valid driver’s license, and insurable under Company’s auto policy.

 **Join our team:**  

We are a passionate and close\-knit community of individuals who believe in the power of teamwork and provide friendly, knowledgeable, and prompt service. At **Mygrant Glass**, we don't just offer jobs; we offer opportunities to nurture your career with one of the nation's leading wholesale auto glass companies. **Benefits:**  

Health Insurance Flexible Spending Plan Health Savings Plan Dental Insurance Voluntary life insurance
