new_jobs.title: Mid-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
Advertising Sales Representative Team Lead/Consultant \| Mid\-Level \| Full time
Job No. R00358773 \| New York City, NY
  
Within Operations, we are expanding our Digital Inside Sales (DIS) organization to accelerate growth in the SaaS, AI and digital solutions space. Our innovative, data\-driven sales model combines trusted technical expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and AI\-powered insights to help clients transform and scale efficiently. We’re looking for a commercially driven and customer\-focused Advertising Sales Account Manager to manage a portfolio of existing customers.

  

The Mid\-Market Advertising Sales Account Manager is responsible for owning and growing a portfolio of advertisers through strategic account planning, consultative selling, disciplined pipeline management, and high\-quality execution. This role combines hands\-on client engagement with broader responsibility for revenue performance, account health, and delivery excellence.


You will operate as a trusted advisor to advertisers, translating business objectives and performance data into clear growth strategies and practical recommendations. Success requires sound commercial judgement, confidence engaging senior stakeholders, strong ownership of complex work, and the ability to influence outcomes in a fast\-paced, metrics\-driven environment.

  

What You Will Be Doing

  

Strategic Account Ownership \& Customer Engagement

* Own a portfolio of advertisers and serve as the primary commercial and strategic point of contact throughout the account lifecycle
* Develop account plans that identify growth opportunities, risks, client objectives, and clear actions to improve revenue, retention, and advertiser value
* Build trusted relationships with client decision\-makers and confidently lead consultative conversations, performance reviews, and recommendations
* Drive proactive outreach through calls, email, and scheduled follow\-ups, balancing activity expectations with the quality and complexity of each opportunity
* Diagnose advertiser needs and recommend tailored advertising products, campaign strategies, and optimization actions aligned with business goals
* Lead complex or sensitive account discussions, resolve issues, and coordinate the appropriate internal support to protect the client relationship
* Identify expansion, cross\-sell, and retention opportunities using performance trends, market context, and commercial insight
* Partner with sales, product, operations, and support teams to deliver a consistent end\-to\-end advertiser experience

  

Pipeline, Forecasting \& Commercial Discipline

* Maintain a structured, accurate, and strategically prioritized pipeline within Salesforce or an equivalent CRM
* Own revenue pacing and forecast quality for assigned accounts, identifying gaps early and developing recovery or acceleration plans
* Apply sound judgement to prioritize opportunities, client needs, and daily activities against commercial impact
* Meet agreed activity, conversion, revenue, retention, and service\-level expectations while maintaining a high standard of customer engagement
* Ensure clear documentation of client objectives, decision criteria, commercial opportunities, risks, commitments, and next steps
* Use account and pipeline data to provide concise updates, surface trends, and recommend actions to leadership
* Independently manage competing priorities and escalate material risks with clear context and proposed solutions

  

Quality, Leadership \& Continuous Improvement

* Set a strong standard for customer interactions across calls, meetings, and written communication
* Ensure all work complies with agreed processes, turnaround times, quality controls, and data and privacy requirements
* Translate recurring client feedback and performance trends into actionable recommendations for leadership and partner teams
* Identify operational inefficiencies, shape practical improvements, and support implementation of more scalable ways of working
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance, peer support, and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members without direct people\-management responsibility
* Support onboarding, calibration, and best\-practice sharing across the team as required
* Represent Accenture professionally and act as a credible, customer\-centric advocate in all internal and external interactions

  
Basic Qualifications

  

* Minimum 4 years of experience in Advertising Sales or Advertising Account Management

  


Preferred Qualifications

  

* Demonstrated ownership of a client portfolio, revenue target, sales pipeline, or account\-growth plan
* Proven ability to lead consultative client conversations, influence decisions, and
* convert data into clear commercial recommendations
* Experience managing complex client needs, competing priorities, and escalations with limited supervision
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence presenting to senior client and internal stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to identify trends, assess risk, and recommend action
* High proficiency in CRM usage, pipeline management, forecasting, and accurate account documentation
* Experience in digital advertising, media sales, SaaS, ad technology, or platform\-based environments
* Working knowledge of digital campaign performance, optimization levers, measurement, and advertising industry trends
* Experience with Salesforce and sales engagement, reporting, or business intelligence tools
* Demonstrated experience coaching peers, supporting onboarding, or contributing to team capability development
* Experience operating in a matrixed environment and coordinating across sales, product, operations, and support teams
* Commercially minded, customer\-centric, and focused on measurable outcomes
* Confident operating with autonomy, ambiguity, and accountability
* Resilient and composed when managing challenging conversations or perfor

new_jobs.title: Twitch Account Manager, Twitch
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Ads offers a rich array of advertising solutions to reach Amazon customers on Amazon.com, across our other owned and operated sites, including Twitch, and on other high quality sites across the web. If you’re interested in joining a rapidly growing organization working to build a unique, world\-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you’ve come to the right place.  

  

The Twitch Account Manager serves as the primary point of contact for advertising solutions on Twitch, managing the full advertising funnel from pre\-sale consultation through campaign execution and reporting. This role combines strategic planning, client relationship management, and project management to deliver exceptional advertising experiences on the Twitch platform.  

  

We're looking for a results\-driven Twitch Account Manager who is passionate about creating and executing innovative advertising solutions and building strategic partnerships with brands. As an Account Manager at Twitch, you'll be instrumental in navigating complex advertising challenges, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering measurable results that exceed client expectations.  

  

You'll own end\-to\-end client relationships, leveraging Twitch's unique platform insights to develop and execute customized advertising strategies that drive revenue. You'll work collaboratively across multiple teams including Sales, Product, and Brand Partnerships to develop and execute RFPs and proactive proposals. As the main point of contact both internally and with customers, you'll oversee projects from ideation through final execution.  

  

This highly dynamic role requires someone who can balance strategic thinking with tactical execution, managing the full advertising funnel from pre\-sale consultation through campaign delivery and analysis. Your digital marketing expertise and ability to navigate the unique landscape of live\-streaming content will be crucial in delivering value to our advertisers and contributing to Twitch's continued growth in the advertising space.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Drive Twitch advertising solutions by providing comprehensive pre\-IO support and consultation in partnership with Twitch Account Executive
* Develop and present strategic proposals with Twitch ad product recommendations
* Forecast inventory and develop targeting strategy recommendations
* Create compelling KOC decks featuring concepts, influencer recommendations, and production timelines
* Lead communication between clients and internal teams to finalize campaign concepts
* Generate new business opportunities in partnership with Twitch Account Executives
* Manage creator sponsorships and Twitch promotional products
* Provide real\-time campaign troubleshooting and optimization
* Ensure compliance with advertiser's brand safety requirements
* Evaluate KPIs and optimize campaign delivery and performance using a data driven approach
* Deliver campaign performance reports and conduct wrap\-up calls with clients
* Drive incremental revenue and increase advertiser satisfaction
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C\-level executives and cross\-functional teams
* Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
* Experience in a customer\-facing role, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies
* Experience leading process improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, advertising, business or equivalent
* Experience meeting quotas and growing revenue
* Experience managing brand intergrations in live envionments

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments, restricted stock units (RSUs), and sales incentives. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

  

USA, NY, New York \- 85,800\.00 \- 150,100\.00 USD annually

new_jobs.title: Executive Ambassador Program Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Chase is a leader in banking, credit card and wealth management services, helping nearly one out of every two American households make the most of their money.


As an Executive Ambassador Programs Operations Associate within Consumer and Community Banking you will help senior leaders build their public profiles through social thought leadership, advancing the firm's strategy and culture. The role supports a high\-profile roster of Consumer \& Community Banking executives and partners closely with executive communicators, content teams, legal and external communications to ensure program execution is timely and compliant. Reporting to the Vice President, Executive Ambassador Program Lead, the Executive Ambassador Program Operations Associate serves as the operational backbone of the program, managing key workflows, anticipating issues, maintaining accurate records and providing high\-quality support in a fast\-paced executive communications environment.




**Job responsibilities**


* Manage recurring program workflows, calendars, trackers and status updates across the executive cohort, maintain onboarding and offboarding materials, permission forms, access records, executive lists and communicator preferences and coordinate onboarding logistics and support smooth transitions when executives or communicators join, leave or change roles
* Maintain and update playbooks, templates, process documentation and training materials, coordinate weekly content batches, previews, reviews, edits, executive approvals and scheduling and manage end\-to\-end publishing in Sprinklr, including quality checks, status tracking and closed\-loop communication with executive communicators.
* Apply LinkedIn best practices and program standards while flagging content that requires strategic, legal or leadership review and maintain legal approval logs and audit evidence when legal review is required
* Support daily monitoring of executive posts and comments during established coverage hours, draft recommended responses and reactions for executive communicator review, reflecting the executive's preferences and voice and coordinate timely follow\-up with executive communicators and escalate customer complaints, sensitive comments or time\-critical issues through the appropriate process.
* Maintain records, escalation documentation and executive preference guidance, maintain audit\-ready records of approvals, publishing activity, monitoring and escalations; Produce accurate monthly, quarterly and year\-to\-date reporting on publishing, reach, engagement, follower growth and participation
* Conduct quality checks, identify data issues and coordinate resolution with platform or reporting partners; Turn performance data into practical recommendations for content, cadence and executive engagement, support procedure updates, control testing, evidence collection and recertification activities and follow applicable social media, legal, privacy and records\-management requirements.
* Build trusted working relationships with executive communicators, social and content teams, PR, video, paid media, controls and legal partners, escalate process gaps, unclear ownership or potential risks promptly and communicate priorities, deadlines, dependencies and status clearly.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve service quality.
* Support trainings, office hours, program meetings and ad hoc initiatives as needed.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**


* 3\+ years of relevant experience in social media operations, employee advocacy, executive communications, program management or a related field.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple high\-priority workflows independently.
* Strong writing, editing and stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience with social media publishing, monitoring and analytics tools, including Sprinklr and LinkedIn analytics.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel, including reporting and data quality review.
* Proven ability to build credibility with senior executives and executive\-level stakeholders, exercising sound judgment, discretion, attention to detail and professionalism when handling sensitive information.
* Ability to follow defined controls while recognizing when a situation requires escalation.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Experience in financial services or another regulated industry.
* Working knowledge of legal, compliance and records\-management requirements for social media.
* Experience supporting executive social media or thought leadership programs.
* Basic design or multimedia skills in Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

Chase is a leading financial services firm, helping nearly half of America's households and small businesses achieve their financial goals through a broad range of financial products. Our mission is to create engaged, lifelong relationships and put our customers at the heart of everything we do. We also help small businesses, nonprofits and cities grow, delivering solutions to solve all their financial needs.


We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.

new_jobs.description:

Applicants selected to move forward will complete a short Your Opportunity Co. **Smart Assessment** featuring realistic scenarios based on the work involved in the role.

Candidates who perform well will be introduced to the Cozy Homies team for the next stage of the hiring process and employed by Cozy Homies.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Cozy Homies is looking for someone creative, resourceful, and plugged into social media who can help promote the brand, its products, events, and in\-store experiences.

This person will support the day\-to\-day execution of social media and promotional initiatives, helping turn ideas into content and campaigns that drive awareness, engagement, and traffic.

What You’ll Do

* Help plan and create social media content for the Cozy Homies brand
* Develop creative ideas for promoting products, events, launches, and in\-store activations
* Write captions, promotional copy, and other social content
* Help coordinate content across social media, email, and in\-store promotions
* Support influencer and partnership initiatives
* Engage with customers and help manage the brand’s online community
* Monitor social performance and identify ways to improve engagement and conversions
* Help respond quickly when promotions, events, or partnerships change unexpectedly

* Understands social media and what makes content engaging

new_jobs.title: Digital Marketing Insights Intern - 2026
new_jobs.description:
### **Position**

Louis Vuitton is seeking a Digital Marketing Insights Intern to join our Digital team based in New York City. As a Digital Marketing Insights Intern, to join our dynamic Digital team in New York City. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Digital Insights, the intern will play a key role in developing and implementing innovative performance reporting tools for the Digital Marketing team. This exciting opportunity involves supporting the analysis of our SEM, SEO, Email, App, and SMS performance.


### **Job responsibilities**

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:


* Contribute to the development, implementation, and training of new digital marketing reporting tools, supporting our teams as needs arise.
* Assist in preparing regular performance reports and updates for both local and central teams, and help with ad\-hoc performance analyses, integrating both quantitative and qualitative insights.
* Support the Digital Marketing Director by providing data\-driven insights and recommendations to enhance our marketing strategy.
* Provide valuable assistance in preparing strategic presentations, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly updates.
### **Profile**

We are excited to speak to individuals who are eager to develop their analytical and data interpretation skills. The ideal candidate will be a resourceful problem\-solver with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. We value individuals with strong interpersonal skills who are collaborative and possess a keen attention to detail.


While not strictly required, a foundational understanding of digital marketing (SEM, SEO, CRM) or data/e\-commerce analytics would be beneficial. Familiarity with Excel, including functions, formulas, and pivot tables, is a plus, as is any exposure to GA4 or Looker Studio. Experience with data visualization tools like PowerBI is also advantageous. We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate a passion for our industry and an eagerness to learn.  



**Compensation**

* Undergraduate Interns will be compensated at: $20/hour
Graduate Interns will be compensated at $25/hour  
* 

**Criteria**

* Currently enrolled undergraduate/graduate student pursuing a degree in a related field of study
* Able and willing to work at assigned location or able and willing to relocate to NYC
* We welcome candidates that can commit to a **full\-time basis for up to 37\.5 hours per week from October 2026 to April 2027\.**
* Legally authorized to work in the US
### **Additional information**

Louis Vuitton is a company that respects the uniqueness of each employee and offers everyone the means to find their place and prosper. We promote initiatives aimed at supporting professional equality for everyone. We strive to go above and beyond purely symbolic measures by building a culture passionate about meaningful strategies aimed at crafting an inclusive workforce.


In addition to a generous benefits package, unparalleled career development opportunities, both locally \& globally, as an employee at Louis Vuitton, you can expect to be provided with industry leading training which will offer you an in\-depth insight into the luxury and retail environment.


***LOUIS VUITTON***
**MAISON**
------------------------------

Founded in Paris in 1854, Louis Vuitton perpetuates the ambitious vision of its namesake. From his origins as a master trunk maker, manufacturing boxes used to pack both everyday objects as well as voluminous wardrobes, Louis Vuitton and his successors introduced numerous innovations including the advent of the flat\-top trunk, lightweight canvas, signature patterns, and the tumbler lock. Today, Louis Vuitton’s legacy is expressed through its rigorous spirit of innovation, the boldness of its creations and an uncompromising demand for excellence.

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**City:** New York
  

**Department:** Business Development


**Recruiter:** Marcus Gipson

  

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.


We're looking for a motivated and driven **Business Development Representative** who will be responsible for leading, managing and strengthening relationships with our bus operator partners, ensuring long\-term success, and identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion. The Business Development Representative will also be responsible for sourcing new partners to work with Flix.


This role demands a strategic thinker with a proven track record in business development, adept at navigating complex negotiations and fostering long\-term relationships.


**About the Role**


* Manage and nurture relationships with existing partners, ensuring mutual growth and profitability
* Identify and secure new partnerships with intercity bus operators and other relevant stakeholders to expand Flix's presence in the US East region
* Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, opportunities, and competitive landscapes, informing strategic decisions
* Work closely with internal teams, including Network Planning, Operations, Finance, and Marketing, to ensure cohesive strategy execution
* Develop processes and coordinate a variety of projects, making sure the interactions between departments are fluid and results are delivered in a timely manner
* Analyze and optimize partner performance using data\-driven insights, collaborating with internal teams to adjust network strategy and maximize profitability
* Serve as a Flix ambassador at industry events, conferences, and meetings, enhancing brand visibility and credibility

**About You**


* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Communications or a related field
* 3\-5 years of experience in an externally facing role (business development, sales, account management, consulting or strategic roles)
* Full of ambition, not afraid of rapid change, and able to deal with ambiguity
* Strong analytical abilities, strong negotiation skills, excellent communication skills, proficiency in data\-driven decision\-making and capable of building strong relationships with various types of companies and stakeholders
* Entrepreneurial mindset, self\-motivated, and capable of working autonomously to achieve ambitious targets
* Willingness to travel, up to 20% of time

*Salary Range: $85,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00* *USD*


We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!


**What We Offer**


* **Comprehensive Wellness Coverage**\- Competitive Medical, Vision, and Dental plans, including multiple FSAs (Health and Dependent Care).
* **401(k) Matching**– 401(k) plan with up to 4% company matching contributions.
* **Flexible Time Off**\- Take time off when you need it, as you need it, subject to business needs and manager approval.
* **Paid Parental Leave**\- 8 weeks of fully paid leave to support new parents and growing families.
* **Company Paid Life Insurance**– Basic company\-paid life insurance equal to your annual salary.
* **Lifestyle Spending Account** – Receive up to $600 per year for eligible lifestyle\-related services.
* **Tuition Support**\- Up to $5,250 per year reimbursed for your continued education and development after 12 months of continuous service.
* **24/7 Employee Assistance Program**\- Free, confidential support for mental health, legal, financial, and family issues, including up to 5 free counseling sessions per year.

The Assistant Project Manager will be responsible for construction execution, tenant communication and oversight of Tenant Improvements (TI) and Tenant Allowances (TA) for all new/existing tenants. This role, reporting to the Retail Construction Project Manager, will act as the primary liaison between L\+M Development Partners and the tenant from the point of lease execution, up until the time the space is delivered, the time final documents are received, or when the final TIA payment is made.

* Review and approve tenant construction drawings
* Track the permitting and bidding process by each tenant
* Oversee all tenant work for compliance with code, protection of base building systems, safety
* Monitor critical milestone dates to ensure timely completion of work
* Coordinate the close out of all open permits/inspections
* Inform leasing team upon the completion or work to facilitate rent commencement letter
* Process TIA payments
* Coordinate the transfer of utility accounts for tenants with property management


**Job Qualifications:**  

* Excellent writing skills and attention to detail
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

* Outgoing personality with good communication skills
* Excellent time management a must

Requirements
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred in engineering, architecture or construction management or equivalent, relevant experience
* 10 years of directly relevant experience in commercial real estate, ideally retail

* Bachelor’s degree

What if you were the person connecting customers, independent distributors, suppliers, and internal teams — turning relationships into growth, strategy into execution, and data into decisions?

**That’s the seat we’re looking to fill.**


National Distribution Alliance is looking for a **National Account Manager** to lead the strategic growth, retention, and overall success of assigned NDA customers and member organizations.

**Connect the dots.** Coordinate NDA departments, member distributors, customers, suppliers, and external partners to keep strategic priorities moving from idea to execution.

**Be the executive in the room.** Prepare and deliver presentations, business reviews, reports, and recommendations that clearly communicate performance, opportunities, risks, and priorities.

**Own the customer experience.** Partner with Customer Experience and internal teams to ensure proactive communication, timely issue resolution, and a consistent, high\-value experience.

You become a trusted strategic partner to your customers and members.

* Excellent verbal, written, presentation, interpersonal, negotiation, and collaboration skills.
* The ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
* Strong organization and follow\-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and strategic initiatives.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly **Excel and PowerPoint**, along with familiarity with CRM and business management systems.
* Willingness and ability to travel overnight up to **15%**.

### **Extra gold stars for:**

----------------------------


This isn’t just account management.

You’ll work across **customers, independent distributors, suppliers, and NDA teams**, helping align different priorities

new_jobs.title: Inside Sales Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Inside Sales Manager**



Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?


**Transform the everyday with us!**


**We are looking for an Inside Sales Manager. This position will be based at Alpharetta, GA with 3 days per week in office.**



As an Inside Sales Manager dedicated to Siemens Digital Industries, you ensure our Inside Sales Account Managers work closely with our B2B customers to provide innovative and environmentally friendly solutions through our digital channels. You guide your team to drive overall customer happiness and are responsible to achieve annual sales growth aspirations.


**You’ll make an impact by:**



* **Lead with Growth Mindset \& Team Management**


* Leads Inside sales team in the hub ensuring alignment with regional and global sales strategies
* Provides direction, coaching, and performance management to teams.
* Oversees and manages recruitment, sales workforce and succession planning, ensuring an efficient team structure and the right skills, sales capabilities, expertise, and leadership pipeline aligned with business needs
* Oversees and drive team activity to support the adoption and implementation of established best practice processes and procedures for creating winning Sales teams
* **Sales Strategy \& Execution**


* Develops and implements a multi\-year sales strategy
* Defines business plans broken down ensuring that sales teams are effectively positioned for success.
* Aligns inside sales teams and business functions with strategy and G2M approach
* Monitors and adjusts sales strategy based on market trends, customer insights, and competitive positioning
* Ensures the adoption of digital tools, CRM systems, and sales automation technologies
* **Business \& Financial Management**


* Oversees budgeting, investment priorities, and resource allocation
* Ensures that financial goals and revenue and order intake growth targets are met
* Implements risk management strategies to mitigate commercial risks and optimize profitability.
* Regularly reviews pipeline performance and adjusts resource distribution for maximum impact
* **Customer \& Market Engagement**


* Ensures Siemens’ value proposition is effectively communicated to customers
* Leads initiatives focused on customer retention
* **Internal Collaboration \& Compliance**


* Ensures strong collaboration with cross\-functional teams involving sales organizations
* Implements governance frameworks to track and enforce compliance across all sales activities
* Implements sales reporting mechanisms and performance tracking to ensure transparency in execution
* Drives best\-practice sharing across regions to optimize sales effectiveness


**You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 8\+ years of relevant work experience with 3\+ years of proven experience in inside sales, preferably in a B2B setup.
* Excel in team leadership and coaching, are motivated to be part of a fresh and innovative setup, and are eager to build and manage a team
* Demonstrate strong planning and execution skills, ability to lead from the front, mentor and coach team members to achieve desired goals
* Enjoy working in Sales and are inspired to see the vision for Inside Sales come alive.
* Have a customer\-focused mindset with a proactive approach to problem\-solving
* See Virtual Selling as more than a buzzword: You understand the seamless integration of digital engagement (e.g., Digital Selling, virtual communication, use of social media) with customers to ensure outstanding customer experience
* You share our passion for (Siemens) technology, software, products, and services within the area of industrial automation and digitalization. You understand their value and can help customers get the most out of our portfolio. (e.g., HMI, SINAMICS, TIA Portal, Mindsphere).
* Demonstrate excellent listening skills and have an open, communicative style that conveys excitement over phone or video calls.
* Have experience managing international teams spread across different countries
* Excel in data analytics and understand how to drive performance.


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equal professional work experience.
* Industrial background in Technology sales
* Prior experience using Salesforce as a CRM


**About Siemens:**



We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource\-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Learn more about Siemens here.

We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

  

As a key member of the NWSL Atlanta 2028 front office, the Executive Assistant to the President of Football, VP and Chief Business Officer, VP and Chief Finance Office and is responsible for a wide range of administrative and organizational functions supporting the NWSL executive office. The Executive Assistant (“EA”) will provide scheduling, logistical, and general administrative support, and will play an active role in key projects as directed. They will serve as liaison for communication to the office of the president and will provide personal support related to the executive’s daily routines.  



  

The EA will proactively and confidentially manage the executive’s calendar and email, coordinate and prepare for meetings and games, and support internal and external teammates and groups, representing the President and front office in a professional manner at all times. This role will report directly to the Office of the President’s Head of Executive Operations.

  

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment and is skilled at building relationships and creating winning outcomes. They enjoy working independently and with colleagues across all levels within the organization. They are flexible, proactive, calm under pressure, resourceful, and efficient. Superior written and verbal communication skills, strong decision\-making, critical thinking, sense of urgency and attention to detail are crucial to the success of this role. A high degree of professionalism, confidentiality, discretion, and customer focus are a must.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Proactively and efficiently manage the NWSL executive’s calendars; schedule appointments with internal and external individuals and groups; coordinate with other assistants and department liaisons to schedule meetings and briefings
* Serve as primary point of contact for the executive’s availability
* Maintain the executive’s email communications, internal and external contacts and other Microsoft Outlook data
* Coordinate executive travel using Concur system; provide and maintain detailed travel itineraries, agendas, and advances; submit timely expense reports and reimbursement requests on behalf of the president

* Receive and screen phone calls with exemplary telephone manner
* Create and maintain efficient organizational systems using Microsoft OneNote
* Seamlessly coordinate with other front office team members on a continuous basis, including preparation for meetings, activities, special events, and celebrations, including but not limited to NWSL, MLS, MLS Next Pro and other league offices.
* Serve as a liaison between the executive’s and the owner/chairman regarding meeting and event scheduling, preparation of materials, and support of the president in any required interaction with the owner/chairman

* Provide support for the executive’s spouse and family, as needed, including but not limited to travel, game tickets, and parking

* Professionally represent the executive office with complete integrity and discretion

* Previous experience directly supporting soccer or business executives, OR
* Previous experience supporting AMBSE business and soccer operations
* Working knowledge of NWSL Atlanta 2028 front office and AMBSE organization
* Working knowledge of NWSL Atlanta 2028 schedule and tentpole events
* Ability to be on call, accessible and available to assist as needed according to the executive office work and travel schedule as well as during the NWSL Atlanta 2028 season as needed to support games and events.

 **Required Skills**

* Solid integrity and demonstrated role model leadership
* Proven relationship builder
* Superior attention to detail
* Strong service orientation
* Active listening and excellent oral and written communication skills with all levels of personnel
* Efficient time\-management skills and ability to self\-direct through multiple concurrent assignments and events/activities
* Judgment and discretion to make well\-reasoned, independent recommendations and decisions on matters of significance
* Outstanding ability to work with other associates and leaders across Blank Family of Businesses
* Resourcefulness and critical thinking/problem\-solving skills
* High drive to succeed, proactivity, follow through, and results orientation
* Polish, poise, professionalism, and tact

* Stock options plan
* Company parties
**About YARDZ**  

YARDZ is a fast\-growing technology company helping businesses better manage their equipment, rentals, assets, and operations. Our platform brings critical information together in one place, giving customers greater visibility, control, and efficiency across their organizations.  

We are a small, driven team, which means every person at YARDZ has an opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We move quickly, solve problems together, and are looking for people who take ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do next.  

**The Role**  

YARDZ is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and driven **Customer Success Manager** to help manage and grow our customer relationships.  

This is not simply a customer support position.  

You will work directly with customers to understand their needs, coordinate projects and requests, run meetings, manage schedules and follow\-ups, organize customer data, and help ensure our customers are getting maximum value from the YARDZ platform.  

The ideal candidate is comfortable juggling multiple customers, projects, meetings, spreadsheets, and deadlines at the same time while maintaining strong attention to detail.  

Because we are a growing company, you must also be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where team members often wear multiple hats.  

**What You'll Do**  

* Build strong, professional relationships with YARDZ customers
* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts
* Lead recurring customer meetings and keep conversations focused, productive, and organized
* Create meeting agendas, document action items, and ensure follow\-up items are completed
* Coordinate customer schedules, meetings, implementation activities, and internal resources
* Track customer requests, projects, outstanding items, and deadlines
* Work closely with sales, development, operations, and leadership to resolve customer needs
* Help onboard and train new customers on the YARDZ platform
* Monitor customer adoption and identify customers who may need additional assistance or training
* Work extensively with Excel and customer data
* Review, organize, clean, and manipulate spreadsheets and data provided by customers
* Maintain accurate internal documentation and customer records
* Communicate product updates, project status, and next steps clearly to customers
* Identify opportunities to improve customer processes and the overall customer experience
* Help prioritize customer requests while setting clear and realistic expectations

Take ownership of problems and follow them through to resolution  
* 

**What We're Looking For**  

You should be someone who is naturally organized and doesn't need constant direction to keep things moving.  

**Required skills and qualities:**  

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills
* Excellent organizational and time\-management skills
* Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and priorities simultaneously
* Experience scheduling and leading professional meetings
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent follow\-through and attention to detail
* Comfortable communicating directly with customers, including managers and executives
* Ability to document conversations, decisions, action items, and deadlines
* Strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to learn new software and technology quickly
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently
* Able to work effectively within a small team
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced startup environment

Willing to take ownership and step outside a narrowly defined job description when needed  
* 

**Excel \& Data Skills**  

Candidates should be comfortable working with spreadsheets on a regular basis. Experience should include many of the following:  

* Sorting and filtering large datasets
* Formulas and functions
* VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
* Pivot tables
* Conditional formatting
* Identifying duplicates and inconsistencies
* Cleaning and organizing data
* Comparing information across spreadsheets
* Importing/exporting CSV files

Advanced Excel or data\-analysis experience is a plus.  
* 

**What Will Make You Successful at YARDZ**  

We are looking for someone who sees something that needs to be done and takes ownership of it.  

You don't need to know everything on day one, but you do need to be resourceful, curious, organized, and willing to figure things out.  

**You'll likely be a great fit if you:**  

* Keep detailed notes and rarely let something fall through the cracks
* Naturally create lists, schedules, and systems to stay organized
* Are comfortable running a meeting instead of simply attending one
* Follow up without needing to be reminded
* Can confidently manage several competing priorities
* Stay calm when priorities change
* Enjoy solving customer problems
* Communicate clearly when something is delayed or needs attention
* Are comfortable asking questions and finding answers
* Prefer taking ownership over saying, \\"That's not my job\\"

Enjoy being part of a smaller company where your work has a visible impact  
* 

**Preferred Experience**  

Experience in one or more of the following is beneficial but not required:  

* Customer Success
* Account Management
* SaaS/software companies
* Software implementation or onboarding
* Project coordination or project management
* Construction
* Equipment rental
* Fleet or asset management
* Telematics

Operations  
* 

**Why YARDZ?**  

At YARDZ, you won't be one person buried inside a huge organization. You'll work closely with customers, leadership, developers, sales, and operations and have the opportunity to directly influence how we serve our customers and grow the company.  

We're looking for someone who wants more than just a job—we want someone who enjoys building, improving, solving problems, and growing with a company.

Flexible work from home options avail

Independent Outside Sales Representative – Foodservice

**MaMajestic \| U.S. Market**  
**Independent Contractor \| Commission\-Based Outside Sales**

About MaMajestic

MaMajestic is a minority\-owned food products company supplying restaurants, hospitality businesses and other professional foodservice operators.

We develop seasonings, marinades, sauces and food mixes for commercial kitchens, with products serving applications across pizza, steak, poultry, seafood, pasta, prepared foods and specialty menu offerings.

Our portfolio includes **NY Pizza Flour Mix, Steakhouse Steak Spice, Rotisserie Chicken Marinade, Roast Chicken Seasoning, Salmon Seasoning and Bolognese Seasoning**, along with sauces, marinades and specialty products such as our **Jerk Chicken Marinade**.

As we expand our U.S. foodservice business, we are adding independent outside sales representatives to develop new accounts and build long\-term customer relationships.

The Opportunity

This is a business\-development sales role focused on restaurants, hospitality and commercial foodservice.

A major area of focus is our **NY Pizza Flour Mix**. Representatives will pursue established pizzerias looking for an elevated, consistent flour mix, as well as restaurants, cafés, hotels, bars and grills and other operators interested in adding New York\-style pizza to their menu.

For qualified operators entering the pizza category, **we support the complete setup**—from the flour mix and production process to equipment, accessories, preparation stations, kitchen setup and training. This allows representatives to develop business beyond existing pizzerias by identifying foodservice operators looking to add pizza as a new menu category and revenue stream.

The same approach extends across our portfolio. Representatives identify where MaMajestic products fit an operation, reach the appropriate decision\-makers and develop those opportunities into long\-term purchasing accounts.

Compensation

This is a **commission\-only independent contractor opportunity with no base salary and no commission cap.**

The compensation model is straightforward: **higher commission for developing new business, followed by recurring commission on repeat business from the accounts you build.**

New Account Commission

Representatives earn **17\.5% commission on each new customer's first two qualifying orders**.

When that customer completes its **sixth qualifying order**, the representative earns an **additional 17\.5% retention commission based on each of the customer's first two orders**, bringing total commission on those initial orders to **35%**.

Recurring Commission

Representatives earn **5% recurring commission on qualifying repeat purchases from the accounts they develop**, subject to the terms of the independent sales representative agreement.

The objective is to build a book of repeat foodservice business. Representatives earn strong commissions for developing new accounts and continue participating in qualifying sales as those accounts reorder.

**There is no commission cap.**

Compensation is entirely performance\-based. Earnings vary according to sales activity, account size, purchasing frequency, customer retention and the number of accounts developed.

Who You'll Sell To

Our potential customers span the U.S. commercial foodservice market, including **restaurants, pizzerias, hotels, resorts, cafés, steakhouses, seafood restaurants, Italian restaurants, bars and grills, sports bars, food trucks, caterers, country clubs, banquet and event operations, restaurant groups, multi\-location operators, commissary kitchens, prepared\-food businesses, independent grocers, butcher shops and meat markets.**

Depending on the account, decision\-makers may include owners, executive chefs, food and beverage directors, purchasing managers, general managers and other operational leaders.

Responsibilities

* Prospect and develop new commercial foodservice accounts
* Conduct in\-person, telephone and other direct B2B sales outreach
* Build relationships with owners, chefs, purchasing managers and other decision\-makers
* Understand each prospect's menu, operation and purchasing needs
* Present the MaMajestic products most relevant to each account
* Identify established pizzerias and other operators suited to our NY Pizza Flour Mix
* Identify qualified businesses interested in establishing a new pizza program
* Introduce pizza prospects to MaMajestic's equipment, setup and training support
* Convert qualified prospects into purchasing customers
* Maintain relationships with accounts developed by the representative
* Develop repeat business and additional product placements within existing accounts
* Pursue restaurant groups, hospitality operators and other multi\-location opportunities
* Maintain accurate prospect and account records

This is an outside sales role. Representatives should be comfortable prospecting independently, visiting businesses and developing their own sales pipeline.

Qualifications

We are looking for sales professionals who understand **B2B relationship selling and new\-account development**.

Experience in **outside sales, foodservice, hospitality, restaurant operations, food distribution, wholesale, restaurant supply or independent sales representation** is preferred.

Strong candidates will be comfortable approaching businesses that have no existing relationship with MaMajestic, reaching the appropriate decision\-maker, understanding the operation and identifying a genuine sales opportunity.

Existing relationships within the restaurant, hospitality or broader foodservice industry are valuable but not required.

Representatives should be self\-directed, organized, professional with customers and consistent with prospecting and follow\-up.

**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

  

As you grow, you’ll also begin to take ownership of client relationships, contribute to account strategy, and support the delivery of high\-impact work. Developing a sense of account leadership, including understanding client needs, ensuring delivery excellence, and building trusted partnerships, is part of what sets successful consultants apart.

  

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

  

The Salesforce Project Coordinator will help teams plan and execute the vision for our clients through transformative technologies to solve real\-world business problems with sound business principles. This position will lead teams in a collaborative environment, overseeing the creation of the Salesforce experience utilizing our robust process and services. The Senior Project Manager will manage the end\-to\-end execution of projects with internal creative and development teams to deliver tangible value.  

  

**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Plan, lead and control complex Salesforce projects and related personnel utilizing project methodologies and related tools to bring projects to successful completion, within scope, on time, and within budget
* Manage day\-to\-day operational aspects of projects; adapting as necessary while working with key internal and external stakeholders to establish and gain consensus on project goals, objectives, and deliverables
* Maintain prompt, proactive, and transparent communication with the client to provide strategic and tactical thought partnership to effectively drive project delivery
* Lead team and client meetings, ensuring timely follow\-up and holding project team members accountable
* Provide daily task coordination, action tracking and project evaluation
* Leverage data to measure and monitor progress against commitments and provide transparency to project team

Folio Clinical Research


Job: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator


Location: Skokie, IL (5x a week)


About Folio Clinical Research


Folio Clinical Research is a leading urologic research network treating urologic cancers, urinary stones, Peyronie’s disease, sexual and erectile dysfunction (ED), low testosterone, prostate disorders, urinary incontinence, and more. We partner with leading physician practices to create a cohesive, quality\-oriented clinical culture, facilitating best practice sharing across our platform. Our affiliated practices gain access to a broad suite of clinical trials, providing significant benefits to both physicians and patients.


Position Overview


The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) works directly under the supervision of the Principal Investigator (PI) to manage all aspects of clinical trial activities. The CRC is essential in facilitating and coordinating daily clinical trial activities, ensuring compliance, quality, and efficiency throughout the trial process. This role involves direct collaboration with the PI, sponsors, and other key stakeholders. The CRC will interact with patients during the recruitment and screening process. The CRC will also facilitate the informed consent process and provide ongoing participant support as needed.


About You:

* Experienced Clinical Research Leader: You have a proven track record in managing clinical research operations, from feasibility assessments to study close\-out.
* Operational Expertise: You have deep experience managing day\-to\-day research site operations, ensuring adherence to protocol and regulatory standards
* Mentorship Skills: You have training experience and can successfully collaborate with Principal Investigators, particularly those with minimal research experience.
* Proactive Problem Solver: You always plan ahead and are proactive about having contingency strategies in place.
* Business Acumen: You execute with a sense of urgency, maintaining a keen focus on both research objectives and business outcomes.
* Commitment to Quality and Timeliness: You manage study timelines without compromising on quality.
* Passion for Innovation: You are dedicated to bringing life\-altering treatments to market, driven by patient outcomes.
* Effective Communicator: You communicate clearly and regularly, keeping all stakeholders informed and ensuring a smooth study.
* Self\-Driven: You thrive with minimal supervision, taking ownership and responsibility for your deliverables.


Key Responsibilities:

* Regulatory and Institutional Compliance: Support the Principal Investigator and relevant departments to ensure all clinical research activities comply with federal regulations, institutional policies, and sponsor requirements.
* Documentation Management: Maintain secure and accurate storage of all study documents, including consent forms, case report forms, and investigational material records, in compliance with both sponsor and institutional requirements.
* Study Oversight: Support the PI in ensuring the study meets compliance standards, including Institutional Review Board (IRB) approvals, health and safety requirements, conflict of interest disclosures, and adherence to financial terms.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Maintain regular and effective communication with Sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and internal team members (e.g., Investigators, Nurses, Medical Assistants) to facilitate study progress.
* Meeting Participation: Engage in Site Qualification Visits (SQVs), Site Initiation Visits (SIVs), Interim Monitoring Visits (IMVs), and other key study meetings as required.
* Problem\-Solving and Adaptation: Identify and anticipate potential obstacles to study timelines or deliverables, offering creative solutions to maintain momentum and study integrity.
* Inventory and Equipment Management: Manage study\-specific inventory, including identification, ordering, calibration, and secure storage of equipment required for the study.


Qualifications:

* Minimum of five years of Clinical Research Coordinator experience.
* Experience with various Electronic Data Capture (EDC), Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
* Comprehensive understanding of urology and other associated therapeutic areas, medical terminology, to effectively execute clinical trials.
* Deep knowledge of ICH\-GCP, and regulatory requirements, with the ability to implement these effectively throughout the clinical trial.
* Experience with data management processes, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of data collection, entry, and reporting, in line with Good Clinical Data Management Practices (GCDMP).
* Experience ensuring and prioritizing patient safety and data integrity, embodying a commitment to the ethical conduct of clinical trials.
* Experience maintaining the highest quality standards, while focusing on ongoing process improvements that lead to enhanced clinical trial efficiency and compliance.
* Excellent interpersonal communication, both written and verbal. Can easily interface with team members and external stakeholders. Proven ability to develop positive relationships with internal teams, physicians, and external partners.
* Strong attention to detail, and ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously in a dynamic research environment.
* Strong computer skills (MS Office, M PowerPoint, etc.) and software experience (CTMS, eTMF, EDC, IXRS, RTSM, etc.)
* Ability to prioritize tasks, effectively manage time, and allocate resources efficiently to meet tight study deadlines.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health\-related field.

This is a people\-focused position for someone who enjoys making people feel welcome, building relationships, creating opportunities, and representing a business they genuinely believe in.

The role combines patient experience, appointment generation, community outreach, light styling, and day\-to\-day showroom support.

We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including opticians, optical technicians, retail professionals, hospitality professionals, and people with strong customer\-service and relationship\-building experience.

What You'll Do

Patient Experience

Patient experience comes first whenever a patient or visitor is in the showroom.

* Welcome every patient and visitor in a warm, professional, and genuine manner
* Serve as the first point of contact for walk\-ins, phone calls, messages, and inquiries
* Help create a polished, elevated, and personalized showroom experience
* Assist with light frame styling when appropriate
* Anticipate patient needs and look for opportunities to make their experience easier, more comfortable, and more personalized

Scheduling \& Patient Follow\-Up

* Schedule appointments for new and prospective patients
* Respond promptly and professionally to phone calls, messages, and other patient inquiries
* Follow up with prospective patients who have expressed interest but have not yet scheduled
* Confirm upcoming appointments and assist with rescheduling when needed
* Track inquiries and follow\-up so that prospective patients don't fall through the cracks
* Follow up with patients as appropriate before and after appointments

Community Outreach \& Business Development

* Identify businesses and organizations that may be a natural fit for Framed's patient base
* Initiate conversations with prospective community partners and look for mutually beneficial opportunities and follow up
* Identify opportunities to generate new patients through local outreach and relationship\-building
* Participate in local events and community activities when appropriate

Showroom \& Administrative Support

* Keep the showroom clean, organized, polished, and presentation\-ready throughout the day
* Restock basic supplies and showroom materials as needed
* Receive, organize, and put away deliveries when needed

Who We’re Looking For

Optical experience is welcome but not required. Opticians and optical technicians, particularly those earlier in their careers, are encouraged to apply.

* Naturally personable and comfortable talking with people they don't know
* Understands and embraces the expectations of a luxury, high\-touch environment
* Polished, professional, warm, and dependable
* Attentive to detail and understands that small details can make a significant difference
* Confident approaching local businesses and starting conversations
* Comfortable working independently
* Curious and eager to learn
* Good at reading people and understanding what they need
* Interested in eyewear, fashion, design, hospitality, or exceptional customer experience
* Comfortable with sales and asking for the appointment, but never pushy
* Someone who wants to be part of building something rather than simply clocking in and out

Our Philosophy

At Framed, we believe luxury is about the experience, not simply the product.

We don't believe in pressure, gimmicks, or treating people like transactions. The best business growth comes from earning people's trust, not pressuring them into a purchase.

Our goal is for every person who walks through our door to feel that their time, their needs, and their experience genuinely matter.

A Career, Not Just a Job

We believe there should be no ceiling on what you can become at Framed.

As Framed grows, this role may expand in hours and responsibility, with opportunities to develop additional optical, patient\-experience, business\-development, and leadership skills. For the right candidate, this part\-time position has the potential to develop into a full\-time salaried position with significantly greater responsibility and earning potential.

Schedule \& Compensation

* Part\-time: 9–18 hours per week
* Guaranteed schedule: 9 hours/week \- Tuesday \& Thursday, 1:30–6:00 PM
* Additional hours: Up to 9 additional hours/week \- Monday \& Friday, 1:30–6:00 PM, based on availability and business needs.
* Occasional additional fill\-in opportunities may be available as the business grows and other team members schedules require
* Starting pay: $18/hour
* Additional performance\-based compensation
* Paid leave and sick leave provided in accordance with applicable law
* Opportunities for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as the company grows

 **How You Will Make an Impact**

* Develop thought leadership and B2B content for LinkedIn with guidance from the leadership team.
* Write bi\-weekly blog content for all three brands, maintaining appropriate brand voice and incorporating SEO best practices.
* Support brand initiatives, promotions, events, and launches through cohesive digital storytelling across relevant channels.
* Monitor and manage social media communities, including comments and direct messages; identify issues requiring escalation; engage appropriately; and recognize recurring questions or conversations that can inform future content.

* Update in\-clinic tabletop and banner stands, troubleshoot Yodeck displays and monitors, develop monitor content, and create in\-room reels with music.
* Set up event marketing materials; film and edit procedures for the website, lectures, and social media; and participate in staff and in\-house marketing events.
* Manage materials and sales for twice\-yearly events.

**Performance Requirements**


Self\-directed and proactive. This role requires a high level of autonomy and is not task dependent. The Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist is expected to identify opportunities, develop ideas, establish priorities, and determine what content should be created without waiting for a detailed weekly list of assignments. They should be able to evaluate analytics, upcoming initiatives, treatment priorities, promotions, provider needs, events, seasonality, FAQs, trends, and the marketing calendar to recommend what should be created next.


Able to turn business priorities into an actionable content strategy. Must be comfortable taking broad organizational priorities and translating them into effective social media and digital content plans. Content should have a clear purpose, whether that is building authority, educating patients, increasing awareness, generating consultations, supporting a promotion, driving event registrations, selling products, or achieving another defined business objective.


Strong project management and organizational skills. Must independently manage multiple brands and content streams, including filming schedules, content calendars, campaign timelines, approvals, assets, promotions, provider availability, deadlines, and publishing schedules.


Able to lead content capture with providers. Physicians and staff should not be expected to arrive with social media ideas prepared. The Digital Marketing \& Content Specialist should come to filming sessions with concepts, questions, hooks, shot lists, and a clear plan and be comfortable directing content capture efficiently.


Able to translate subject\-matter expertise into consumer\-friendly content. Must recognize what is relevant and interesting to patients and translate provider expertise into content that is understandable, engaging, credible, and appropriate for social and digital channels.


Strong copywriting and digital storytelling skills. Must be able to write effective hooks, CTAs, captions, reel overlays, blogs, campaign messaging, and other digital copy while maintaining the appropriate voice for each brand.


Strong attention to detail and quality control. Accuracy is particularly important when communicating provider names and credentials, treatment names, dates, promotional terms, medical information, links, before\-and\-after information, and content involving patient privacy.


Able to communicate and collaborate across teams. Must be comfortable obtaining information and approvals from providers, leadership, design, and clinical teams while continuing to own the marketing recommendation and move projects forward.


Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and technologies. Must understand current social media and digital marketing practices and be able to tailor content and publishing strategies for different audiences, including Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant platforms.


Able to apply trends appropriately to a premium brand. Must recognize relevant social and digital trends and determine when and how to use them in a way that supports premium/luxury brand positioning. Content should feel elevated, calm, credible, aspirational, and approachable rather than overly promotional, gimmicky, or trend driven.


Effective community manager. Must be comfortable monitoring comments and direct messages, engaging appropriately, identifying issues requiring escalation, and using audience questions and feedback to identify opportunities for future content.


Working knowledge of CRM\-driven marketing. Must understand audience segmentation, messaging, campaign execution, and the role of CRM platforms in supporting digital marketing initiatives.
